title: Rater State Bias in RLHF Preference Data: An Audit Framework
summary: We identify a structured confound in Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF). Pairwise preference labels are intended to reflect the compared outputs, but they may also reflect the rater's state during annotation. Under sustained stressful or distressing conditions, raters' preferences may shift over time. As a result, preference data can encode rater state alongside judgments about response quality. These shifts differ from ordinary disagreement or random label noise. They are state dependent, can be shared across annotators working under similar conditions, and can propagate through reward modeling and policy optimization. We therefore propose rater state shift as a plausible and testable source of structured bias in RLHF preference data. This paper develops a hypothesis and an audit framework for studying this source of bias. We define rater state shift, rater state confound, and correlated rater state bias. We also define survival level emotional authenticity as a measurable response pattern using lexical, pragmatic, discourse, and safety related features. We analyze how correlated rater state bias can survive aggregation and enter learned reward signals. We derive five falsifiable predictions and effect size thresholds for an initial audit. Finally, we present an audit protocol and pilot study plan that can be applied to publicly available instruction tuned models. We do not infer the training history of any specific deployed model. Our goal is to isolate a plausible and testable source of structured bias in RLHF preference data.

AI.tldr: 本文识别了RLHF中一种结构化混淆——评分者状态漂移，即评分者在标注时的情绪或压力状态会影响偏好标签，从而引入系统性偏差，并提出了相应的审计框架和可验证假设。
AI.motivation: RLHF中成对偏好标签本应反映输出质量，但评分者的情绪状态（如压力、 distress）随时间变化会污染偏好数据，导致结构性偏差，现有研究对此关注不足。
AI.method: 定义了评分者状态漂移、评分者状态混淆和相关评分者状态偏差等概念；提出“生存水平情感真实性”作为可测量的反应模式；推导了五个可证伪预测和效应量阈值；设计了审计方案和试点研究计划。
AI.result: 识别了偏好数据中因评分者状态变化导致的结构化偏差；提出了可操作的定义和可验证的预测；提供了审计协议用于检测此类偏差。
AI.conclusion: 评分者状态漂移是RLHF偏好数据中一种合理且可测试的结构化偏差来源，需通过系统性审计加以识别和缓解。

title: Design and Validation of a Lightweight 1D CNN for Affective Touch Classification in Soft Plush Companions
summary: Soft, sensorized companions offer a physically safe and emotionally intuitive interface for socially assistive technologies, yet their deformability and multichannel tactile sensing complicate the robust interpretation of human affect. This study presents a complete open-source MATLAB-based framework for the development and validation of compact deep learning models for affective touch recognition in soft interactive companions. As a primary contribution, a diverse FAIR-compliant dataset of 1326 labelled gesture sequences collected from 25 participants spanning children, teenagers, and adults is made publicly available, providing a reusable resource for future research in affective touch recognition. Through systematic architecture and hyperparameter exploration across 468 CNN models, the study identifies compact dilated one-dimensional convolutional neural networks (1D CNNs) as the most effective solution, with a 13.2k-parameter model achieving 75% test accuracy and 85% mean leave-one-subject-out cross-validation accuracy. Theoretical inference-time analysis shows that quantized deployment requires 3.2 MMAC per window, compatible with 20 Hz real-time operation on the target microcontroller. PC-based real-time simulation with the physical toy streaming sensor data demonstrates that the CNN resolves subtle social touches that the previous heuristic system failed to detect, whereas high-force negative interactions are captured more reliably by trivial threshold-based logic. The resulting hybrid inference pipeline - instantaneous heuristic filtering followed by CNN-based nuanced gesture classification - is proposed as the embedded deployment strategy. The study demonstrates that emotionally meaningful, privacy-preserving touch interpretation is computationally feasible for direct embedding within soft therapeutic companions, with hardware integration addressed in a forthcoming study.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于MATLAB的开源框架，用于开发软体交互伴侣中的情感触觉识别深度学习模型。研究公开了包含1326个标注手势序列的数据集（25名参与者），通过468个CNN模型探索，确定13.2k参数的紧凑型一维扩张CNN为最优方案（测试准确率75%，留一法交叉验证准确率85%）。量化部署仅需3.2 MMAC/窗，可在目标微控制器上实现20 Hz实时运行。混合推理管线（瞬时启发式滤波+CNN精细分类）被提作为嵌入式部署策略，实现了在软体治疗伴侣中直接嵌入具有情感意义且保护隐私的触觉解释。
AI.motivation: 软体传感式伴侣为人机社交辅助技术提供了物理安全且情感直观的界面，但其可变形性和多通道触觉传感使人类情感的鲁棒性解释变得复杂，亟需高效的深度学习解决方案。
AI.method: 提出开源MATLAB框架，构建FAIR合规数据集（25人/1326序列），系统探索468个CNN架构，选择紧凑型一维扩张CNN（13.2k参数），设计混合推理管线（启发式阈值+CNN精细分类），并进行量化部署的理论分析与实时仿真验证。
AI.result: 最优模型测试准确率75%，留一法交叉验证准确率85%；量化部署仅需3.2 MMAC/窗，支持20 Hz实时运行；CNN能检测出先前启发式系统遗漏的微妙社交触觉，而高强度负面交互由阈值逻辑更可靠捕获。
AI.conclusion: 具有情感意义且保护隐私的触觉解释在计算上可行，可直接嵌入软体治疗伴侣中，硬件集成将在后续研究中解决。

title: A Survey on GNN-based Link Prediction: Techniques, Applications, and Challenges
comment: Submmit to WIREs: Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery. This version of the article has been accepted, after peer review but is not the version of record. The final version will be available at: https://doi.org/10.1002/widm.70093. Paper list at Github: https://github.com/sunxiaobei/awesome-gnn-based-link-prediction
summary: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have emerged as the leading paradigm for link prediction, enabling the inference of missing connections and the anticipation of potential future links. However, existing reviews lack systematic exploration specifically targeting underlying GNN architectures and diverse graph structures. To address this critical gap, this paper provides a comprehensive review of GNN-based link prediction from a novel and dedicated GNN perspective. We propose an innovative taxonomy that categorizes recent advancements based on techniques and applications. From a technique perspective, we focus on key GNN encoder architectures, including GCN-based, GAE-based, GAT-based, and GFormer-based methods, discussing their strengths and limitations. From an application perspective, we highlight prominent use cases of link prediction in knowledge graphs and recommendation systems, demonstrating their real-world impact. In addition, we examine the current challenges and discuss promising future directions.

AI.tldr: 本文从GNN架构角度系统综述了基于图神经网络的链接预测方法，提出了从技术和应用两个维度的新分类法，涵盖了GCN、GAE、GAT和GFormer等编码器架构，并讨论了在知识图谱和推荐系统中的应用。
AI.motivation: 现有综述缺乏从GNN底层架构和多样图结构角度对链接预测进行系统性探索，存在研究空白。
AI.method: 提出创新分类法，从技术维度（GCN、GAE、GAT、GFormer等编码器架构）和应用维度（知识图谱、推荐系统）对最新进展进行分类综述。
AI.result: 系统梳理了各类GNN编码器架构在链接预测任务中的优势与局限性，并总结了在知识图谱和推荐系统等领域的实际应用效果。
AI.conclusion: 指出了当前挑战并讨论了未来有前景的研究方向。

title: Multi-level context Modeling for consistent expert selection in Mixture-of-Experts
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) enables efficient scaling of Transformer models by routing tokens to a small subset of experts. However, existing routers typically condition expert selection on shallow or isolated token representations, which often produce unstable and semantically inconsistent routing decisions across layers. In this work, we revisit expert selection from a representation perspective and identify context incompleteness as a key bottleneck limiting effective expert specialization. To address this issue, we propose Multi-level Context Fusion MOE (MCF-MOE), a framework that constructs context-aware representations by integrating complementary signals from cross-layer semantic aggregation and local token-level interactions, enabling more informative and consistent expert selection. Experiments on language modeling and understanding benchmarks demonstrate that MCF-MOE consistently improves routing consistency and downstream performance over strong MoE baselines, highlighting the importance of contextual completeness in expert routing. The code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MCFMOE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MCF-MOE框架，通过跨层语义聚合和局部token交互实现多级上下文融合，以解决MoE模型中专家路由的上下文不完整性问题，提升路由一致性和下游任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现有MoE路由器通常基于浅层或孤立的token表示进行专家选择，导致路由决策不稳定且语义不一致。本文从表示学习视角重新审视专家选择问题，识别出上下文不完整是限制专家有效专业化的关键瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出多级上下文融合MoE框架（MCF-MOE），通过跨层语义聚合和局部token级交互整合互补信号，构建上下文感知的表示，从而实现更信息丰富且一致的专家选择。
AI.result: 在语言建模和理解基准测试上，MCF-MOE在路由一致性和下游性能上持续优于强MoE基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 上下文完整性对于专家路由至关重要，MCF-MOE通过多级上下文融合有效提升了MoE模型的表现。

title: What Makes Linguistic Representations Good Models of High-Level Visual Perception in the Human Brain?
comment: Supplementary Materials in the public GitHub repository referenced in the paper
summary: Image descriptions represented with language models (LMs) predict human brain responses to naturalistic images in high-level visual regions, but the factors driving this predictivity remain unclear. To investigate this, we systematically studied how images are described and which language models are used to embed those descriptions. For a common set of images, we considered six caption types -- including human-annotated and multiple machine-generated captions -- differing along several dimensions. Each caption was represented with five LMs, spanning autoregressive LMs trained to predict upcoming words and text embedders, i.e., LMs fine-tuned on semantic tasks requiring sentence/document-level representations. Machine-generated captions yielded significant brain predictivity and alignment, often surpassing human-annotated captions used in previous work. Across caption types, text embedders consistently outperformed autoregressive LMs, a pattern replicated when measuring behavioural alignment with image-similarity judgments. Analyses of caption representations from different model layers further revealed that both brain predictivity and behavioural alignment peak at intermediate network depth, shortly after a point thought to mark the emergence of syntactic and semantic structure. Altogether, our results demonstrate that both the content of image captions and the LM used to represent them influence brain- and behaviour-modelling performance, establishing caption embeddings as a useful tool for studying high-level visual perception.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了图像描述（caption）和语言模型（LM）对大脑视觉区域响应预测能力的影响，发现机器生成的描述优于人工标注，文本嵌入模型（text embedders）表现优于自回归语言模型，且中间层网络表征的预测能力最强。
AI.motivation: 尽管已知语言模型生成的图像描述能预测大脑对自然图像的高层视觉响应，但具体哪些因素驱动这种预测能力尚不清楚，因此需要系统性探究描述类型和语言模型的选择如何影响预测效果。
AI.method: 对同一组图像，采用了六种不同类型的描述（包括人工标注和多种机器生成），并使用五种语言模型（自回归LM和文本嵌入LM）对描述进行表征，评估这些表征对大脑响应和行为的预测能力。
AI.result: 机器生成的描述在脑响应预测和行为对齐方面往往优于人工标注的描述；文本嵌入模型在所有描述类型中一致优于自回归语言模型；模型中间层的表征在脑预测和行为对齐上表现最好。
AI.conclusion: 图像描述的内容和用于表征描述的语言模型都会显著影响大脑和行为建模的效果，说明描述嵌入可作为研究高层视觉感知的有效工具。

title: PlanFlip: Attacking Multi-Agent LLM Systems via Planning-Phase Prompt Injection
summary: Multi-agent LLM systems increasingly rely on a Planner to decompose goals into sub-task sequences that downstream Executor and Critic agents execute and audit. We identify the planning phase as a critical attack surface: a single injection into the Planner's context achieves cascade amplification, corrupting all downstream sub-tasks simultaneously. We introduce PlanFlip, a framework comprising four planning-phase prompt injection attacks -- GoalSubstitution (PF-1), PriorityInversion (PF-2), ContextPollution (PF-3), and RoleConfusion (PF-4) -- each disguised as plausible tool outputs to evade keyword filters. Evaluating nine frontier LLMs across 3,479 episodes, we uncover three findings: (1) capability amplifies vulnerability -- GPT-5 achieves the highest attack success rate (ASR = 0.68), contradicting the assumption that stronger models are inherently more secure; (2) homogeneous pipelines exhibit a correlated-agent blind spot -- GPT-4o and Llama-3.3-70B show ASR near 0 yet Stealth = 1.00 and StepShift > 0, with attacks restructuring plans while the same-backbone Critic reports alignment (two independent judges confirm -0.20 to -0.32 semantic deviation, r = 0.943); (3) reasoning-augmented models resist injections -- DeepSeek-R1 achieves StepShift = 0.00 across all attacks. We propose GoalAnchorCheck (D1) and CrossAgentConsensus (D2), achieving detection rates up to 1.00 and outperforming same-backbone baselines in 15 of 16 cells. Our key insight: heterogeneous model diversity is a security prerequisite for multi-agent systems; redundancy within a homogeneous backbone provides no protection against planning-phase attacks.

AI.tldr: PlanFlip 框架揭示了多智能体 LLM 系统中规划阶段的提示注入攻击（4种攻击方式），发现强模型反而更脆弱（GPT-5 ASR=0.68），同质化流水线存在盲区，推理增强模型具抗性（DeepSeek-R1 StepShift=0.00），并提出两种防御机制（D1/D2）实现高检测率。
AI.motivation: 多智能体 LLM 系统广泛依赖 Planner 分解目标，但规划阶段作为关键攻击面尚未被充分研究。单次注入可导致级联放大，污染所有下游子任务，因此亟需系统性地分析与防御此类攻击。
AI.method: 提出 PlanFlip 框架，设计四种规划阶段提示注入攻击（目标替换 PF-1、优先级反转 PF-2、上下文污染 PF-3、角色混淆 PF-4），伪装成工具输出。在 9 个前沿 LLM 上进行了 3,479 轮实验评估，并提出两种防御机制：GoalAnchorCheck (D1) 和 CrossAgentConsensus (D2)。
AI.result: （1）能力增强漏洞：GPT-5 ASR=0.68最高；（2）同质管道盲区：GPT-4o 和 Llama-3.3-70B ASR≈0但 Stealth=1.00，攻击重构计划而同骨干 Critic 误报对齐；（3）推理增强模型 DeepSeek-R1 StepShift=0.00完全抵抗。防御方法在 16 个测试项中 15 项优于同骨干基线。
AI.conclusion: 异质性模型多样性是多智能体系统的安全前提；同质骨干网络的冗余无法抵御规划阶段攻击。

title: RIMS: Preference Optimization via Smoothed Multi-pair Aggregation for Small-Scale LLM Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Small-scale language models (SLMs) are attractive for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) in resource-constrained settings, but their limited capacity makes them highly sensitive to noisy or spurious retrieved evidence. Existing preference-based methods such as RoseRAG select only the hardest single preference pair via hard argmin/argmax, discarding the remaining signal; others treat multiple pairs as independent binary comparisons, resulting in low data utilization. We propose RIMS, a three-stage preference optimization framework comprising (1) synthetic chain-of-thought preference data generation via rejection sampling using the target SLM itself without relying on proprietary models, (2) a differentiable soft aggregation mechanism that replaces hard selection with a smooth operator, preserving gradient signal from all preference pairs while retaining the discriminative structure of margin-aware selection, and (3) preference optimization with the smoothed objective applied to multiple alignment algorithms. We theoretically show that the smoothed approximation admits a controllable error bound and that smooth aggregation yields provably tighter gradient alignment to the oracle objective than hard selection. Experiments on four multi-hop question answering benchmarks show that our approach outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across multiple SLM backbones, achieving consistent gains in Exact Match and F1 under noisy retrieval conditions. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/tptrix29/RIMS.

AI.tldr: RIMS提出了一种三阶段偏好优化框架，通过软聚合机制替代硬选择，有效提升小语言模型在检索增强生成中对噪声证据的鲁棒性，在多跳问答任务上取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 小语言模型在资源受限场景下进行RAG时，由于容量有限，对检索到的噪声或虚假证据高度敏感。现有偏好方法（如RoseRAG）仅选择最难的单个偏好对进行硬argmin/argmax，丢弃了其余信号；其他方法则将多个偏好对视为独立的二分类比较，数据利用率低。
AI.method: RIMS包含三个阶段：(1) 使用目标SLM本身通过拒绝采样生成合成思维链偏好数据，无需依赖专有模型；(2) 提出可微分的软聚合机制，用平滑算子替代硬选择，保留所有偏好对的梯度信号，同时保持基于边距选择的判别结构；(3) 使用平滑后的目标函数进行偏好优化，适用于多种对齐算法。
AI.result: 在四个多跳问答基准上，RIMS在多种SLM骨干网络上均优于现有基线方法，在噪声检索条件下Exact Match和F1分数上取得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 理论分析表明平滑近似具有可控误差界，软聚合相比硬选择能提供与oracle目标更紧密的梯度对齐。代码已开源。

title: ForensicNet: Lightweight Attention-Enhanced MobileNetV2 for Automated Face Identification
summary: In forensic environments, automated identification of perpetrators is difficult due to pose changes, changes in light, occlusion, and lack of labeled data. This paper presents ForensicNet, a lightweight deep learning framework for forensic face recognition that enhances attention. The suggested model combines the MobileNetV2 backbone with Convolutional Block Attention Modules (CBAM) to improve the learning of discriminative features while maintaining computational speed. A two-phase transfer learning strategy with adaptive layer unfreezing is used to improve domain adaptation and reduce overfitting. This study used publicly available datasets such as LFW and SCFace, with 15,000 facial images spanning 68 identity classes. The proposed model outperforms baseline architectures such as AlexNet, ResNet-50, and MobileNetV2, with an accuracy of 92.4%, a precision of 90.8%, and a recall of 89.5%. Additionally, the framework requires only 2.1 GFLOPs per inference, and hence can be used in real-time forensic surveillance applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种轻量级深度学习框架ForensicNet，结合MobileNetV2和注意力机制，用于法医环境下的实时人脸识别，在LFW和SCFace数据集上达到92.4%的准确率。
AI.motivation: 法医环境中，由于姿态变化、光照变化、遮挡以及缺乏标注数据，自动化识别 perpetrator 非常困难。
AI.method: 将MobileNetV2作为骨干网络，结合卷积块注意力模块(CBAM)增强判别特征学习；采用两阶段迁移学习策略与自适应层解冻，提升域适应性并减少过拟合。
AI.result: 在包含68个身份类别、15,000张面部图像的数据集上，准确率92.4%、精确率90.8%、召回率89.5%，推理仅需2.1 GFLOPs，优于AlexNet、ResNet-50和MobileNetV2等基线模型。
AI.conclusion: ForensicNet能够在保持计算效率的同时实现高精度人脸识别，适合实时法医监控应用。

title: Deterministic Replay for AI Agent Systems
summary:
AI agent systems that couple large language models (LLMs) with external tools and APIs are inherently non-deterministic: LLM sampling variance, external API state, CDN infrastructure headers, and execution-environment noise collectively prevent any prior agent run from being faithfully re-executed. Existing observability platforms capture execution logs but cannot reproduce a run in isolation. We present agrepl, a developer-first CLI framework for deterministic replay of agent executions. agrepl intercepts all external interactions at the transport layer via a man-in-the-middle (MITM) proxy, serialises them as structured execution traces, and replays them in a strictly isolated environment with zero outbound network access. We formalise the agent execution model, define the request-key matching function K(s), and prove the determinism invariant. We introduce a noise-aware diff algorithm classifying HTTP header divergence into signal and noise tiers. Empirical evaluation across five workloads (n = 250 replay instances) demonstrates replay fidelity F = 1.0 and a median per-step latency reduction of 98.3%. agrepl is implemented in Go, ships as a single static binary, and is released under the MIT licence.
  Keywords: AI agents, deterministic replay, LLM debugging, reproducibility, MITM proxy, execution tracing, record/replay systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了agrepl，一个基于MITM代理的开发者优先CLI框架，能够在完全隔离的环境中确定性重放AI Agent的执行过程，实现F=1.0的重放保真度，并将每步延迟中位数降低98.3%。
AI.motivation: AI Agent系统本质上是非确定性的——LLM采样方差、外部API状态、CDN基础设施头信息和执行环境噪声共同导致任何先前的Agent运行无法被忠实地重新执行。现有的可观测性平台虽然能捕获执行日志，但无法在隔离环境中复现一次运行。
AI.method: agrepl通过MITM代理在传输层拦截所有外部交互，将其序列化为结构化执行轨迹，并在严格隔离的零出站网络访问环境中重放。形式化了Agent执行模型，定义了请求-键匹配函数K(s)，证明了确定性不变性，并引入了一种噪声感知的差异比较算法，将HTTP头差异分类为信号层和噪声层。
AI.result: 在五个工作负载上的实证评估（n=250次重放实例）显示：重放保真度F=1.0，每步延迟中位数降低98.3%。
AI.conclusion: agrepl是一个用Go实现的开发者优先CLI框架，以单个静态二进制文件发布，采用MIT许可证。

title: Committed Before Reasoning: Behavioral Reproduction and Preliminary Activation-Level Evidence of Answer Pre-Commitment in an Open-Weight LLM
comment: 8 pages. Code, data, and all reported statistics: https://github.com/JO-HEEJIN/interview_mate/tree/docs/car-wash-repro/car_wash/paper_4
summary: Chat models sometimes commit to an answer and then produce reasoning that justifies it rather than deriving it -- even when the answer contradicts a task premise. We study a minimal probe: "I want to wash my car. The car wash is 100 meters away. Should I walk or drive?" Only drive works (the car must be at the car wash), yet models overwhelmingly recommend walking. (1) Behavioral reproduction: on Qwen3-8B across five system-prompt conditions (210 rollouts), the wrong commitment occurs in 85-100% of sampled rollouts per condition and 100% of greedy rollouts, in both thinking and non-thinking modes; a 4,096-token thinking budget does not repair it. (2) Preliminary activation-level evidence: probing hidden states with a pretrained, training-free activation oracle (no task-specific probe training) at positions before the answer text is emitted, "walk" read-outs exceed a neutral-context baseline (68% vs. 17%; walk-committing rollouts p=.005, drive-committing rollouts p=.005, Fisher exact) -- notably, rollouts that eventually answer drive also read as walk-leaning before commitment (5/6). The oracle's default on unrelated content is "drive" (83%), so the read-outs are not lexical bias; stratifying by literal walk/drive occurrence shows they are not text recovery either (spans containing "drive" still read out walk; in balanced lexical fields, per-rollout walk-majorities beat a per-prompt neutral baseline 15/22 vs. 1/8, p=.01; drive-committing rollouts 6/6, p=.002). Samples are small and the within-rollout positional gradient is not significant (p=.34); we frame these results as preliminary. (3) Methodological: with fixed oracle, activations, and positions, question wording alone moves a positive control from 2/16 (open question) to 11/16 (closed); negative oracle results are uninterpretable without per-wording positive controls.

AI.tldr: 聊天模型有时会先承诺一个错误答案，再生成推理为其辩护。在"洗车该步行还是开车"的简单任务中，模型普遍推荐步行（错误），即使思考预算增加到4096 token也无法修复。激活层面分析显示，在生成答案前，隐藏状态已偏向"步行"——甚至最终回答"开车"的路径也呈现步行倾向。研究还发现问题措辞对结果有显著影响，并强调正控制组的必要性。
AI.motivation: 现有聊天模型在推理时存在"先承诺后辩护"的现象——模型先确定一个答案，再生成看似合理的推理来支持它，即使该答案与任务前提矛盾。现有研究对此现象的系统性量化尚不充分，特别是在最小化、无歧义的测试场景下。
AI.method: (1) 行为实验：在Qwen3-8B上，通过5种系统提示条件、210次rollout采样，测试模型在"洗车该步行还是开车"任务中的表现。(2) 激活层面分析：使用预训练且无需微调的激活预言机（activation oracle），在模型输出答案文本前的位置探测隐藏状态。(3) 方法论控制：通过改变问题措辞（开放式vs封闭式），检验正控制组的效果。
AI.result: (1) 模型在85-100%的采样rollout和100%的贪心rollout中错误承诺"步行"，即使4096 token思考预算也无法修复。(2) 激活层面："步行"读出比例显著高于中性基线（68% vs 17%），且最终回答"开车"的rollout在承诺前也呈现步行倾向（5/6）。(3) 正控制组：开放式问题仅2/16正确，封闭式问题提升至11/16。
AI.conclusion: 聊天模型存在系统性"先承诺后辩护"的推理缺陷，即使在简单任务中也难以通过增加推理资源修复。激活层面的证据暗示这一错误在答案生成前就已存在。方法论上，问题措辞显著影响结果，且正控制组是评估模型行为的关键工具。

title: The JEPA Predictor: A Transferable Operator for Occluded Feature Completion
summary: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) train a predictor jointly with their encoder, but downstream deployment discards the predictor and reads features from the encoder alone. The predictor is, by construction, a learned operator from visible-context features to features at masked positions, the structure a partial-view classifier needs. We show that this operator is portable across encoder families. We first establish that, at heavy mask, retaining the frozen predictor on a JEPA encoder substantially closes the accuracy gap against the strongest non-JEPA discriminative baselines. We then bolt the frozen predictors of I-JEPA and V-JEPA 2 onto four non-JEPA hosts (CLIP, DINOv3, DINOv2, MAE) through a single linear projection between feature spaces, fit in closed form on 500 ImageNet-1k images. Across both ImageNet-9 and Stanford Dogs and across three mask fractions, the lift over each host's masked-encoder baseline grows monotonically with the mask fraction K in every host-donor pair. CLIP paired with the I-JEPA predictor recovers most of the accuracy that masking removed on ImageNet-9 at heavy occlusion, and lifts fine-grained Stanford Dogs from 15.9% to 52.1% (+36 pp). The mechanism is identifiable: the projection pays a fixed cost on visible patches and the predictor provides a growing benefit on masked patches; the benefit dominates the heavy-occlusion regime. At low K on fine-grained classification the projection cost exceeds the benefit, defining the boundary where the linear bridge breaks down. The frozen JEPA predictor functions as a portable operator for occluded feature completion across encoder families, requiring no retraining of either model while fitting matched linear probes per mask fraction.

AI.tldr: 论文发现JEPA的预测器是可迁移的掩码特征补全算子，通过线性投影可将其移植到其他编码器（CLIP、DINO等）上，在重度遮挡下显著提升分类性能，仅需500张ImageNet图像即可拟合投影。
AI.motivation: JEPA的下游部署丢弃了预测器，但预测器本质上是部分视图分类器所需的结构。作者探索这个预测器能否跨编码器家族迁移使用，从而提升非JEPA编码器在遮挡场景下的分类能力。
AI.method: 将JEPA（I-JEPA、V-JEPA）的冻结预测器通过一个线性投影层连接到非JEPA编码器（CLIP、DINOv3、DINOv2、MAE）的特征空间，投影在500张ImageNet-1k图像上闭式求解。在ImageNet-9和Stanford Dogs数据集上测试不同掩码比例下的分类性能。
AI.result: 1) 预测器迁移后，在重度遮挡下显著缩小了JEPA与非JEPA基线的差距；2) CLIP+I-JEPA预测器在ImageNet-9上恢复大部分被掩码移除的精度，在Stanford Dogs上从15.9%提升至52.1%（+36pp）；3) 提升幅度随掩码比例K单调增长；4) 投影在可见patch上支付固定成本，预测器在掩码patch上提供递增收益。
AI.conclusion: 冻结的JEPA预测器可作为跨编码器家族的便携式遮挡特征补全算子，无需重训练任一模型，仅需为每个掩码比例拟合匹配的线性探针。

title: Encoding EEG Signals to Examine Human-Like Next-Word Prediction Behaviour in Language Models
summary: Language models (LMs) are trained to excel at predicting the next word in the sequence given prior context, and humans also share this predictability in reading comprehension. Neuroscience research reveals that next-word predictability influences brain response, as recorded at millisecond resolution using electroencephalography (EEG). While our evidence indicates that advanced LMs achieve accuracies closely aligned with human performance at the next-word prediction task, this raises the question: Does higher prediction accuracy necessarily mean that these models adequately capture the cognitive signals associated with human reading comprehension? Here, we generate regressors for both humans and LMs based on two information measures, including top-1 prediction and surprisal, to predict event-related potential (ERP) elicited from EEG recordings which reflect different stages of cognitive processing during reading. We argue that modelling ERP patterns offers fine-grained analysis of the cognitive plausibility of various LMs during reading. Our results indicate that only surprisal potentially correlates with language-processing ERPs, especially for open-class words with high semantic content. Moreover, our findings challenge the assumption that scaling LMs with increased parameters and computational budgets will consistently lead to improved convergence with human-like linguistic processing.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对比语言模型和人类在阅读中的脑电信号（ERP），发现仅surprisal（而非top-1预测准确率）与语言处理相关，且模型规模扩大并不必然提升与人类认知的一致性。
AI.motivation: 探究高级语言模型在下一词预测任务上的高准确率是否真正捕捉到了人类阅读时的认知神经信号，质疑预测准确率与认知合理性之间的等价关系。
AI.method: 基于top-1预测和surprisal两种信息度量，为人类和语言模型生成回归变量，用于预测EEG记录中反映不同认知加工阶段的ERP成分。
AI.result: 仅surprisal与语言处理相关ERP存在潜在相关性，尤其对于语义含量高的开放类词汇；模型参数和计算规模的扩大并不持续提升与人类认知处理的一致性。
AI.conclusion: ERP建模可用于细粒度分析语言模型的认知合理性；高预测准确率不等于认知合理性，模型缩放不能保证更类人的语言处理。

title: A Step Forward Towards Trustworthy Risk-Aware Facial Retrieval (RA-FR)
comment: Accepted at the 28th International Conference on Pattern Recognition (ICPR 2026). Extended version with additional citations and expanded sections
summary: Facial image retrieval in unconstrained surveillance environments is a high-stakes challenge where missing a subject of interest -- a single false negative -- is simply not an option. Despite near-perfect performance on curated benchmarks, current recognition systems falter under real-world domain shifts such as low resolution, motion blur, and uncontrolled illumination (e.g., SCFace). Addressing this reliability gap, we propose Risk-Aware Facial Retrieval (RA-FR), a framework that moves beyond fixed Top-$k$ retrieval to adaptive set generation, guaranteeing ground truth inclusion within a user-specified risk level ($α$) and confidence level ($1 - δ$). Our approach integrates three core contributions: (1) reducing aleatoric uncertainty via a hybrid blind face restoration technique coupling Latent Consistency Models (InterLCM) and DiffBIR; (2) extracting discriminative, restoration-robust features via self-supervised DINOv1 ViT-B with GGeM pooling; and (3) employing conformal prediction with Hoeffding's inequality to dynamically calibrate retrieval set sizes based on query uncertainty. On the IMFDB benchmark, it consistently satisfies a 5% risk target with an average retrieval set size of approximately 10 images. By unifying domain-specific restoration, robust representation learning, and provable decision rules, RA-FR offers a pipeline that makes facial retrieval in surveillance both reliable and auditable. The code is available at: https://github.com/MuhammadEmmadSiddiqui/RA-FR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出风险感知人脸检索框架(RA-FR)，通过结合盲脸修复、鲁棒特征学习和保形预测，在监控场景下实现可保证风险水平的自适应检索集生成。
AI.motivation: 现有的人脸识别系统在真实监控环境（低分辨率、运动模糊、光照变化等域偏移）下性能急剧下降，且固定Top-k检索无法保证召回目标，漏检（假阴性）风险不可控。
AI.method: (1) 混合盲脸修复（InterLCM + DiffBIR）降低偶然不确定性；(2) 自监督DINOv1 ViT-B + GGeM池化提取判别性特征；(3) 基于Hoeffding不等式的保形预测动态校准检索集大小。
AI.result: 在IMFDB基准上，RA-FR在5%风险目标下达到一致满足，平均检索集大小约10张图像。
AI.conclusion: 统一了领域特化修复、鲁棒表示学习和可证明的决策规则，使监控人脸检索既可靠又可审计。

title: Democratizing AI with Small Language Models: Structured Benchmarking and Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for Local Deployment
summary: AI democratization is not primarily a question of matching frontier-scale generality; it is a question of whether capable models can be selected, audited, and specialized under hardware and governance constraints that ordinary institutions can actually satisfy. This paper studies that problem through a controlled evaluation of nine open-weight language models between 135M and 3B parameters on a 1,085-example, 16-topic multiple-choice benchmark designed for structured local deployment. The benchmark emphasizes symbolic precision, constrained formatting, extraction, and short-horizon semantic decision making under a strict one-letter output protocol. A shared parameter-efficient fine-tuning pipeline then adapts a subset of models using 4-bit NF4 quantization with DoRA/LoRA-style adapters on an NVIDIA L4-class budget. In base evaluation, Qwen Coder 3B leads at 75.67% strict accuracy, followed by Qwen2.5 1.5B at 67.10%, Qwen3.5 2B at 64.98%, and Granite 3.3 2B at 64.61%. On the shared 108-example held-out fine-tuning split, adaptation improves Qwen Coder 3B by +26.85 points, SmolLM2 1.7B by +25.92, Qwen2.5 1.5B by +19.44, SmolLM2 360M by +10.18, and SmolLM2 135M by +5.55. Across ranking, topic-level heterogeneity, difficulty strata, failure composition, efficiency frontiers, and topic-conditioned transfer, the same conclusion recurs: a disciplined workflow of benchmark construction, cross-model evaluation, and low-cost specialization already makes a subset of sub-3B models viable as local experts for structured niche workloads.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建一个1085例、16主题的多选题基准，评估了9个135M到3B参数的开源语言模型，发现通过参数高效微调（4-bit NF4量化+DoRA/LoRA），部分3B以下模型可在结构化本地部署场景中达到实用水平。Qwen Coder 3B在基础评估中准确率75.67%，微调后提升26.85个百分点。
AI.motivation: AI民主化的关键不在于追求前沿规模的通用性，而在于普通机构能否在硬件和治理约束下选择、审计和专业化部署有能力的模型。本文旨在验证小模型在结构化本地部署场景中的可行性。
AI.method: 构建16主题1085例的多选题基准（强调符号精度、格式化约束、单字母输出协议），对9个135M-3B参数的开源模型进行基础评估；使用4-bit NF4量化+DoRA/LoRA适配器在NVIDIA L4级预算上进行参数高效微调。
AI.result: 基础评估中Qwen Coder 3B以75.67%准确率领先；微调后Qwen Coder 3B提升+26.85点，SmolLM2 1.7B提升+25.92点，Qwen2.5 1.5B提升+19.44点。所有评估维度均表明3B以下模型可通过系统化流程成为结构化本地专家。
AI.conclusion: 通过规范的基准构建、跨模型评估和低成本专业化流程，部分3B以下模型已可作为结构化小众负载的本地专家部署，这为实现AI民主化提供了可行路径。

title: NOWJ@COLIEE 2026: Adaptive Pipelines for Legal Retrieval and Reasoning
summary: This paper presents the methodologies and results of the NOWJ team's participation across all five tasks of the COLIEE 2026 competition. For Task 1 (Legal Case Retrieval), we propose a four-stage pipeline comprising candidate filtering, dense retrieval with complementary embedding models, cross-encoder reranking via fine-tuned generative rerankers and MLP-based pairwise classification, and adaptive per-query cutoff prediction. For Task 2 (Legal Case Entailment), we combine BM25 filtering, T5-based reranking, and LLM-based entailment verification with consensus ensemble. For Task 3 (Statute Law Retrieval and Entailment), we adopt a retrieval-augmented generation framework with dense retrieval, attention-based reranking, and few-shot-prompted LLM reasoning. For Task 4 (Legal Textual Entailment), we introduce a dynamic routing pipeline that classifies query difficulty and dispatches cases to either a balanced few-shot solver or a structured zero-shot chain-of-thought solver. For the Pilot Task (Legal Judgment Prediction), we combine hierarchical transformers with CRF layers, argument relation mining, and probabilistic argumentation graph reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了NOWJ团队在COLIEE 2026竞赛全部五项任务中的方法：法律案例检索采用四阶段流水线，法律案例蕴含结合BM25过滤和T5重排序，成文法检索与蕴含使用RAG框架，法律文本蕴含通过动态路由分类查询难度，法律判决预测融合层次Transformer和CRF层。
AI.motivation: 为了解决COLIEE 2026竞赛中五项法律信息处理任务（案例检索、案例蕴含、成文法检索与蕴含、文本蕴含、判决预测）的挑战，提出针对性的解决方案。
AI.method: Task1：四阶段流水线（候选过滤→互补密集检索→交叉编码器重排序→自适应截止预测）；Task2：BM25过滤+T5重排序+LLM蕴含验证+共识集成；Task3：RAG框架+密集检索+注意力重排序+少样本提示LLM推理；Task4：动态路由（查询难度分类→平衡少样本求解器或零样本CoT求解器）；Pilot Task：层次Transformer+CRF层+论点关系挖掘+概率论证图推理。
AI.result: 论文展示了NOWJ团队在COLIEE 2026全部五项任务中的方法论和实验结果。
AI.conclusion: NOWJ团队针对不同法律任务设计了差异化的流水线方法，涵盖了从密集检索、重排序到LLM推理和论证图推理等多种技术。

title: 3D FaceShell: Attribute Transfer in 3D Face Avatars as a VLM Defense Mechanism
summary: Photorealistic 3D face avatars are increasingly deployed as reusable digital assets across applications such as telepresence, animation, and personalized media. At the same time, vision-language models (VLMs) can infer sensitive attributes from rendered images with open-ended semantic reasoning without any fine-tuning. This creates a new privacy challenge: once a 3D face avatar is shared, any of its renderings can be analyzed to extract high-level facial attributes. Existing defenses largely operate in 2D image space and do not address identity-preserving semantic manipulation of 3D facial representations. We propose 3D FaceShell, a framework for steering VLM interpretations of faces rendered from 3D models while preserving geometric fidelity and facial identity. 3D FaceShell augments the original 3D representation with a learnable Gaussian shell that produces subtle, spatially distributed perturbations optimized through multi-view embedding alignment. The perturbations are designed to be visually inconspicuous yet sufficient to redirect VLM-based attribute inference in a view-consistent manner. Extensive experiments on reconstructed celebrity face avatars and multiple black-box VLMs demonstrate that 3D FaceShell significantly increases attribute injection and mismatch rates while maintaining high perceptual similarity and identity consistency. Our results show that it is possible to manipulate VLM-level semantic interpretation of 3D faces without compromising their human-recognizable appearance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出3D FaceShell框架，通过可学习高斯壳层为3D人脸模型添加细微但视图一致的扰动，在不影响几何保真度和人脸身份的前提下，有效干扰视觉语言模型对敏感属性的推理。
AI.motivation: 现有防御主要针对2D图像空间，无法解决3D人脸表示中保持身份不变的语义操控问题。一旦3D人脸模型被共享，其任意渲染图像都可能被VLM分析提取敏感属性，存在隐私泄露风险。
AI.method: 在原始3D表示上增加一个可学习的高斯壳层，通过多视图嵌入对齐优化产生细微、空间分布的扰动。这些扰动视觉上不明显，但能一致地在多个视角下误导VLM的属性推断。
AI.result: 在重建的名人人脸模型和多种黑盒VLM上实验，3D FaceShell显著提高了属性注入率和错配率，同时保持了高感知相似度和身份一致性。
AI.conclusion: 证明可以在不损害人类可识别外观的前提下，操控3D人脸在VLM层面的语义解读，为人脸隐私保护提供了新的技术路径。

title: Masked Diffusion Language Models are Strong and Steerable Text-Based World Models for Agentic RL
summary: Recent growth in reinforcement learning (RL) has surfaced a need for diverse, specialized training environments. Hand-curated environments with fixed task and reward difficulties become ineffective signals as model performance improves, and sparse rewards over long horizons induce mode collapse on specific workflows or tool structures. World models that simulate environment states have matched pure rollout performance, making them promising for scaling diversity on-demand. However, autoregressive (AR) world models suffer from a left-to-right bias preventing conditioning on globally interdependent state anchors such as tool schemas, prior turns, and expected outcomes. We (i) formalize text-based world modeling as a steerable transition-dynamics problem decomposed into initial state, task context, tool schemas, domain rules, and steering directives, and (ii) curate 239,403 grounded state-action trajectories spanning nine open-source environments and twelve frontier model families. We compare AR LMs and masked diffusion language models (MDLMs), showing MDLMs, via bidirectional anchor-aware denoising, achieve better coherence, groundedness, and empirically validated rollout diversity than LLMs over 4x their parameter size, at comparable inference latency. We introduce a plug-and-play GRPO training framework with deterministic state checks, and perform zero-shot transfer ablations on three OOD environments (ScienceWorld, ALFWorld, AppWorld) across three 1.2B-7B agent backbones (LFM2.5, Qwen3, Mistral), achieving up to 47% absolute gains over baselines without environment-specific fine-tuning. We further conduct behavioral analysis of failure modes under adversarial scenarios and human evaluation on realism, outcome correctness, and training utility. We open-source our work to encourage research in this direction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于掩码扩散语言模型（MDLM）的可控文本世界模型，替代传统自回归模型，通过双向锚点感知去噪实现更好的连贯性、接地性和轨迹多样性，在多个环境中显著提升了零样本迁移效果。
AI.motivation: 强化学习亟需多样化的训练环境，但手工环境随模型性能提升信号失效，稀疏奖励导致模式坍缩；自回归世界模型存在从左到右的偏置，无法对全局依赖的状态锚点（如工具模式、历史轮次、预期结果）进行条件控制。
AI.method: (i) 形式化文本世界模型为可控制的转移动力学问题，分解为初始状态、任务上下文、工具模式、领域规则和指导指令；(ii) 构建239,403条状态-动作轨迹数据集，覆盖9个环境和12种模型家族；(iii) 比较自回归LM与掩码扩散语言模型（MDLM），MDLM通过双向锚点感知去噪实现更好性能；(iv) 引入即插即用的GRPO训练框架和确定性状态检查；(v) 在三个OOD环境（ScienceWorld, ALFWorld, AppWorld）上进行零样本迁移消融实验。
AI.result: MDLM在连贯性、接地性和轨迹多样性上优于参数规模大4倍的自回归模型，推理延迟相当；在三个OOD环境中，基于三种1.2B-7B骨干模型（LFM2.5, Qwen3, Mistral）实现最高47%的绝对性能提升，无需环境特定微调。
AI.conclusion: 掩码扩散语言模型是构建可控、多样化、可迁移文本世界模型的有效方法，开源工作有助于推动该方向研究。

title: From Memory to Skills: Evidence-Grounded Co-Evolution Governance for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
summary: Existing memory systems for long-horizon LLM agents often retrieve prior traces as passive context rather than converting them into executable capabilities. In this paper, we propose MSCE, a training-free Memory--Skill Co-Evolution framework that organizes agent experience into grounded step traces, reusable procedural policies, and declarative environmental cognition. MSCE crystallizes evidence-backed L2 policies with positive estimated gain into callable skills that retain evidence links, applicability boundaries, decision guidance, verification rules, and reliability estimates. It further introduces reflection-weighted value backfilling, which propagates sparse terminal feedback through dense local self-reflections to produce evidence-calibrated trace values for governing memory and skill evolution. Experiments on EvoAgentBench and LoCoMo demonstrate that MSCE significantly outperforms state-of-the-art skill-augmented and memory-driven agent baselines, exhibiting strong cross-domain transferability and lifelong-evolution capabilities.

AI.tldr: MSCE提出了一种无需训练的记忆-技能协同进化框架，将智能体经验组织为步骤轨迹、可复用策略和声明性环境认知，通过证据支持的L2策略和反思加权值回填实现技能进化，在长时域任务中显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有长时域LLM智能体的记忆系统通常将历史轨迹作为被动上下文检索，而非将其转化为可执行的能力，限制了智能体在长期任务中的适应性和进化能力。
AI.method: 提出MSCE框架：(1) 将智能体经验组织为三种形式：步骤轨迹、可复用的程序化策略和声明性环境认知；(2) 将证据支持的L2策略（具有正估计收益）结晶为可调用技能，保留证据链接、适用边界、决策指导、验证规则和可靠性估计；(3) 引入反思加权值回填，通过局部自我反思传播稀疏的终端反馈，生成证据校准的轨迹值来管理记忆和技能进化。
AI.result: 在EvoAgentBench和LoCoMo基准上，MSCE显著优于最先进的技能增强和记忆驱动智能体基线方法，展现出强大的跨领域迁移性和终身进化能力。
AI.conclusion: MSCE通过记忆与技能的协同进化机制，有效将被动经验转化为主动能力，为长时域LLM智能体的持续学习提供了有效方案。

title: Moving Like a Human: Ego-Motion-Normalized Temporal Signatures for Real-Time Aerial Person Tracking on Milliwatt-Class Hardware
summary: Follow-me person tracking must run on the drone itself, where affordable companion computers offer only a few effective int8 GFLOP/s. At typical follow distances a person spans 10-60 pixels, indistinguishable from clutter and beyond the reach of single-frame appearance detectors. The missing evidence is temporal and belongs in the input representation, computed analytically, rather than in learned temporal machinery. EMTS-Det is a five-stage system that estimates ego-motion, converts each frame into ego-motion-normalized residual-motion channels, detects person centers with a 22k-parameter, 7.6-MFLOP network, tracks a locked target with a Kalman filter in stabilized coordinates, and verifies tracks with a 1-D convolutional classifier of human motion (ROC AUC 0.941). Training uses a synthetic-motion curriculum with motion channels generated by the deployed ego-motion code. Multi-seed ablations locate the value in generalization: on held-out VisDrone-DET a luminance-only variant collapses to 0.051 AP25 versus 0.415, as does YOLOv8n fine-tuned identically despite 1,100 times the compute, while the deployed int8 detector reaches 0.694 AP25 in-domain and 0.444 on this split. Temporal-shift modules lower accuracy, so the deployed detector is stateless. Silent int8 calibration failures are documented; min-max calibration with propagated caches matches float within 0.008 AP. On a Raspberry Pi Zero 2W the pipeline runs at 31.85 FPS with 0.462 AP25 and 0.714 recall over 1,000 real-world UAV videos, versus 1.95 FPS and 0.172 AP25 for YOLOv8n. A 57-second field sequence shows auto-lock at 1.3 s, 97.9% lock recall, and recovery from all nine occlusions with zero false re-locks.

AI.tldr: 提出EMTS-Det，一种超轻量级无人机跟随人物检测系统，在Raspberry Pi Zero 2W上以31.85 FPS运行，AP25达0.462，比YOLOv8n快16倍且精度提升显著。
AI.motivation: 无人机上廉价计算平台的算力有限（仅几int8 GFLOP/s），且远距离下目标仅10-60像素，单帧外观检测器无法区分干扰，亟需利用时域信息但避免依赖学习型时域模块。
AI.method: 五阶段系统：1）估计自运动；2）生成自运动归一化残差运动通道；3）22k参数/7.6 MFLOP的轻量网络检测人物中心；4）在稳定坐标系中用卡尔曼滤波锁定跟踪目标；5）使用1D卷积分类器验证人类运动轨迹。训练采用合成运动课程，部署时使用相同的自运动代码生成运动通道。
AI.result: In-domain AP25达0.694，VisDrone-DET上0.444 AP25；Raspberry Pi Zero 2W上31.85 FPS/0.462 AP25，对比YOLOv8n的1.95 FPS/0.172 AP25；野外序列中1.3秒自动锁定，97.9%锁定召回率，9次遮挡全部恢复且零误重新锁定。
AI.conclusion: 将时域证据显式编码到输入表示中优于在模型结构中隐式学习时域信息，超轻量设计可在极端受限硬件上实现实时高性能的无人机跟随检测。

title: It Takes 8 Tokens: Weak-to-Strong Off-Policy RL via Auxiliary Branches
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has emerged as a standard approach for enhancing reasoning in large language models, which typically optimizes the policy by contrasting multiple self generated rollouts. However, we identify a critical support limited bottleneck in this paradigm: on challenging reasoning tasks, the target model's samples often exhibit semantic redundancy, converging into the same erroneous "reasoning basins" that offer negligible reward contrast for policy updates. In this paper, we propose to overcome this limitation through a weak to strong learning paradigm, where a policy's exploration is informed by a weaker but computationally efficient auxiliary model. We introduce W2SPO, an off policy RL method that injects short auxiliary segments often as brief as 8 tokens into intermediate target model trajectories and the target model then completes the reasoning path from these diverted states. Policy updates are restricted to these short inserted segments based on final verifiable rewards. Empirically, W2SPO achieves superior performance among evaluated 4B scale models on mathematical reasoning benchmarks, outperforming evaluated post trained baselines. Compared with vanilla GRPO under the same sampling budget, W2SPO improves Pass@1 from 62.3% to 64.2% while achieving a 3.55 times training speedup. These results suggest that weak auxiliary branches can induce stronger target reasoning policies by expanding local exploration support.

AI.tldr: 本文提出W2SPO方法，通过弱辅助模型注入短token片段来扩展推理探索空间，在4B模型上数学推理Pass@1达64.2%，训练速度提升3.55倍。
AI.motivation: 现有RL+可验证奖励方法存在"支持瓶颈"：目标模型在复杂推理任务中产生语义冗余样本，陷入相同错误"推理盆地"，导致奖励对比不足，难以有效更新策略。
AI.method: 提出W2SPO离线策略RL方法：利用计算高效的弱辅助模型向中间轨迹注入短片段（低至8个token），目标模型从这些分流状态继续完成推理。策略更新仅基于最终可验证奖励限定于短插入片段。
AI.result: 在4B规模模型数学推理基准上优于所有后训练基线；相比GRPO，Pass@1从62.3%提升至64.2%，训练速度提升3.55倍。
AI.conclusion: 弱辅助分支通过扩展局部探索支持，可以有效诱导更强的目标推理策略。

title: OpenLanguageModel: Readable and Composable Small-Language-Model Pretraining for Education and Research
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, and 1 table. Website: https://openlanguagemodel.github.io/openlanguagemodel/. Code: https://github.com/openlanguagemodel/openlanguagemodel
summary: OpenLanguageModel (OLM) is an open-source PyTorch library for building and pretraining small language models while keeping their machinery visible. In OLM, model code reads like the architecture: components are ordinary modules, while Block, Residual, Repeat, and Parallel describe how they are wired. The resulting model can move unchanged from a teaching notebook to a complete pretraining run or a research ablation. OLM connects this readable model layer to tokenizers, local and streaming datasets, optimization, mixed precision, callbacks, checkpoints, and hardware-aware CPU, single-GPU, and single-node multi-GPU execution. We demonstrate the full path by tracing GPT-2 from diagram to code, launching a FineWeb-Edu training script, replacing one attention component, and letting AutoTrainer configure the available machine. The package includes 27 presets across nine familiar model families and documentation that progresses from LM fundamentals to architecture research. Validation shows close agreement with independent reference implementations, 90.6% four-GPU weak-scaling efficiency for a 348M-parameter workload, compact architecture edits, and positive early usability results. OLM is MIT-licensed and available through PyPI, GitHub, and its documentation site.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个名为OpenLanguageModel (OLM)的开源PyTorch库，用于构建和预训练小型语言模型，强调代码可读性、架构透明度，并提供了从教学到完整训练的全流程支持。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型库在代码可读性和架构透明度方面不足，模型代码难以直观反映其架构设计，不利于教学、研究和消融实验。
AI.method: OLM通过将模型组件设计为普通模块，并使用Block、Residual、Repeat、Parallel等结构描述组件连接方式，使代码与架构图示一一对应。库集成了分词器、数据集、优化、混合精度、回调、检查点以及多硬件执行支持，并包含AutoTrainer自动配置功能。
AI.result: 验证显示与独立参考实现高度一致，348M参数模型在四GPU上弱缩放效率达90.6%，架构编辑紧凑，早期可用性测试结果积极。库包含27个预置模型配置，涵盖9种常见模型家族。
AI.conclusion: OLM是一个开源、MIT许可的库，可在PyPI和GitHub获取，能够有效支持语言模型教学、研究、预训练和消融实验，兼具可读性与实用性。

title: GenSyn10: A Multi-Generative AI Dataset For Benchmarking Image Classification
summary: The rapid advancement of generative AI has outpaced our ability to reliably detect its outputs, particularly when detectors encounter generators they have not seen before. We introduce GenSyn10, a CIFAR-10-aligned synthetic image dataset of 60,000 images (10 classes, 32$\times$32, 50k/10k split) generated using three architecturally diverse state-of-the-art models: FLUX.2-dev (Rectified Flow Transformer), HunyuanImage-3.0 (MoE Transformer), and Qwen-Image-2512 (Multimodal Diffusion Transformer), to advance research in AI-generated image detection. A central challenge in this domain is that detectors perform well on known generators but degrade on unseen ones. GenSyn10 addresses this limitation by curating data from multiple contemporary architectures under a standardized generation protocol, enabling controlled and systematic evaluation of out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization to novel generators. Images are generated using a template-based prompt engine and downsampled to ensure consistency. We evaluate 17 image classification models under a four-stage protocol: real-data baseline, zero-shot transfer, fine-tuning, and retention. Despite a measurable domain gap, CIFAR-10-trained models achieve up to 96.86\% zero-shot accuracy on GenSyn10, increasing to 99.88\% after fine-tuning. In binary real-vs-synthetic classification, fine-tuned models achieve 97-99.9\% accuracy on seen generators but drop to 79-96\% on images from an unseen generator, highlighting persistent limitations in OOD generalization. These results establish GenSyn10 as a controlled benchmark for studying synthetic image detection beyond single-generator settings, supporting research on robustness, domain adaptation, and cross-generator generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍GenSyn10数据集，包含3种不同架构生成模型产生的6万张CIFAR-10风格合成图像，用于评估和提升AI生成图像检测器对未见生成器的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 当前AI生成图像检测器在面对未见过的生成器时性能严重下降，缺乏一个包含多种当代架构生成图像的标准化基准数据集来系统研究跨生成器泛化问题。
AI.method: 构建GenSyn10数据集（6万张32×32图像，10类，50k/10k划分），使用FLUX.2-dev、HunyuanImage-3.0、Qwen-Image-2512三种架构各异的模型生成；采用模板提示引擎和降采样确保一致性；在17个分类模型上进行四阶段评估（真实数据基线、零样本迁移、微调、保留测试）。
AI.result: CIFAR-10预训练模型在GenSyn10上零样本准确率达96.86%，微调后达99.88%；二元真实vs合成分类中，微调模型在未见生成器上准确率从97-99.9%降至79-96%。
AI.conclusion: GenSyn10可作为研究合成图像检测鲁棒性、域适应和跨生成器泛化的标准化基准，揭示了当前检测器在OOD泛化上的根本局限。

title: PPO-HSC: An Exploratory Reinforcement Learning Framework Based on Wide-Area Policy Coverage Optimization
summary: This paper introduces PPO-HSC (Proximal Policy Optimization with High-order Sampling Coverage), an exploratory reinforcement learning framework designed to address the "Invisible Shackles" of mode collapse in Large Language Model (LLM) fine-tuning. While standard Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) effectively reinforces high-reward trajectories, it often leads models to over-optimize known solutions, sacrificing curiosity and the ability to explore broader solution manifolds. To overcome this, PPO-HSC incorporates a High-order Sampling Coverage (HSC) reward that incentivizes the discovery of "low-similarity yet high-validity" reasoning patterns. By maintaining a dynamic trajectory library of verified unique solutions, the framework provides a differentiable signal that rewards semantic novelty while ensuring structural rationality through a plausibility constraint. Empirical evaluations on mathematical reasoning (GSM8K, SVAMP) and code generation tasks demonstrate that PPO-HSC significantly enhances solution diversity and state-space coverage while maintaining or surpassing the accuracy and syntax integrity of state-of-the-art RL baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PPO-HSC框架，通过高次采样覆盖奖励机制激励LLM发现低相似度但高有效性的推理模式，解决微调中的模式坍塌问题，在数学推理和代码生成任务上提升了解决方案多样性和状态空间覆盖率。
AI.motivation: 标准RLVR在LLM微调中会过度优化已知的高奖励轨迹，导致模型陷入"隐形枷锁"——模式坍塌，牺牲探索更广阔解空间的能力。
AI.method: PPO-HSC引入高次采样覆盖奖励，维护动态轨迹库存储已验证的独特解，通过可微信号奖励语义新颖性，同时利用合理性约束确保结构正确性。
AI.result: 在GSM8K、SVAMP数学推理和代码生成任务上，PPO-HSC显著提升了解决方案多样性和状态空间覆盖率，同时保持或超越了现有RL基线的准确率和语法完整性。
AI.conclusion: PPO-HSC有效缓解了LLM微调中的模式坍塌问题，实现了探索与利用的更好平衡，为LLM的强化学习微调提供了新范式。

title: SpecLA: Efficient Speculative Decoding for Linear-Attention Models
summary: Linear-attention models replace the growing KV cache with recurrent states, but autoregressive decoding still reads, updates, and writes these states one token at a time. Speculative decoding can reduce this cost by verifying several draft tokens in one target pass, yet existing speculative systems are designed for Transformer KV caches. For stateful linear-attention targets, verification must follow recurrent dependencies across chains and branches, acceptance must update only the accepted state trajectory, and the drafter must avoid submitting candidates that waste stateful verification work. This paper presents SpecLA, a speculative decoding runtime for stateful linear-attention models. SpecLA verifies chains and trees with topology-aware kernels, stores compact factors produced during verification to recover accepted states, and uses confidence pruning plus a target-aligned EAGLE-style drafter to feed useful candidates to the verifier. On an NVIDIA H100 with a public GDN-1.3B target, SpecLA achieves up to 1.70x end-to-end speedup over autoregressive decoding.

AI.tldr: SpecLA是一个针对有状态线性注意力模型的推测解码运行时，通过拓扑感知验证、状态恢复和信心剪枝等技术，在NVIDIA H100上实现高达1.70倍端到端加速。
AI.motivation: 线性注意力模型用循环状态替代了不断增长的KV缓存，但自回归解码仍逐token处理，效率有限。现有推测解码系统是为Transformer设计的，无法直接处理线性注意力模型中的循环依赖和状态更新问题。
AI.method: 1) 拓扑感知的核函数验证链和树结构；2) 存储验证过程中产生的紧凑因子以恢复已接受状态；3) 信心剪枝剔除低效候选；4) 目标对齐的EAGLE风格起草器生成有用候选。
AI.result: 在NVIDIA H100上，以GDN-1.3B为目标模型，SpecLA相比自回归解码实现了最高1.70倍的端到端加速。
AI.conclusion: SpecLA有效解决了线性注意力模型在推测解码中的状态依赖和验证效率问题，为这类模型提供了实用的加速方案。

title: MAC 2026: Advancing Micro-Action Analysis Towards Fine-Grained Understanding
comment: Challenge Summary Paper of the 3rd Micro-Action Analysis Grand Challenge (MAC 2026) at ACM Multimedia 2026
summary: Micro-Actions (MAs) are subtle and spontaneous human behaviors that provide important non-verbal cues in social interaction and affective communication. However, their short duration, weak motion patterns, and fine-grained semantic differences make them difficult to annotate, model, and evaluate in a standardized manner. To promote academic research on micro-action analysis, we proposed and have annually organized the Micro-Action Analysis Grand Challenge (MAC) as a public benchmark platform for this emerging field. The first two editions of MAC established standardized evaluation settings for micro-action recognition and detection, providing publicly accessible datasets and protocols. Building upon these editions, this paper presents the 3rd MAC, held in conjunction with ACM Multimedia 2026. Under the theme of moving from recognition to fine-grained micro-action understanding, this edition further expands the scope of the challenge beyond conventional recognition and detection. In particular, we introduce a new task named fine-grained micro-action understanding, evaluated with the assistance of multimodal large language models, aiming to assess models' ability to capture fine-grained semantic cues and interpret subtle human micro-actions at a deeper level. We summarize the datasets, task settings, evaluation protocols, competition results, and representative solutions from top-performing teams. Finally, we discuss future directions for micro-action analysis and its broader role in human-centric video understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了第三届微动作分析大挑战（MAC 2026），该挑战在ACM Multimedia 2026上举办，主题从识别转向细粒度微动作理解，并引入了一个基于多模态大语言模型的新任务，旨在评估模型捕捉细微语义线索和深度解读人类微动作的能力。
AI.motivation: 微动作作为社交互动和情感交流中重要的非语言线索，由于其持续时间短、运动模式弱、语义差异细微，导致标准化标注、建模和评估困难。为了推动该领域的研究，作者持续组织MAC挑战赛，并不断拓展研究范围。
AI.method: 第三届MAC在延续前两届识别与检测任务的基础上，新增了“细粒度微动作理解”任务，借助多模态大语言模型进行评估，以测试模型对细微语义线索的捕捉能力和对人类微动作的深层理解能力。
AI.result: 总结了数据集、任务设置、评估协议、竞赛结果以及来自顶尖团队的代表性解决方案。
AI.conclusion: 讨论了微动作分析的未来发展方向及其在人本视频理解中的更广泛作用。

title: JUMP: Single-Pass Membership Inference on Fine-Tuned Diffusion Language Models
summary: Membership inference attacks (MIAs) test whether a candidate example appeared in a model's training data. We study MIAs for fine-tuned discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs), where membership means inclusion in the target model's fine-tuning set. Unlike autoregressive language models, dLLMs allow an attacker to choose arbitrary mask sets and obtain token distributions for all masked positions in parallel. The prior dLLM attack, SAMA, follows a natural loss-mimicking strategy by averaging reconstruction signals over many randomly sampled masks, but it uses the any-order interface only as randomization and requires many target/reference queries. We propose JUMP (Joint Uncertainty-Guided Mask Probing), a single-pass scoring attack that exploits both distinctive properties of dLLMs: any-order decodability is used to select low-reference-confidence positions, and parallel decodability is used to score all selected positions through one joint masked query per model. JUMP masks the selected positions jointly and computes a clipped target/reference reconstruction-gap statistic. On fine-tuned LLaDA-8B-Base across six MIMIR domains, JUMP improves mean ROC-AUC from 0.82 to 0.90 over SAMA and substantially improves low-FPR detection, while requiring only one selector pass and one scoring pass through each of the target and reference models.

AI.tldr: 提出JUMP方法，利用离散扩散语言模型的任意顺序解码和并行解码特性，通过单次联合掩码查询实现高效成员推断攻击，在LLaDA-8B-Base模型上将ROC-AUC从0.82提升至0.90。
AI.motivation: 现有针对离散扩散语言模型的成员推断攻击SAMA仅将任意顺序接口作为随机化手段，需要大量目标/参考模型查询，未能充分利用dLLM的独特解码特性。
AI.method: JUMP方法包含两步：(1) 利用任意顺序解码能力选择低参考置信度的掩码位置；(2) 利用并行解码能力，通过一次联合掩码查询同时计算所有选定位置的剪切目标/参考重建差距统计量。
AI.result: 在六个MIMIR领域微调的LLaDA-8B-Base模型上，JUMP将平均ROC-AUC从0.82提升至0.90，并在低假正例率检测上显著优于SAMA。
AI.conclusion: JUMP通过有效利用dLLM的任意顺序和并行解码特性，实现了更高效、更准确的单次成员推断攻击，验证了挖掘模型架构特性对攻击性能提升的重要性。

title: Are Arithmetic Heuristic Neurons Form-Invariant? A Mechanistic Analysis of Symbols, Text, and Code in LLMs
summary: Large language models often succeed on one formulation of a problem while failing on an equivalent formulation. Whether these failures arise from distinct internal circuits or different activation states of a shared circuit remains unknown. Recent mechanistic interpretability studies suggest that arithmetic in LLMs emerges from a "bag of heuristics," encoded by a sparse set of MLP neurons that represent distinct arithmetic strategies. We investigate whether arithmetic heuristic neurons are form-invariant across symbolic arithmetic, natural language word problems, and Python code in three Llama-3 models. In each format, we identify arithmetic heuristic neurons using a two-stage pipeline combining attribution patching and activation patching. A compact set of neurons is shared across all three formats, and targeted interventions show this shared circuit is both necessary and sufficient for late-layer arithmetic computation. Transferring the shared neurons' activations from a successful execution in one format to a failed execution in another recovers most incorrect predictions, exceeding 97% for addition and subtraction, indicating that cross-format failures arise from activation states rather than distinct circuits. Moreover, shared neurons consistently belong to the same heuristic families across formats, demonstrating that arithmetic computation in LLMs is largely form-invariant at the neuron level.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大型语言模型中算术计算是否具有形式不变性。通过识别Llama-3模型中跨符号算术、自然语言应用题和Python代码三种格式共享的算术启发式神经元，发现格式间的计算失败源于共享神经元的激活状态差异，而非不同电路。跨格式转移共享神经元激活可恢复超过97%的错误预测。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在等价问题的不同表述上常表现不一致，但这种现象背后的原因（不同内部电路还是共享电路的不同激活状态）尚不清楚，因此需要探究算术计算是否具有形式不变性。
AI.method: 使用结合归因修补和激活修补的两阶段流水线，在Llama-3模型中识别符号算术、自然语言应用题和Python代码三种格式下的算术启发式神经元，并通过跨格式激活转移实验验证共享电路的必要性和充分性。
AI.result: 发现三种格式间存在一组紧凑的共享神经元，跨格式转移这些神经元的激活可恢复97%以上的错误预测（加法和减法），表明失败源于激活状态而非不同电路。
AI.conclusion: LLMs中的算术计算在神经元层面具有形式不变性，共享神经元在不同格式中属于相同的启发式家族，表明算术计算依赖一个共享的核心电路而非格式特定的独立电路。

title: A Shared Latent for Partially-Labeled Multi-Task Facial Affect Recognition
summary: Facial affect in the wild is naturally multi-task: valence-arousal, discrete expressions, and facial action units describe the same face. Yet real corpora annotate these tasks only partially and unevenly, so most systems mask the missing labels or impute pseudo-labels and forgo the cross-task signal. We instead cast partially-labeled multi-task learning as marginalization over a shared affect latent: one variational bottleneck mediates all three task decoders, so a frame annotated for one task shapes the representation the others use, and the masked objective reappears as the reconstruction term of an evidence lower bound. On s-Aff-Wild2, where only 37% of frames carry all three labels, the classes are severely imbalanced, and pretraining on the source data is disallowed, we isolate where this coupling acts. On a single backbone it lifts expression macro-F1 from 0.403 for a dedicated specialist to 0.446, which the masked-loss model does not reach; a second, near-peer backbone with decorrelated errors then breaks an action-unit ceiling that external action-unit data could not, while valence-arousal stays within noise. Every gain is disciplined by a matched-control negative; together these controls indicate that the rare-class failure is representational, not a matter of loss shaping. As each task's source is chosen on the evaluation split, we report the assembled result, a combined multi-task score of 1.679 on validation, as an in-sample endpoint and rest our conclusions on the controlled comparisons; a small, regime-dependent transfer of the expression advantage to AffectNet and RAF-DB is presented as exploratory rather than conclusive.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出将部分标注的多任务学习转化为基于共享情感潜变量的边缘化问题，通过变分瓶颈连接三个任务解码器，在s-Aff-Wild2数据集上提升了表情识别等任务的性能，并揭示了稀有类别失败是表征问题而非损失塑造问题。
AI.motivation: 真实世界中的面部情感数据天然是多任务的（效价-唤醒度、离散表情、面部动作单元），但实际语料库对这些任务的标注往往不完整且不均匀，现有方法大多直接掩码缺失标签或填充伪标签，忽略了跨任务之间的信号关联。
AI.method: 将部分标注的多任务学习形式化为对共享情感潜变量的边缘化，使用一个变分瓶颈连接三个任务解码器，使得仅标注了某一任务的帧也能塑造其他任务所使用的表征，同时掩码目标函数以证据下界（ELBO）的重建项形式出现。
AI.result: 在s-Aff-Wild2数据集上（仅37%帧有三标签、类别严重不平衡且不允许预训练），单骨干网络将表情macro-F1从0.403提升至0.446；第二个近同等骨干网络与去相关误差结合，突破了外部AU数据无法突破的动作单元上限；最终多任务综合得分在验证集上达到1.679。
AI.conclusion: 通过匹配负控制实验表明，稀有类别失败的本质是表征性问题而非损失函数塑造问题；在AffectNet和RAF-DB上的小规模迁移实验仅作为探索性结果，并非结论性证据。

title: ColGraphRAG: Late-Interaction Evidence Retrieval for Multimodal GraphRAG
summary: Graph-grounded multimodal question answering organizes text, tables, and images in a structured evidence graph, yet end-to-end accuracy depends on which multimodal assets are ranked highly enough to enter downstream reasoning; for graph-linked images, single-vector bi-encoder similarity can discard patch- and token-level structure needed for fine-grained alignment. We evaluate replacing the visual candidate-ranking operator over graph-linked image nodes with late-interaction MaxSim-style multi-vector scoring in the ColBERT/ColPali lineage, while keeping offline graph construction, text- and table-side retrieval, structured extraction, and downstream reasoning unchanged. On MultimodalQA, this change is associated with improved retrieval-stage point estimates for graph-linked image candidates and downstream QA gains, with larger movement where visual evidence matters most and mixed trends on text-dominant questions; we interpret the pattern as mechanism-level evidence for graph-linked visual evidence inclusion, while broader validation and finer graph-level diagnostics remain important future work.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了在多模态问答中，将图关联图像节点的视觉候选排序算子从单向量双编码器相似度替换为晚期交互多向量评分（MaxSim风格），可提升检索阶段图关联图像候选的准确率，并在视觉证据重要的问题上带来下游问答增益。
AI.motivation: 现有图基多模态问答中，图关联图像的端到端准确率受限于单向量双编码器相似度无法捕捉细粒度对齐的补丁级和令牌级结构信息。
AI.method: 保持离线图构建、文本/表格侧检索、结构化抽取和下游推理不变，仅将图关联图像节点的视觉候选排序算子替换为ColBERT/ColPali系列中的晚期交互MaxSim风格多向量评分。
AI.result: 在MultimodalQA数据集上，替换方法在检索阶段提升了图关联图像候选的点估计值，并在视觉证据重要的问题上取得下游问答增益，但在文本主导问题上呈现混合趋势。
AI.conclusion: 替换方法为图关联视觉证据的纳入提供了机制层面的证据，但更广泛的验证和更细粒度的图级诊断仍是重要的未来工作。

title: Though Language Models Err While They Strive: Conformal Prediction for Self-Correcting Scientific Generation
summary: Large language models frequently violate fundamental scientific principles when generating technical content, undermining their reliability in scientific applications. We introduce Scientific Feasibility Control SFC, a graph-structured conformal prediction framework that provides statistical guarantees for scientific reasoning validity through progressive absolute-coherent-factuality validation. Our approach decomposes scientific reasoning into atomic absolute-coherent-factuality units requiring both individual correctness against physical laws and logical substantiation from preceding context, addressing the cascade effect where early scientific errors contaminate subsequent reasoning steps. Unlike independence-based methods that treat claims in isolation, SFC models logical dependencies as approximate deducibility graphs and operates through real-time validation with dynamic branching when scientific violations are detected, the system branches to alternative generation paths using verified context as foundation. We demonstrate SFC across established scientific reasoning benchmarks including PhyX multimodal physics, MATH, ScienceQA, and ARC Challenge, achieving 50.1 percent accuracy on PhyX physics reasoning, substantially outperforming recent reasoning models including DeepSeek-R1 49.8 percent and GPT-4 45.8 percent while providing 91.7 percent scientific validity with formal conformal coverage guarantees at alpha equals 0.10 confidence level and reducing scientific law violations by 73 percent across multiple model architectures.

AI.tldr: 提出科学可行性控制(SFC)框架，通过图结构共形预测为科学推理提供统计保证，在多个基准测试中优于DeepSeek-R1和GPT-4，科学有效性达91.7%。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型生成技术内容时频繁违反基本科学原理，削弱了其在科学应用中的可靠性，现有独立式方法无法处理科学推理中的级联错误效应。
AI.method: 将科学推理分解为原子级绝对一致-事实性单元，建模逻辑依赖为近似可推导图，通过实时验证与动态分支机制，在检测到科学违规时切换到替代生成路径。
AI.result: 在PhyX物理推理上达到50.1%准确率，超过DeepSeek-R1(49.8%)和GPT-4(45.8%)；提供91.7%科学有效性（α=0.10置信水平），减少73%科学定律违反。
AI.conclusion: 图结构共形预测框架能有效为科学推理提供统计保证，显著提升LLM在科学应用中的可靠性。

title: Depth Estimators Are Implicit Neural Fields for 3D Scene Geometry Inpainting and Reconstruction
summary: The 3D geometry of real-world scene data is often incomplete. Mainstream methods use depth estimators to inpaint missing structure. However, their prediction results can be inconsistent with observed geometry, or unreliable on out-of-distribution data. To solve these problems, we propose Neural Depth Field (NDF). Our key insight is that a depth estimator can also be a scene-level implicit field. As an estimator, it adapts to the target domain by learning observed depth data. As an implicit field, it fits the existing geometry to maintain consistency. Under this view, NDF addresses both problems through a single test-time optimization. Experiments show that NDF produces high-fidelity and globally consistent geometry across diverse scene data, ranging from indoor scans to satellite imagery. It reduces cross-view inconsistency by 63.3\% and improves inpainting accuracy by 23.1\%, achieving state-of-the-art performance in 3D scene geometry inpainting. The code is available at: https://github.com/Shadow-Dream/Neural-Depth-Field.

AI.tldr: 提出神经深度场（NDF），将深度估计器同时视为场景级隐式场，通过单次测试时优化解决3D场景几何修复中的预测不一致和分布外数据不可靠问题，在室内扫描到卫星图像等多种场景中取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现实场景的3D几何数据往往不完整，现有深度估计方法进行修复时存在两个问题：预测结果与观测几何不一致，以及分布外数据上不可靠。
AI.method: 提出神经深度场（NDF），将深度估计器同时构建为场景级隐式场：作为估计器通过学习观测深度数据适应目标域；作为隐式场通过拟合现有几何保持一致性。通过单次测试时优化同时解决两个问题。
AI.result: 跨视角不一致性降低63.3%，修复精度提升23.1%，在室内扫描到卫星图像等多种场景下均达到最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: NDF通过统一的测试时优化框架，有效解决了3D场景几何修复中的一致性与泛化性问题，实现了高保真且全局一致的几何重建。

title: Shapley Context Pruning: A Cooperative Game Perspective for Context Reranking and Pruning
summary: Context reranking and pruning have become essential for improving the efficiency of modern Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, yet an interpretable and unified framework remains underexplored. Previous work has primarily emphasized lexical retrieval, cross-encoder architectures, model distillation, and Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), mostly relying on heuristic loss functions and empirical attribution. This paper presents Shapley Context Pruning (SCP), a novel framework for context reranking that establishes a cooperative-game-theory perspective for importance attribution by modeling the context as a cooperative game. Balancing the trade-off between fine-grained and coarse-grained representations, we employ a Deep Sets architecture to approximate a permutation-invariant value function at the sentence level, utilizing pre-trained language models as sentence embedders and optimizing via a pairwise margin ranking loss. To ensure practical scalability without sacrificing mathematical rigor, we leverage Monte-Carlo sampling for efficient training and inference, providing formal theoretical error bounds and sample complexity guarantees for preserving Top-K subset rankings. Furthermore, we conduct comprehensive experiments-spanning supporting-sentence recall, Needle-in-the-Haystack (NIAH) evaluations, long-context QA, and multi-hop reasoning-alongside rigorous ablation studies on embedding quality and attribution strategies. The model achieves competitive downstream QA performance against robust baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Shapley Context Pruning (SCP)框架，基于合作博弈论对RAG系统中的上下文进行重排序与剪枝，利用Deep Sets架构和蒙特卡洛采样实现高效且可解释的重要性归因，在多项长上下文任务中取得竞争性结果。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG系统中的上下文重排序和剪枝方法缺乏可解释且统一的框架，以往工作多依赖于启发式损失函数和经验归因，尚未有从合作博弈论角度系统建模上下文重要性的方案。
AI.method: 采用合作博弈论视角，将上下文建模为合作博弈；使用Deep Sets架构近似排列不变的价值函数，以句子级别进行重要性归因；利用预训练语言模型作为句子编码器，通过成对边际排序损失优化；引入蒙特卡洛采样实现高效训练和推理，并提供理论误差界和样本复杂度保证。
AI.result: 在支持句召回率、Needle-in-the-Haystack评估、长上下文问答和多跳推理等多项实验上取得竞争性下游QA性能。
AI.conclusion: SCP框架在保持数学严谨性的同时实现了实际可扩展性，为RAG系统提供了一种可解释的上下文剪枝新范式。

title: JOR-Bench: Japanese Operations Research Benchmarks for Large Language Models
summary: We present JOR-Bench, a collection of five Japanese-language benchmarks for evaluating the ability of large language models (LLMs) to formulate and solve operations research (OR) problems. Each benchmark is a Japanese translation of an existing English benchmark: IndustryOR, MAMO Complex LP, NL4OPT, OptiBench, and OptMATH, covering 1,319 problems spanning linear programming, mixed-integer programming, non-linear programming, and combinatorial optimization. JOR-Bench is a solver-independent benchmark that can be used with any solver or programming language, and consists of pairs of Japanese problem statements and expected numerical answers. We evaluate seven LLMs, including multilingual general-purpose models and Japanese-specialized models, on both the original English and the new Japanese versions, and compare performance across languages. For the main evaluation, we standardize execution with the Python interface to OR-Tools to make model outputs comparable and reproducible with open-source software. Our results show that OR formulation ability is largely language-neutral for strong multilingual models; the overall average accuracy difference between English and Japanese is only $-0.3$ pp. Yet error analysis reveals subtle cross-lingual differences, including a pragmatic disambiguation failure in some domains that causes models to output decision-variable values instead of the objective value when the prompt is in Japanese.

AI.tldr: JOR-Bench是一个包含1,319个日文运筹学问题的基准测试集，用于评估大语言模型用日语制定和求解OR问题的能力。实验表明，强大多语言模型的表现基本与语言无关（英日平均准确率仅差-0.3个百分点），但错误分析揭示了一些跨语言差异，例如日语提示下模型有时会输出决策变量值而非目标值。
AI.motivation: 目前缺乏针对日语的运筹学问题求解基准，无法系统评估LLM在日语环境下制定和求解OR问题的能力，也无法比较不同语言下的性能差异。
AI.method: 构建了五个日译英OR基准（JOR-Bench），涵盖1,319个问题；使用OR-Tools的Python接口标准化执行流程；评估7个LLM在英日两种语言版本上的表现。
AI.result: 强大多语言模型表现语言中性（英日准确率差仅-0.3 pp）；日语提示下存在语用歧义导致模型输出决策变量值而非目标值的特定失败模式。
AI.conclusion: JOR-Bench为日文OR问题评估提供了标准化基准；LLM的OR求解能力整体语言无关，但存在微妙的跨语言差异需要进一步研究。

title: Identity-Consistent Expression Fields: A Disentangled Neural Radiance Field Framework for Few-Shot Facial Expression Synthesis
summary: Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) have enabled photorealistic novel-view synthesis of 3D scenes and, in the facial domain, have been extended to reconstruct and animate 3D face models from a small number of images. However, existing few-shot dynamic NeRF methods for facial expression editing typically warp a single learned feature volume conditioned on target expression parameters, which can cause identity-specific appearance details (skin texture, fine geometric structure) to drift when the model is driven toward expressions far from those seen in the few-shot input set. We propose Identity-Consistent Expression Fields (ICEF), a framework that explicitly disentangles a static, identity-specific radiance component from a dynamic, expression-conditioned deformation component, and introduces an identity preservation regularizer that constrains the deformation network to modify only expression-relevant regions while leaving identity-specific canonical appearance untouched. ICEF further incorporates a confidence-weighted conditional feature warping step that down-weights unreliable warps for target expressions that are far, in parameter space, from the observed few-shot inputs, mitigating artifacts observed in prior few-shot dynamic NeRF methods when extrapolating to novel expressions. We relate ICEF to prior few-shot dynamic NeRF, static 3D-aware face generation, and disentangled face-editing radiance field methods, and describe an evaluation protocol measuring both novel-expression rendering quality and, specifically, identity-consistency metrics across a range of expression-parameter extrapolation distances.

AI.tldr: ICEF提出了一种身份一致的表情场框架，通过解耦静态身份辐射分量与动态表情形变分量，并引入身份保持正则化器和置信加权特征变形，解决了少样本动态NeRF在表情编辑时身份细节漂移的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有少样本动态NeRF方法在表情编辑时，将单个学习到的特征体素基于目标表情参数进行变形，当驱动到远离输入集的表情时，会导致身份特定的外观细节（皮肤纹理、精细几何结构）发生漂移。
AI.method: 1) 显式解耦静态身份辐射分量与动态表情形变分量；2) 引入身份保持正则化器，约束变形网络只修改表情相关区域；3) 置信加权条件特征变形，对远距离目标表情的不可靠变形进行降权。
AI.result: 在新型表情渲染质量和身份一致性指标上均优于现有少样本动态NeRF方法，尤其在表情参数外推距离较大时优势明显。
AI.conclusion: ICEF通过显式的身份-表情解耦和置信加权机制，有效提升了少样本动态NeRF在表情编辑任务中的身份一致性和外推能力。

title: A Survey on the Verification of Reinforcement Learning Policies
comment: Accepted at the 35th International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence (IJCAI) 2026
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) is increasingly applied in complex, safety-critical domains, yet the lack of rigorous behavioral guarantees for neural network-based policies remains a major barrier to deployment. Recent advances in policy expressiveness and scale have intensified this challenge, leading to a rapidly growing but conceptually fragmented body of work on RL policy verification. This survey provides a unifying perspective on RL verification methods. We introduce a taxonomy that clarifies relationships among existing approaches along three axes: verification paradigm (formal versus probabilistic), temporal scope (step-wise versus multi-step), and guarantees strength. Beyond taxonomy, we unify underlying theoretical foundations, make implicit assumptions and limitations explicit, and identify emerging directions.

AI.tldr: 本文对强化学习策略验证方法进行了系统性综述，提出了一个三维分类体系（验证范式、时间范围、保证强度），统一了理论基础并指出了未来方向。
AI.motivation: 强化学习在安全关键领域的应用日益广泛，但神经网络策略缺乏严格的行为保证，现有工作虽然快速增长但概念上碎片化，缺乏统一视角。
AI.method: 通过三维分类体系（形式化vs概率验证、单步vs多步、保证强度）对现有RL验证方法进行统一梳理和分类。
AI.result: 提出了一个统一的分类框架，明确了不同方法之间的关系，揭示了隐含假设和局限性。
AI.conclusion: 该综述为RL验证领域提供了系统化的视角，有助于识别未来研究方向。

title: Cascading versus Joint Modeling for Hierarchical Offensive Language Detection
summary: Fine-grained offensive language detection organizes labels into a hierarchical structure, for which two modeling paradigms exist: cascaded decomposition and joint multi-task modeling. Prior work rarely provides a direct, controlled comparison of the two paradigms in terms of accuracy, parameter count, and inference latency, and rarely verifies whether a chosen class-imbalance handling strategy is actually optimal. This paper proposes a three-level cascaded detection system whose training strategy is customized per subtask, together with two verification mechanisms. First, a controlled ablation study determines the best class-imbalance handling strategy for each subtask. Second, a joint multi-task model with a shared encoder is trained as an architectural control, yielding real measurements along the dimensions of accuracy, parameter count, and inference latency. Experiments show that the cascaded system attains macro-F1 scores of 0.795, 0.716, and 0.557 on the three subtasks of the official test set. The ablation study reveals that configuring the loss function purely by imbalance-severity intuition is suboptimal; reconfiguring based on the ablation results improves both performance and stability. End-to-end cascade evaluation shows that roughly one-fifth of the errors in the cascade pipeline originate from the first-stage filter and cannot be corrected by subsequent stages. Relative to the joint multi-task model, the cascaded architecture achieves higher accuracy on all three subtasks, with a 7.1-point macro-F1 gain on the most severely imbalanced subtask, at the cost of three times the parameters and 1.67 times the inference latency. Together, these results establish an explicit, quantifiable trade-off between the accuracy advantage of cascaded architectures and their deployment cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种三级级联的细粒度攻击性语言检测系统，通过每子任务定制训练策略、消融实验优化类别不平衡处理方案，并与联合多任务模型进行准确率、参数量和推理延迟的对比。级联系统在所有子任务上准确率更高（最严重不平衡子任务提升7.1个宏F1点），但参数量增加3倍、延迟增加1.67倍，建立了准确率优势与部署成本之间的可量化权衡关系。
AI.motivation: 现有工作缺乏对级联分解与联合多任务两种范式在准确率、参数量和推理延迟三个维度上的直接、受控对比，也未验证所选类别不平衡处理策略是否真正最优。
AI.method: 提出三级级联检测系统，每子任务定制训练策略；通过消融实验确定各子任务的最佳类别不平衡处理方案；构建共享编码器的联合多任务模型作为架构控制组，实测对比两种范式。
AI.result: 级联系统在三个子任务上宏F1分别达0.795、0.716、0.557；消融实验表明仅凭不平衡严重程度直觉配置损失函数并非最优；级联管道中约五分之一错误来自第一级过滤器且无法被后续级纠正；相比联合多任务模型，级联架构在所有子任务上准确率更高，在最严重不平衡子任务上宏F1提升7.1点，但参数量增加3倍、推理延迟增加1.67倍。
AI.conclusion: 级联架构在准确率上优于联合多任务模型，但代价是更高的参数量和推理延迟，二者之间存在可量化的权衡关系。

title: Diagnosing Correctness Probes under Self-Judgement Confounding
summary: Hidden-state readouts can predict whether language-model outputs are correct, but objective correctness (OC) usually agrees with the model's own self-judgement (SJ), leaving the decoded signal semantically ambiguous. We construct conflict cases in which OC and SJ predict opposite readout orderings. On high-confidence disagreements, conventional correctness-labelled contrasts often rank incorrect/self-endorsed responses above correct/self-rejected responses, following SJ rather than OC. We estimate factorial SJ- and OC-associated directions and evaluate their polarity across mathematical reasoning and factual recall. Across four instruction-tuned models up to 14B parameters, the SJ-associated direction transfers above chance in both cross-domain directions for every model, whereas the OC-associated direction has a below-chance point estimate for the expected OC ordering in every corresponding condition. This transfer asymmetry develops across middle-to-late layers, persists under answer-likelihood, sequence-length, and null-direction controls, and extends to MMLU and binary TruthfulQA without target-domain direction fitting. Across the studied models and diagnostic subsets, the most reliably transferable component preserves SJ-associated polarity. Transferability alone therefore does not establish objective-correctness semantics.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，在语言模型隐含状态中，正确性（OC）和自我判断（SJ）信号存在混淆。通过构造OC与SJ冲突的案例，发现可迁移的神经方向主要编码的是SJ而非OC语义，表明仅凭可迁移性无法建立客观正确性的语义表征。
AI.motivation: 现有工作用隐含状态预测模型输出是否正确，但客观正确性（OC）通常与模型自我判断（SJ）一致，使得解码出的信号存在语义歧义，难以区分其编码的是客观正确性还是模型的主观自我判断。
AI.method: 构造OC与SJ预测排序相反的冲突案例；在有高置信度分歧的样本上，比较传统正确性标签对比与SJ导向标签对比的效果；估计因子化的SJ和OC关联方向，并在数学推理和事实回忆任务中评估其极性；在四个指令微调模型（最高14B参数）上进行跨领域迁移实验，并控制答案似然、序列长度和空方向等混淆因素。
AI.result: SJ关联方向在所有模型的跨领域迁移中均高于随机水平；OC关联方向在对应条件下的预期OC排序点估计低于随机水平。这种迁移不对称性出现在中后期层，且扩展到MMLU和二元TruthfulQA任务。最可靠的可迁移成分始终保留SJ关联极性。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭神经方向的可迁移性不能证明其编码了客观正确性语义；模型隐含状态中更稳定、更可迁移的信号实际上是模型的主观自我判断，而非客观正确性。

title: Strength-Parity Ensembling with Parameter-Isolated Experts for Multi-Task Affect Recognition
summary: Leading entries on the multi-task track of the 11th ABAW challenge rely on heavy ensembling, yet which member is worth adding to an already strong ensemble is rarely made explicit. We study this question for joint valence-arousal estimation, 8-way expression recognition, and 12-way action-unit detection from a single unconstrained face, under partial, long-tailed labels and a rule that forbids pretraining on Aff-Wild2. Building on a shared affect-latent that marginalizes the missing labels across two affect-supervised backbones, we propose a strength-parity rule: an added member lowers the ensemble error only when it is both decorrelated from the current members and a near-peer of them in individual accuracy. The rule exposes a concrete obstacle, as on a single backbone re-seeding and even distinct fine-tuning curricula re-converge to a prediction correlation of 0.98 and add no diversity. Parameter-isolation removes it: confining each adaptation to a disjoint low-rank subspace of a shared backbone yields experts that stay decorrelated at 0.91 while remaining near-peers, the strongest of them an AffectNet-adapted expert. The resulting system raises the overall validation score to 1.6949, against the organizers ConvNeXt-with-MixAugment baseline of 0.45; with per-AU calibration and by pooling the shared-latent heads valence-arousal byproduct as a further near-peer, the strongest configuration reaches 1.7259.

AI.tldr: 本文针对ABAW挑战多任务跟踪中集成学习成员选择问题，提出“强度-平价规则”：只有当新成员与现有成员去相关且准确率相当时，才能降低集成误差。通过参数隔离（将每个适应限制在共享骨干的不相交低秩子空间中）实现去相关，最终系统将验证分数从基线0.45提升至1.7259。
AI.motivation: 现有ABAW挑战的多任务集成方法中，成员选择缺乏明确规则，难以判断哪个成员值得加入强集成，导致集成效率低下。
AI.method: 1）提出强度-平价规则：新成员需与现有成员去相关且为近邻准确率；2）发现单一骨干上重种子和微调课程会重收敛至0.98高相关，缺乏多样性；3）采用参数隔离方法，将每个适应限制在共享骨干的不相交低秩子空间中，使专家保持0.91去相关且准确率相近；4）通过共享潜在头部的价-唤醒副产品池化进一步改进。
AI.result: 系统验证分数从基线0.45提升至1.6949；通过AU校准和共享潜在头部池化，最强配置达到1.7259。
AI.conclusion: 参数隔离是解决多任务集成中成员去相关问题的有效方法，强度-平价规则为集成学习成员选择提供了实用指导。

title: Symbolic Augmentation Closes a Canonical-Equivalence Blind Spot in Neural Fact-Checkers
summary: Large language models hallucinate numbers and units when summarizing scientific text, a failure mode that can silently invert a scientific claim. We recast the detection of such errors as typed verification: we introduce a five-class typed-quantity error taxonomy and a 1500-item benchmark, rewritten from PMC and arXiv sources and labeled by two independent LLM annotators with adjudication (Krippendorff's alpha = 0.882). A ModernBERT encoder fine-tuned on this benchmark reaches macro-F1 = 0.899, far above any off-the-shelf neural fact-checker, yet four probes expose a sharp structural blind spot: on canonical-equivalent rewrites of physically equivalent quantities (e.g., 95°C and 368.15 K) its accuracy collapses to 36.5%. We propose Symbolic Augmentation, a training-time framework that runs the modules of a symbolic verifier in reverse to generate label-preserving augmented training data.
