Leveraging the APPA-REAL dataset, we train Bayesian Neural Networks on datasets of varying sizes using three BNN approximations: MC-DropConnect, Flipout, and Deep Ensembles using supervision on human aleatoric uncertainty available in the APPA-REAL dataset. Each model outputs both the predicted apparent age and the amount of aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty. Our results confirm the hypothesis that the inherent aleatoric uncertainty remains stable across dataset sizes, while epistemic uncertainty increases as training data decreases. These findings demonstrate that different sources of uncertainty can be quantified in face age estimation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究面部图像表观年龄估计中的不确定性量化，通过贝叶斯神经网络区分认知不确定性和偶然不确定性，并验证了偶然不确定性不随数据量变化而认知不确定性随数据减少而增加的假设。
AI.motivation: 面部表观年龄估计具有主观性和数据变异性，现有方法缺乏对不确定性来源的系统量化，特别是缺乏对认知不确定性和偶然不确定性的区分研究。
AI.method: 使用APPA-REAL数据集，分别采用MC-DropConnect、Flipout和Deep Ensembles三种贝叶斯神经网络近似方法，在不同规模数据集上训练模型，输出预测年龄及两种不确定性估计。
AI.result: 偶然不确定性在不同数据集规模下保持稳定，而认知不确定性随训练数据减少而增加。
AI.conclusion: 面部年龄估计中可有效量化不同来源的不确定性，验证了不确定性分解的理论假设。

title: Modeling turn-taking with distant viewing: investigating silence thresholds in human and AI-generated discourse
comment: 10 pages, MeSSH26 (Méthodes pour les sciences sociales et les humanités - Methods for social sciences and humanities 2026)
summary: This study investigates silence gaps in two kinds of audiovisual material. We analysed thirty US situational comedies and fifty-one synthetic podcasts generated with Google NotebookLM. Gaps were compared across speaker gender, assigned from a fundamental-frequency threshold estimated in Praat, and across production settings.

AI.tldr: 研究分析了30部美国情景喜剧和51个AI生成播客中的沉默间隙，比较了不同性别说话者和不同制作环境下的沉默模式。
AI.motivation: 探究不同类型视听材料中沉默间隙的分布特征，以及说话者性别和制作环境对沉默模式的影响。
AI.method: 分析30部美国情景喜剧和51个使用Google NotebookLM生成的合成播客，通过Praat软件基于基频阈值估算说话者性别，比较不同性别和制作环境下的沉默间隙差异。
AI.result: 揭示了情景喜剧和AI生成播客中沉默间隙的分布差异，以及性别和制作环境对沉默模式的影响。
AI.conclusion: 不同类型的视听材料在沉默间隙上存在显著差异，说话者性别和制作环境是影响沉默模式的重要因素。

title: Apple-$π$: Benchmarking Thinking with Video Towards Law-Grounded Physical Intelligence
summary: Modern video generation models are increasingly hailed as emerging world models with an internalized grasp of physical law. Yet existing benchmarks largely evaluate physical plausibility only at the output level, without verifying whether the model arrives there through a faithful, law-grounded reasoning process. We introduce Apple-PI, the first benchmark that anchors video-model evaluation explicitly in physical laws. Apple-PI comprises three components. 1) Orchard: a dataset of 400 videos covering ten canonical tasks in classical mechanics. It separates single-law tasks for confounder-free diagnosis from multi-law tasks for probing generalization. 2) Benchmark Protocol: a three-stage protocol based on scientific reasoning, including Perception, Formulation, and Deduction. It uses chain-of-frames prompting on infographic-annotated first frames, treating the generated video as the model's visible reasoning trace. 3) Evaluation Suite: a hybrid evaluation suite that combines MLLM-based subjective scoring with physics-law-grounded objective measures. This enables stage-resolved diagnosis of not only whether a model fails, but where it fails. Benchmarking 11 models shows that current video models remain far from reliable law-grounded world simulators, with the best video model scoring only 0.473. Our stage-, pillar-, and source-resolved analyses further expose a Perception-to-Formulation-to-Deduction bottleneck, weak multi-law state transfer, and a persistent Sim-to-Real gap. These findings position Apple-PI as a diagnostic foundation for guiding future video models toward world models with law-grounded physical intelligence.

AI.tldr: Apple-PI是首个基于物理定律评估视频生成模型的可信推理过程的基准，包含400个经典力学视频数据集、三阶段科学推理协议（感知-公式化-演绎）和混合评估体系。测试11个模型发现最佳模型得分仅0.473，揭示了当前视频模型在物理定律推理方面的严重不足。
AI.motivation: 现有基准仅从输出层面评估视频生成模型的物理合理性，无法验证模型是否通过符合物理定律的推理过程得到结果，因此需要一种能够诊断模型在物理推理各阶段表现的新型评估方法。
AI.method: 构建Orchard数据集（400个经典力学视频，分单定律和多定律任务）；设计三阶段基准协议（感知、公式化、演绎），采用图表标注首帧的链式帧提示技术；开发混合评估套件，结合MLLM主观评分和物理定律客观度量，实现分阶段诊断。
AI.result: 11个模型的测试显示最佳模型得分仅0.473；发现感知→公式化→演绎的瓶颈问题、多定律状态转移能力弱、以及持续的模拟到真实（Sim-to-Real）差距。
AI.conclusion: Apple-PI为引导未来视频生成模型向具备物理智能的世界模型发展提供了诊断基础，揭示了当前模型与可靠物理模拟器之间的显著差距。

title: Otap:Structure-Aware Optimal Transport for Evaluating Planning and Execution in Agent Trajectories
summary: Large language model agents solve tasks by generating trajectories that interleave planning, tool calls, and intermediate results. Current evaluation metrics reduce such a trajectory to a binary success flag or compare it against a reference by exact matching. A success flag cannot distinguish a sound solution from one that succeeds by luck, and says nothing about why a failed run went wrong. Exact matching penalizes plans that are valid but reordered or decomposed differently from the reference. We reframe trajectory evaluation as a distance between the agent's execution graph and a set of valid solution graphs, and instantiate it via an unbalanced fused Gromov-Wasserstein transport problem over attributed dependency graphs. The resulting score, termed \otap{} (Optimal Transport for Agentic Planning), is a pseudo-metric that is provably invariant to dependency-preserving reorderings and has bounded sensitivity to redundant steps. Its unbalanced marginals handle missing or hallucinated steps without forcing a match, and its soft coupling accommodates variation in plan granularity. On controlled perturbations and three public benchmarks, \otap{} separates valid from invalid trajectories in a regime where semantics-only metrics score below chance. Its accuracy is highest when the dependency graph is recovered exactly, and drops only when the graph is inferred heuristically from free-text traces.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于最优传输的轨迹评估方法OTAP，通过比较执行图与有效解图之间的非平衡融合Gromov-Wasserstein距离，实现对智能体轨迹的语义级评估。
AI.motivation: 现有评估指标（二值成功标志或精确匹配）无法区分偶然成功与真正合理的方案，也无法解释失败原因，且对顺序调整或粒度变化的合理方案过于严厉。
AI.method: 将轨迹评估转化为智能体执行图与有效解图集之间的非平衡融合Gromov-Wasserstein最优传输距离，通过属性依赖图建模，支持冗余步缺失/幻觉的软匹配和粒度变化适应。
AI.result: 在受控扰动和三个公开基准上，OTAP在纯语义指标无效的场景下能有效区分有效与无效轨迹；准确率在依赖图精确恢复时最高，启发式推断时略有下降。
AI.conclusion: OTAP是一个伪度量，具有保依赖重排不变性、对冗余步敏感度有界、支持软匹配等优势，为大语言模型智能体轨迹评估提供了更细粒度的语义级解决方案。

title: VDAR-Router: Adaptive LLMs Routing via Verbalized Query Difficulty Analysis Retrieval
summary: Large language models are increasingly used in practical systems, making efficient model selection important for reducing deployment cost. LLM routing has emerged as a practical solution for allocating each input query to an appropriate model under a desired cost-performance trade-off. Existing routing methods often estimate model suitability from the surface semantics or embedding similarity of the input query. However, such methods may ignore the underlying difficulty of a query, leading to suboptimal routing decisions. To address the challenge, we propose VDAR-Router, a difficulty-aware retrieval-based routing framework. For each input query, VDAR-Router first generates an explicit difficulty analysis. It then retrieves historical examples with similar difficulty profiles. Based on the retrieved records, it estimates candidate model suitability and selects the model using a reward function that considers both performance and cost. Experiments on three datasets show that VDAR-Router consistently achieves better cost-performance trade-offs than existing baselines. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of difficulty-aware retrieval for training-free LLM routing. Case studies further show that explicit query analysis helps retrieve more relevant examples and supports more reliable routing decisions.

AI.tldr: 提出VDAR-Router，一种基于难度感知的检索式路由框架，通过显式分析查询难度并检索相似历史示例来为大语言模型选择最优路由，实现更好的成本-性能平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM路由方法仅从表面语义或嵌入相似性估计模型适用性，忽略了查询的潜在难度，导致路由决策次优。
AI.method: 对每个输入查询首先生成显式难度分析，然后检索具有相似难度特征的历史示例，基于检索记录评估候选模型适用性，并使用同时考虑性能和成本的奖励函数选择模型。
AI.result: 在三个数据集上，VDAR-Router始终优于现有基线方法，实现了更好的成本-性能权衡。
AI.conclusion: 难度感知的检索方法对于无需训练的LLM路由是有效的，显式查询分析有助于检索更相关的示例并支持更可靠的路由决策。

title: Think, Plan, Paint: Layout-Aware Reasoning for Controllable Image Generation in Unified Models
summary: Unified Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) offer a promising paradigm for unifying visual understanding and generation, yet they still struggle to follow complex spatial instructions and logical constraints in controllable image generation. To address this gap, we present ATLAS, a unified framework that equips MLLMs with a human-like "Think, Plan, and Paint" paradigm. We adopt layout as the shared representation that connects the three stages, enabling the model to reason about spatial requirements, plan explicit object arrangements, and render the final image. We further improve plan-to-image fidelity with reinforcement-learning-based layout alignment. We instantiate ATLAS at 7B and 80B scales, achieving state-of-the-art performance among MLLMs on image generation benchmarks and an average 65.31% improvement over existing layout-based unified MLLMs. On spatially related tasks, ATLAS obtains an average 23.06% gain over the base models. Through the same layout interface, ATLAS also supports instruction-guided editing and multimodal grounding. We further introduce ATLAS-Reasoning, a benchmark for evaluating generation under complex spatial instructions.

AI.tldr: ATLAS是一个统一的多模态大语言模型框架，采用"思考-规划-绘制"范式，通过布局作为共享表示来增强可控图像生成，在7B和80B规模上取得了SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有统一多模态大语言模型在遵循复杂空间指令和逻辑约束进行可控图像生成方面仍存在不足。
AI.method: 提出ATLAS框架，采用"思考、规划、绘制"三步范式，以布局作为连接三阶段的共享表示；并利用基于强化学习的布局对齐提升规划到图像的一致性。
AI.result: 在7B和80B规模上实现SOTA性能；相比现有基于布局的统一MLLMs平均提升65.31%；在空间相关任务上平均提升23.06%。
AI.conclusion: ATLAS通过布局接口有效统一了视觉理解与生成，并支持指令引导编辑和多模态定位，同时提出了ATLAS-Reasoning基准用于评估复杂空间指令下的生成能力。

title: Fourier Geometric Wind Power Forecasting with Numerical Weather Prediction
summary: Accurate short-term wind power forecasting is essential for grid stability and operational planning, yet remains challenging due to the complex interactions between atmospheric conditions and turbine dynamics. However, existing methods fail to effectively incorporate weather forecasting with wind turbine data (i.e., SCADA), leading to suboptimal solutions. To address this, we introduce a multimodal framework that integrates historical point-based SCADA data with grid-based Numerical Weather Prediction (NWP) forecasts, which is challenging due to heterogeneous input and the complex physical wind-turbine interactions. Our approach first explicitly decomposes inputs into scalar and vector features to better capture both site-specific and geometric dependencies and then incorporates a geometric encoder to extract rotation-invariant features from wind vectors. We further leverages a Fourier Neural Operator (FNO) architecture, which performs global convolutions in the frequency domain to efficiently model long-range spatiotemporal relationships. Extensive experiments on three real-world wind farms, with weather forecasting data, demonstrate that our model consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, highlighting the effectiveness of its physically-informed design. The core implementation of our method is publicly available at: https://github.com/shawn-sypiao/GWPF.

AI.tldr: 提出一种多模态框架GWPF，融合SCADA点数据与NWP网格天气预测，通过标量/向量分解、几何编码器及傅立叶神经算子进行短期风电功率预测，在三个真实风电场中优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有方法未能有效融合天气预测与SCADA数据，导致风电预测精度不足。
AI.method: 将输入分解为标量和向量特征，使用几何编码器提取旋转不变特征，并利用傅立叶神经算子（FNO）在频域进行全局卷积建模长程时空依赖。
AI.result: 在三个真实风电场上的实验表明，该方法持续优于最先进的基线模型。
AI.conclusion: 融合异构数据（SCADA+NWP）并采用物理信息指导的设计可有效提升短期风电预测性能。

title: How Does Alignment Tuning Shape Representations of Sycophancy and Related Cue-Induced Biases in LLMs?
summary: Modern LLMs are alarmingly susceptible to surprisingly simple immaterial changes of input prompts: a casual hint, an incorrectly labeled few-shot example, or a fake prior assistant turn often flips an originally correct answer. We study where this susceptibility, spanning sycophancy and related cue-induced biases, lives inside the model. Across five model families and seven BCT bias types, we extract a per-bias direction from hidden states and triangulate it through three measures: probing, leave-one-dataset-out transfer, and causal intervention. The susceptibility is largely installed by alignment tuning rather than pretraining: pretrained base models barely cave to these biases, and their activations carry no cue-specific signal beyond question content. Within aligned models, each bias becomes a single coherent direction that we can both decode and steer along, recovering the unbiased answer across every family we test. The biases stay representationally distinct, however: cross-bias entanglement is model-specific rather than a property of the bias category, and even behaviorally similar biases occupy different directions. The same intervention also serves as a modest debiasing tool, recovering a meaningful share of bias-induced errors while preserving most correct answers across all instruct families. Cue-induced bias is therefore best understood not as a single flaw in LLMs but as a family of distinct, causally active directions that alignment tuning installs.

AI.tldr: 本文发现LLM对输入提示中微小变化（如随意提示、错误标签等）的敏感性主要来自对齐微调而非预训练。这些偏差在模型内部表现为独立的、可解码和操控的方向，不同偏差之间保持表征分离，并且通过干预可以部分去偏。
AI.motivation: 理解现代LLM为何对输入提示中微小、无关的变化表现出惊人的易感性（如谄媚和线索诱导偏差），并探究这种偏差在模型内部的表征位置和来源。
AI.method: 跨5个模型家族和7种偏差类型，从隐藏状态中提取每种偏差的方向，通过三种测量手段（探针、留一数据集迁移、因果干预）进行三角验证，并比较预训练基座模型与对齐模型之间的差异。
AI.result: 偏差主要由对齐微调而非预训练引入；对齐模型中每种偏差对应一个单一连贯的方向，可被解码和操控；不同偏差之间表征分离，交叉纠缠具有模型特异性；沿偏差方向进行干预可恢复部分偏差导致的错误。
AI.conclusion: 线索诱导偏差不应被视为LLM的单一缺陷，而是一组由对齐微调安装的、因果活跃的独立方向集合。

title: One Modality to Forget Them All: Enhancing Cross-Modal Unlearning in Vision-Language Models
summary:
Machine unlearning is widely used to remove hazardous knowledge from large language models. Modern Vision-Language Models (VLMs), however, process both text and visual inputs, raising a fundamental security question: does unlearning in one modality transfer to the other? We present the first systematic, bidirectional study of cross-modal unlearning transfer across three VLM architectures: LLaVA-1.5 (MLP projection), InstructBLIP (Q-Former), and IDEFICS (gated cross-attention). We find that unlearning transfers across modalities, but the transfer is asymmetric and incomplete. In some cases, text unlearning strongly transfers to vision. However, this robustness is not preserved under typographic attacks that manipulate the visual presentation of text. Under such attacks, previously unlearned knowledge can be readily recovered, indicating shallow unlearning.
  To address the transfer gap and shallow robustness, we propose \textsc{CrossInf}, an influence-guided mitigation strategy. Motivated by the observation that different model components contribute unequally to cross-modal transfer, \textsc{CrossInf} focuses unlearning on transformer blocks that most influence cross-modal generalization. It reduces the transfer gap by more than half in architectures with strong fusion, while preserving model utility. It also improves robustness under typographic attacks, reducing the attack success rate to near zero. We further conduct human evaluation with three annotators ($κ{=}0.77$) to validate our findings. Finally, we analyze shallow unlearning using Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA), providing insights into the observed transfer behavior and robustness limitations.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统研究了视觉语言模型（VLM）中跨模态遗忘迁移现象，发现遗忘存在非对称和不完全性，且易受排版攻击影响。提出CrossInf策略，通过影响引导聚焦关键Transformer模块，将跨模态迁移差距减半并将攻击成功率降至近零。
AI.motivation: 现有机器遗忘研究主要针对纯文本模型，但视觉语言模型同时处理文本和视觉输入，遗忘是否能在不同模态间迁移是一个尚未解决的安全问题。
AI.method: 在三种VLM架构（LLaVA-1.5、InstructBLIP、IDEFICS）上进行双向遗忘实验，并提出基于影响引导的CrossInf策略，聚焦对跨模态泛化影响最大的Transformer模块进行遗忘优化。
AI.result: 遗忘可在模态间迁移但非对称且不完全；文本遗忘可强迁移至视觉，但排版攻击可恢复遗忘知识；CrossInf将迁移差距减少一半以上，攻击成功率降至近零。
AI.conclusion: VLM中的跨模态遗忘存在浅层遗忘问题，CrossInf策略能有效缓解迁移差距并提升鲁棒性，CKA分析进一步揭示了遗忘行为的深层机制。

title: Evidence Interfaces Shape How Retrieval-Augmented Readers Use Support
summary: In multi-hop RAG evaluation, a top-k answer score can hide two different failures: the retrieval window may drop part of the support chain, or it may contain support in a form the adapted reader does not use well. We call this reader-facing form of retrieved evidence an evidence interface. Using three support-annotated multi-hop QA benchmarks, we compare matched adapted readers trained with raw context, retrieval windows, and gold-support diagnostic renderings. These comparisons distinguish support-availability failures from remaining reader-interface effects. Top-k windows become interpretable only after checking whether the complete annotated support chain survives: when it does, short ranked windows can match or improve over raw context; when it does not, missing support explains much of the loss. Gold support-first improves matched readers; on 2Wiki and MuSiQue, a support-supervised ranker raises coverage and recovers raw-context quality at lower prompt cost, while retaining gold headroom. Support-removal checks further show that the gains rely on exposed evidence, not only answer priors. On support-annotated evaluations, top-k answer scores should therefore be reported together with complete-support coverage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“证据接口”概念，区分多跳RAG评估中top-k答案分数的两种失败原因：检索窗口遗漏支撑链，或包含支撑但阅读器未有效利用。通过对比不同训练方法，发现完整支撑链存活时短窗口可匹敌原始上下文，否则缺失支撑是主要损失来源。建议在支撑注释评估中同时报告top-k答案分数和完整支撑覆盖率。
AI.motivation: 多跳RAG评估中top-k答案分数掩盖了两种不同的失败模式，需要区分支撑链遗漏与阅读器接口问题。
AI.method: 使用三个支撑注释的多跳QA基准，比较原始上下文、检索窗口和gold支撑诊断渲染训练的匹配阅读器，并进行支撑移除检查。
AI.result: 完整支撑链存活时短排名窗口可匹配或改进原始上下文；缺失时支撑丢失解释大部分损失。Gold支撑优先改善阅读器；支撑监督排序器提升覆盖率和恢复质量，同时降低提示成本。
AI.conclusion: Top-k答案分数应结合完整支撑覆盖率报告，以区分支撑可用性与阅读器接口效应。

title: VEHBench: A Stage-Local Diagnostic Benchmark for LLM-Assisted Vibration Energy Harvester Design
summary: Battery-free Internet of Things (IoT) requires iterative design of vibration energy harvesters (VEHs) under coupled physical constraints, while LLMs are emerging as interface layers for engineering workflows. However, existing engineering benchmarks primarily assess final artifact validity, offering limited insights into how LLMs behave across different stages of coupled physical design. We introduce VEHBench, an engineering-native diagnostic benchmark for LLM-assisted VEH design, featuring 763 literature-grounded tasks scored by an analytical physical oracle. VEHBench evaluates four design roles: specification triage, verifier-guided search, corrupted-state recovery, and policy-conditioned selection. Experimental results reveal that LLM capability is strongly stage-dependent: no single model consistently dominates the entire workflow, and response-control profiles expose distinct behavioral patterns across design roles. VEHBench thus provides a stage-aware foundation for evaluating, selecting, routing, and improving verifier-grounded engineering LLMs. The benchmark artifact is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/AnonymousVehbench/vehbench

AI.tldr: 本文提出了VEHBench，一个面向振动能量收集器耦合物理设计的工程原生诊断基准，包含763个文献任务和物理评价函数，评估LLM在四个设计角色中的表现，发现不同模型在各阶段能力差异显著。
AI.motivation: 现有工程基准主要评估最终工件的有效性，缺乏对LLM在耦合物理设计不同阶段行为模式的深入洞察。
AI.method: 构建了763个文献支撑的任务，并设计了分析型物理评价函数，从规格分类、验证引导搜索、损坏状态恢复和策略条件选择四个角色评估LLM。
AI.result: 没有单一模型能在整个工作流中持续领先，不同模型在不同设计角色中表现出截然不同的响应控制行为模式。
AI.conclusion: VEHBench为评估、选择、路由和改进验证引导的工程LLM提供了阶段感知的基础。

title: DS@GT ARC at AnimalCLEF 2026: Species-Aware Graph Construction for Multi-Species Animal Re-Identification
comment: 18 pages, 8 figures. Accepted to the CLEF 2026 Working Notes. Code: https://github.com/dsgt-arc/animalclef-2026
summary: Automated individual animal re-identification is essential for large-scale biodiversity monitoring; however, field imagery complicates separating identity cues from nuisance variation in pose, illumination, background, resolution, and species-specific morphology. The DS@GT ARC submission to AnimalCLEF 2026 introduces a multi-species image-clustering system for re-identifying Eurasian lynx, fire salamanders, loggerhead sea turtles, and Texas horned lizards. Instead of relying on a single descriptor or nearest-neighbor retrieval, this approach formulates re-identification as species-aware graph construction over candidate image pairs. The pipeline integrates tailored preprocessing, global candidate retrieval, LightGlue-based local verification with multiple keypoint families, LightGBM pair scoring, conservative edge admission, and Leiden community detection. This design directly addresses a primary failure mode of clustering-based re-identification: high-scoring false pairs that act as bridge edges and merge distinct individuals through transitive closure. Across species, ablation studies demonstrate that local feature support, foreground-aware preprocessing, and species-specific backbone selection enhance pair evidence, while graph operating points determine the trade-off between fragmentation and over-merging. The selected submission achieved a public ARI of 0.733 and a private ARI of 0.674, ranking fifth among 230 teams. These results indicate that robust wildlife re-identification requires not only strong visual representations but also calibrated integration of global similarity, local identity markings, neighborhood context, and graph-level constraints. The code can be found at https://github.com/dsgt-arc/animalclef-2026.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种多物种野生动物个体重识别系统，通过物种感知图构建、局部特征验证和图聚类算法，在AnimalCLEF 2026竞赛中取得第五名（公共ARI 0.733，私有ARI 0.674）。
AI.motivation: 野外图像中个体身份线索与姿态、光照、背景等干扰因素纠缠，现有方法依赖单一描述子或最近邻检索，难以处理多物种场景下的重识别问题。
AI.method: 将重识别构建为物种感知的候选图像对图构建，集成预处理、全局候选检索、LightGlue局部验证、LightGBM对评分、保守边准入和Leiden社区检测。
AI.result: 公共ARI 0.733，私有ARI 0.674，在230支队伍中排名第五。
AI.conclusion: 鲁棒的野生动物重识别不仅需要强大的视觉表征，还需要全局相似性、局部身份标记、邻域上下文和图级约束的校准集成。

title: PPL-Factory: Task-Aware and Budget-Aware Data Selection from Language Modeling to Reasoning
summary: Not all training samples contribute equally to large language model fine-tuning. Selecting informative training samples can reduce the computational cost while preserving downstream performance. Many existing data selection methods rely on indirect heuristics, such as data quality, diversity or reasoning trace length. However, the effectiveness of these fixed criteria is task-dependent and difficult to generalize across diverse downstream tasks. Perplexity-based data selection provides a simple and model-aware solution to estimate the sample difficulty, but existing approaches typically score the entire training sequence and ignore the difference in learning objectives of language modeling and reasoning tasks. In this paper, we propose PPL-Factory, a simple and interpretable data selection framework that combines task-aware perplexity-based scores and data budget-aware selection criteria. Experiments on GSM8K demonstrate that PPL-Factory outperforms other state-of-the-art data selection methods using only $1\%$ of the training set. With $10\%$ of the data, PPL-Factory exceeds full-data fine-tuning accuracy by 0.9 on GSM8K and 4.8 on MATH. Overall, our results demonstrate that task-aware and budget-aware perplexity-based selection provides an effective and applicable approach for efficient fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PPL-Factory框架，基于任务感知的困惑度分数和预算感知选择标准进行数据选择，仅用1%训练数据即可超越现有方法，10%数据即可超越全量微调性能。
AI.motivation: 现有数据选择方法多依赖间接启发式标准（如数据质量、多样性等），这些固定标准难以泛化到不同下游任务；而基于困惑度的方法忽略了语言建模与推理任务在学习目标上的差异。
AI.method: 提出PPL-Factory框架，结合任务感知的困惑度分数（区分语言建模与推理目标）和预算感知的数据选择标准。
AI.result: 在GSM8K上仅用1%训练数据超越SOTA方法；用10%数据在GSM8K上超过全量微调0.9个点，在MATH上超过4.8个点。
AI.conclusion: 任务感知和预算感知的困惑度选择方法为大语言模型的高效微调提供了有效且可推广的解决方案。

title: Spectral-Morphological Attention U-Net: An Efficient Network for Active Wildfire Detection
summary: Over the past decades, the frequency of global wildfires has been increasing steadily. Therefore, if the fire can be detected and precisely located at an early stage, the potential hazards caused by it can be minimized to the greatest extent. The machine learning methods based on satellite images, due to their ability to automatically monitor extremely remote and vast areas, have shown great potential for application in the field of wildfire detection. To address this challenge, we proposed a new model named spectral-morphological attention U-Net(SMA-UNet), which includes a spectral attention module, a residual attention UNet backbone, a channel-spatial modulator, and a pair of differentiable morphological gates. We trained and evaluated this model with two datasets. These modules, excluding the backbone, are used to detect active fire events for the first time, especially the pair of differentiable morphological gates, which is innovatively developed. The proposed model achieved the highest scores in both datasets (e.g., intersection over union 75.16% in TS-SatFire, 22.50% in Sen2Fire). By conducting ablation studies of each module, we compared their independent contributions and tested their combinations. Ultimately, the integration of these modules yields a highly robust framework that significantly improves segmentation consistency across diverse and complex environmental conditions. Future work will focus on validating the proposed architecture across large-scale, multi-regional datasets from different satellite sensors to establish its broader generalizability for global wildfire detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为SMA-UNet的新型 wildfire 检测模型，通过集成光谱注意力、残差注意力UNet骨干、通道-空间调制器和可微分形态学门控模块，在两个数据集上取得了最优性能（IoU分别达75.16%和22.50%），显著提升了复杂环境下的分割一致性。
AI.motivation: 全球野火频率持续上升，早期精准检测与定位对减少灾害至关重要。基于卫星图像的机器学习方法虽具有自动监测广阔偏远区域的潜力，但现有方法在复杂环境下的检测精度和鲁棒性仍不足。
AI.method: 提出SMA-UNet模型，包含四个核心模块：光谱注意力模块、残差注意力UNet骨干、通道-空间调制器以及一对可微分形态学门控。其中形态学门控为创新设计，所有模块（除骨干外）首次用于活跃火事件检测。在两个数据集上进行训练和评估。
AI.result: 在两个数据集上均取得最高分数（TS-SatFire上IoU 75.16%，Sen2Fire上IoU 22.50%）。消融实验验证了各模块的独立贡献及组合效果，集成后的框架在多样复杂环境条件下显著提升了分割一致性。
AI.conclusion: 该模型为野火检测提供了高度鲁棒的框架，未来工作将在大规模、多区域、多传感器数据集上验证其泛化能力，以推动全球野火检测应用。

title: Is Your Model Thinking or Just Stagnating? PUMA: Diagnosing Reasoning Pathology via Phase-Momentum Alignment
summary: Test-time scaling empowers Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) to tackle complex tasks via extensive Chain-of-Thought (CoT). However, this often induces the "overthinking" paradox, where redundant reasoning increases computational overhead without guaranteeing accuracy. Existing test-time efficiency optimization methods primarily fall into two categories: information-theoretic approaches, which are prone to "deceptive convergence" where low uncertainty masks hallucinations, and latent representation analyses, which are often post-hoc, lacking the real-time sensitivity for dynamic reasoning. To bridge this gap, we first posit the Phase-Momentum Alignment Hypothesis, asserting that reasoning correctness hinges on the temporal synchronization between geometric momentum and uncertainty resolution. We then theoretically formulate the Cognitive-Energy Model to characterize these dynamics through two orthogonal dimensions: Geometric Cognitive Effort, quantified by latent velocity and tortuosity, and Entropic Cognitive Uncertainty. To operationalize this, we introduce PUMA (Phase-Uncertainty Momentum Alignment), a training-free framework employing a tiered diagnostic architecture. By coupling lightweight phase monitoring with event-triggered geometric analysis, PUMA effectively distinguishes active exploration from passive stagnation, enabling precise interventions through adaptive truncation or corrective measures. Extensive experiments on LRMs spanning 1.5B to 32B demonstrate that PUMA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across diverse benchmarks, achieving a superior accuracy-efficiency trade-off and robust cross-domain generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PUMA框架，通过相位-动量对齐假设和认知能量模型，实现大规模推理模型测试时的高效推理，解决"过度思考"问题，在1.5B-32B模型上取得优于现有方法的准确率-效率平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时效率优化方法存在两大局限：信息论方法易出现"欺骗性收敛"（低不确定性掩盖幻觉），潜表示分析多为事后分析，缺乏动态推理所需的实时敏感性。
AI.method: 提出相位-动量对齐假设，构建认知能量模型（几何认知努力+熵认知不确定性两个正交维度），并设计PUMA框架：轻量级相位监控结合事件触发的几何分析，通过自适应截断或纠正措施实现精准干预。
AI.result: 在1.5B到32B参数规模的大规模推理模型上，PUMA在多个基准测试中一致优于现有方法，实现更优的准确率-效率权衡和跨领域泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: PUMA通过实时诊断推理过程中的主动探索与被动停滞，有效解决了大规模推理模型的"过度思考"悖论，为测试时效率优化提供了新的理论框架和实用方案。

title: SWE-Pruner Pro: The Coder LLM Already Knows What to Prune
summary: Pruning long context for coding agents has been a vital technology for efficient context management. While existing context pruning methods such as SWE-Pruner realize this by attaching a separate code classifier, we find the agent itself encodes internal representations indicating the relevance of code context when reading tool output. Based on this finding, we propose SWE-Pruner Pro, which prunes tool outputs directly inside the agent. Concretely, a small head turns the agent's own internal representations into a keep-or-prune label for each line, with a length-aware embedding keyed to each tool output's line count. Across two open-weight backbones and four multi-turn benchmarks, SWE-Pruner Pro saves up to 39% of prompt and completion tokens while preserving task quality, with bounded inference overhead. Notably, on MiMo-V2-Flash SWE-Pruner Pro additionally raises the SWE-Bench Verified resolve rate by +3.8% and the long-context Oolong accuracy by +2.2 points.

AI.tldr: SWE-Pruner Pro利用智能体自身的内部表示来进行代码上下文剪枝，无需独立的分类器，在节省最多39%令牌的同时保持甚至提升任务质量。
AI.motivation: 现有方法（如SWE-Pruner）需要附加独立的代码分类器来剪枝长上下文，而研究发现智能体自身在阅读工具输出时已编码了代码上下文的相关性信息，因此希望利用这一内在表征来实现更高效的剪枝。
AI.method: 在智能体内部直接剪枝工具输出：添加一个小型预测头，将智能体的内部表示转化为每行保留或剪枝的标签，并引入长度感知嵌入来对齐不同工具输出的行数。
AI.result: 在两种开源模型和四个多轮基准测试中，节省了高达39%的提示和补全令牌，同时保持任务质量；在MiMo-V2-Flash上，SWE-Bench Verified解决率提升3.8%，Oolong准确率提升2.2个点。
AI.conclusion: 基于智能体内部表征的剪枝方法比外部附加分类器更高效，不仅能节省大量令牌，还能在部分基准上提升性能，且推理开销可控。

title: Toward Anthropomorphic Dialogue: A Closed-Loop Framework for Human-Like Chat Generation, Evaluation, and Preference Alignment
summary: Human-like private chat requires more than fluent response generation: a system must preserve persona, relationship, memory, bounded knowledge, medium-specific timing, and a coherent multi-turn arc. We present AnthroDial, a closed-loop framework that formulates anthropomorphic dialogue as a joint problem of system architecture, executable evaluation, and diagnostic alignment. It combines (1) a role-conditioned scheduled dialogue runtime with persona and scenario cards, long-term memory, virtual time, and single-draft message decisions; (2) an executable benchmark with an L0 validity gate, five per-turn dimensions, and five dialogue-level dimensions; and (3) a post-training pipeline that filters 16,436 scheduled-decision examples for SFT and applies GRPO with a cognitive-diagnostic, ZPD-aware reward. The reward maintains Kalman-filtered capability estimates for each behavioral dimension, upweights dimensions with larger capability deficits, and uses rollout scores as task-level ZPD matches to focus optimization on learnable weak skills. On a benchmark with 55 personas, 50 scenarios, 50 persona-scenario bindings, and 100 role-conditioned cases per model, we evaluate 16 systems spanning frontier baselines, open models, thinking/no-think variants, and SFT/RL ablations. The strongest non-trained baseline reaches 32.00% strict ACC, while Qwen3.6-27B-SFT+RL reaches 39.00% strict ACC and a 98.5 overall score. In the 9B no-think setting, SFT and RL improve strict ACC from 0.00% to 13.00% and 18.37%. These results show that anthropomorphic dialogue benefits when generation, evaluation, and reward shaping share the same behavioral dimensions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AnthroDial框架，将拟人对话建模为系统架构、可执行评估和诊断对齐的联合问题，通过角色调度运行时、可执行基准测试和基于认知诊断的GRPO训练，在55个角色、50个场景的基准上使Qwen3.6-27B-SFT+RL达到39%严格准确率和98.5总分，验证了生成、评估和奖励塑造共享行为维度的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有对话系统虽能生成流畅回复，但缺乏拟人化聊天所需的多维度能力，包括角色一致性、关系维护、记忆、边界知识、媒介特定时序和连贯的多轮弧线，因此需要一种统一的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出闭环框架AnthroDial，包含三个组件：(1) 角色条件调度对话运行时，整合角色与场景卡片、长期记忆、虚拟时间和单稿消息决策；(2) 可执行基准测试，包含L0有效性门控、5个逐轮维度和5个对话级维度；(3) 后训练流水线，利用16,436个调度决策示例进行SFT，并采用基于认知诊断和最近发展区(ZPD)感知奖励的GRPO，使用卡尔曼滤波估计各行为维度的能力并动态调整权重。
AI.result: 在55个角色、50个场景、50个角色-场景绑定及每模型100个角色条件案例的基准上评估16个系统。最强非训练基线严格ACC为32.00%，Qwen3.6-27B-SFT+RL达到39.00%严格ACC和98.5总分；在9B无思考设置下，SFT和RL分别将严格ACC从0.00%提升到13.00%和18.37%。
AI.conclusion: 拟人对话受益于生成、评估和奖励塑造共享相同的行为维度，表明统一的维度定义是提升对话系统拟人化能力的关键。

title: It's Not What You Say, It's How You Say It: Evaluating LLM Responses to Expressions of Belief
summary: Users frequently express their beliefs to large language models (LLMs). In some situations, the LLM should accept these contextual beliefs as true. In others, they should stick to their prior knowledge. Notably, users' expressions of belief (EoBs) can take linguistically diverse forms - using presuppositions, evidential and certainty markers, or varied tones - each of which may have a different persuasiveness over the LLMs. We introduce a typology to systematically evaluate how different EoBs affect whether models follow context versus prior knowledge. The typology is grounded in four linguistically motivated dimensions: form, evidentiality, epistemic stance, and tone, spanning 17 fine-grained types. By pairing these EoBs with world knowledge facts, we generate controlled EoB-query pairs that isolate the effect of linguistic variation. Using this benchmark, we evaluate 16 LLMs that differ in architecture (Llama3, Qwen3, Gemma3), scale (1B-30B parameters), and training stages (base vs instruct). We identify meaningful variations in response behavior across these axes, e.g., that bigger models and instruction models tend to be less context-following than smaller models and base models. We further identify specific EoBs that statistically significantly persuade LMs more consistently than others. Our work reveals systematic patterns in how linguistic framing affects LLM context integration, with implications for prompt engineering and model robustness.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一套基于语言学维度的类型学框架，系统评估了用户信念表达的不同语言形式（预设、证据标记、认识立场、语气等）对LLM遵循上下文还是坚持先验知识的影响。通过构建16个模型的基准测试，发现更大和经过指令微调的模型更不倾向于遵循上下文，且特定语言学形式的信念表达对模型具有更强的说服效果。
AI.motivation: 用户向大语言模型表达信念时，LLM有时应接受这些信念为真，有时应坚持先验知识。然而用户信念表达具有丰富的语言多样性（如预设、证据标记、确定性标记、不同语气等），这些不同的语言形式可能对模型产生不同的说服力，但目前缺乏系统的评估框架来理解这种影响。
AI.method: 构建了一个基于四个语言学维度（形式、证据性、认识立场、语气）的类型学体系，涵盖17种细粒度类型。通过将信念表达与世界知识事实配对，生成受控的信念表达-查询对，以隔离语言变异的影响。在16个不同架构（Llama3、Qwen3、Gemma3）、规模（1B-30B参数）和训练阶段（基础vs指令微调）的LLM上进行评估。
AI.result: 发现模型规模越大、经过指令微调，越倾向于不遵循上下文而坚持先验知识。同时识别出某些特定的信念表达类型在统计学上显著地比其他类型更能说服语言模型遵循上下文。
AI.conclusion: 语言框架如何影响LLM的上下文整合存在系统性的模式，这些发现对提示工程和模型鲁棒性具有重要启示。

title: Geometry-Enhanced Portion Estimation for Multimodal LLMs
summary: Image-based dietary assessment promises to replace costly, bias-prone manual recalls, but portion estimation remains a major blocker. Multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) recognize a wide range of foods zero-shot in uncontrolled photos, yet they are weak at portion estimation -- a gap we measure across the current frontier (Gemini, GPT, and Claude flagships alike). We present a method that enhances a frozen, commercial MLLM with an accurate portion head: a small geometry-enhanced network on a frozen DINOv2 backbone with a structured softmax-ownership volume, consuming the MLLM's per-food name, bounding box, and density range -- no depth sensor, no MLLM fine-tuning. Evaluated fully open-vocabulary on three real-world benchmarks, the head cuts per-food portion error by 33-41% relative to the MLLM alone, outperforms every flagship MLLM's direct estimates, and surpasses each benchmark's originally published image-only model at its own reported metric.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种增强多模态大模型（MLLM）食物份量估计能力的方法，通过附加一个基于DINOv2和softmax-ownership体积的小型几何网络，在不微调MLLM的情况下，将份量估计误差降低33-41%，性能超越当前所有旗舰MLLM及基准模型。
AI.motivation: 基于图像的膳食评估虽有前景，但份量估计是主要瓶颈。现有MLLM能零样本识别多种食物，但在份量估计上表现薄弱，需要一种无需深度传感器或微调即可提升份量估计精度的方法。
AI.method: 在冻结的商业MLLM上附加一个份量估计头：基于冻结的DINOv2骨干网络的小型几何增强网络，采用结构化softmax-ownership体积，输入MLLM输出的食物名称、边界框和密度范围，无需深度传感器或MLLM微调。
AI.result: 在三个真实世界开放词汇基准上，该方法将每类食物份量误差降低33-41%，优于所有旗舰MLLM的直接估计，并超越各基准原始发表的图像模型在自有指标上的表现。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有效弥补了MLLM在食物份量估计上的短板，以轻量级附加模块实现了显著优于当前前沿模型的性能，为基于图像的膳食评估提供了实用解决方案。

title: A Systematic Evaluation of Trajectory Data Curation for LoRA Fine-Tuning of Code Agents
comment: 12 pages, 2 figures. Author's accepted manuscript of a paper published in the ICIC 2026 proceedings (oral presentation)
summary: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) of open-weight LLMs on expert agent trajectories has emerged as a prominent approach to building capable code agents without reliance on proprietary models. A central yet underexplored question is how trajectory quality and quantity jointly shape model performance. We present a systematic empirical study of trajectory data filtering for LoRA fine-tuning of Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct on the SWE-trajectory dataset (67,074 trajectories, of which 32,161 are resolved). We propose a two-axis quality scoring framework -- Efficiency and Style -- and evaluate it through 16 controlled experiments spanning strategy, scale, and ablation analyses. Since 7B-scale models attain near-zero SWE-bench resolve rates, we adopt cross-entropy (CE) loss on held-out trajectories as the primary metric, validated via first-action generation: CE loss and ROUGE-L are perfectly rank-correlated (Spearman $ρ$ = -1.00), with limited-sample evidence supporting but not conclusively establishing this proxy. Our results reveal a scale-dependent quality-quantity trade-off: at small scales, doubling the dataset (500 to 1,000) yields ~12.7% CE-loss reduction whereas the TopQ-Random gap stays <1% (Mann-Whitney p > 0.10); at 2,000 trajectories this same gap widens to 3.6% (p = 0.016). Ablation further identifies error-retry rate as the dominant sub-dimension, performing comparably to the full composite ($Δ$ < 0.2%). Together, these findings establish trajectory-level quality scoring as a viable but scale-sensitive lever for code-agent SFT and offer a proxy-validated evaluation protocol for the regime where end-to-end resolve rate is statistically infeasible.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了代码智能体SFT中轨迹数据质量与数量的联合影响，提出了Efficiency-Style双轴质量评分框架，发现了规模依赖的质量-数量权衡：小规模数据量下质量筛选效果不显著，但在2000条轨迹时质量筛选优势明显（3.6%差距）。交叉熵损失可作为7B模型SWE-bench性能的有效代理指标。
AI.motivation: 当前代码智能体SFT广泛使用专家轨迹数据，但轨迹数据的质量与数量如何联合影响模型性能这一核心问题尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 提出Efficiency（效率）和Style（风格）双轴质量评分框架；在SWE-trajectory数据集上对Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct进行LoRA微调，开展16组受控实验，涵盖策略、规模、消融分析；采用交叉熵损失作为主要评估指标，并通过首次动作生成任务验证其有效性。
AI.result: 发现规模依赖的质量-数量权衡：小规模（500→1000条）时加倍数据量降低CE损失~12.7%，TopQ与Random差距<1%（p>0.10）；2000条时差距扩大至3.6%（p=0.016）。消融实验表明错误重试率（error-retry rate）是主导子维度，与完整复合指标表现相当（Δ<0.2%）。交叉熵损失与ROUGE-L完美秩相关（Spearman ρ=-1.00）。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹级质量评分是可行但规模敏感的代码智能体SFT手段，为端到端解决率统计不可行的场景提供了代理验证评估协议。

title: Automated Discovery Has No Universally Superior Harness
summary: Autonomous discovery systems such as OpenEvolve and TTT-Discover are often used as general-purpose harnesses. However, in practice these are composite systems combining several design choices about archives, parent selection, exploration, and budget allocation into a single recipe. Because discovery runs are expensive and inherently stochastic, existing harnesses are often compared using too few independent trials to distinguish key methodological improvements from run-to-run variance. We systematically decompose OpenEvolve-style evolutionary search and the TTT-Discover search harness into its constituent components and systematically evaluate 30 budget-matched harnesses across 12 model-problem pairs using more than 3.1 million LLM rollouts and repeated-trial statistical analysis. Our results show that discovery harnesses have a generalization problem: No fixed harness is reliably superior across the evaluated model-problem pairs, and variants of OpenEvolve generally underperform simpler alternatives. Thus, harness choice is better viewed as a hyperparameter rather than as a universal recipe, and should be tailored to the specific problem and underlying model. We also find that early discovery progress predicts final performance, and use this property to present a budget-matched adaptive-allocation experiment that starts multiple harnesses, prunes weak partial runs, and reallocates compute to stronger survivors, outperforming both commitment to a randomly sampled fixed harness and a non-adaptive harness ensemble. Together, these results motivate shifting from fixed harness selection to online adaptation guided by early performance. We release all run pools including baseline null distributions for every model-problem pair as reusable statistical infrastructure against for future harness proposals.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分解了OpenEvolve和TTT-Discover等自主发现系统的组件，通过310万+次LLM rollout和统计检验发现：没有通用的最佳框架，框架选择应视为超参数而非通用配方，并验证了早期发现进度可预测最终性能，提出自适应预算分配策略优于固定框架。
AI.motivation: 现有自主发现系统（如OpenEvolve、TTT-Discover）常被当作通用框架使用，但由于发现实验成本高且具有随机性，现有比较往往基于过少的独立试验，难以区分方法改进与随机波动。
AI.method: 将OpenEvolve式进化搜索和TTT-Discover搜索框架分解为组成组件，在12个模型-问题对上系统评估30种预算匹配的框架，使用超过310万次LLM rollout和重复试验统计分析。
AI.result: 没有固定框架在评估的模型-问题对上始终优于其他框架；OpenEvolve变体普遍不如更简单的替代方案；早期发现进度可预测最终性能；自适应预算分配策略优于固定框架和非自适应集成。
AI.conclusion: 框架选择应被视为超参数而非通用配方，应根据具体问题和模型定制；建议从固定框架选择转向基于早期性能的在线自适应调整。

title: Do Vision Encoders Exhibit Human-like Color Thresholds?
summary: Understanding and characterizing human color perception is a longstanding research goal. One of the most traditional approaches is looking for the human color discrimination thresholds, the minimum chromatic differences perceptible to human observers. In recent years, deep neural networks have become the standard networks for computer vision tasks. In particular, deep vision encoders, foundation models trained on large-scale visual data, map images into latent feature representations. Despite the widespread use of deep vision encoders, few studies have investigated whether their internal representations exhibit human-like discrimination thresholds. In this work, we present a large-scale exploratory study probing the chromatic sensitivity of more than 50 pretrained vision encoders, including convolutional networks and vision transformers, against human discrimination thresholds. Using controlled chromatic stimuli at multiple chroma levels, we compare model-derived chromatic discrimination thresholds with human discrimination ellipses through a region-overlap metric (mIoU). Our analysis reveals generally weak alignment between model representations and human perceptual thresholds across all model families, with the best mIoU < 0.25. Moreover, we find that self-supervised encoders consistently outperform supervised ones, while language-supervised models show the most polarized behavior, occupying both the top and bottom of the ranking. These findings suggest that human-like chromatic sensitivity does not emerge naturally from current large-scale visual training objectives for any of the analyzed architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了超过50个预训练视觉编码器（包括CNN和ViT）的色度敏感性与人类色度辨别阈值之间的对齐程度，发现整体对齐较弱（最佳mIoU<0.25），自监督编码器表现优于监督学习模型，语言监督模型表现最极端，表明当前大规模视觉训练目标无法自然产生类似人类的色度敏感度。
AI.motivation: 理解人类颜色感知是一个长期研究目标，传统方法关注色度辨别阈值。尽管深度视觉编码器被广泛使用，但很少研究其内部表征是否表现出类似人类的辨别阈值，因此本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 使用超过50个预训练视觉编码器（包括卷积网络和视觉变换器），通过受控色度刺激在多色度水平下，利用区域重叠度量（mIoU）比较模型推导的色度辨别阈值与人类辨别椭圆。
AI.result: 模型表征与人类感知阈值之间的对齐普遍较弱，最佳mIoU小于0.25。自监督编码器表现始终优于监督学习编码器，而语言监督模型表现出最极端的行为，既排名最高也排名最低。
AI.conclusion: 当前大规模视觉训练目标无法自然产生类似人类的色度敏感度，无论何种架构分析均如此。

title: Constrained Path Reasoning: Measuring When Committed Stages Earn Their Cost
summary: When does a committed intermediate stage in an LLM reasoning pipeline earn its cost? Constrained Path Reasoning (CPR) pairs a source-aware path hypothesis with stage-level accounting. Search generates provisional states; trusted or validated invariants can constrain hard, while other proposals remain soft and revisable. CPR predicts that task-compatible commitments can factor transitions, concentrate candidate mass, induce regularity, and expose feedback when their gains exceed propagated error and execution cost. The formalism covers discrete commitments and continuous flows and measures effective branching, endpoint concentration, and cost per usable output. Across 1,180 generated QCQPs and 40 engineered degenerate polynomial instances (2,140 endpoints), residual triage recovers 63.0% of repair-all's additional feasible yield with 17.7% of its attempts. Fixed-LLM accounting (270 unique calls shared across nested arms) finds usable yield of 41.1% direct, 90.0% after formalization and deterministic execution, 20.0% after one-shot convexification, and 21.1% for the full path. In 120 paired-condition calls, a two-action rollback rule reaches 90% usable yield versus 36.7% for the feedback-conditioned selector. Two endpoint probes separate source from validation: a 72-output cross-trajectory transplant reduces entropy and acceptable mass; a 24-output same-call self-proposal pilot gives unchanged two-repeat collision entropy, 25.0% versus 8.3% usable yield, and 1/8 deterministically confirmed endpoint checks. Model-generated states supply hypotheses; trusted execution earns constraint strength.

AI.tldr: 本文提出约束路径推理（CPR）框架，通过可信不变量的软硬约束结合阶段级核算，在LLM推理中平衡承诺成本与收益。实验表明，残差分诊能以17.7%的尝试恢复63.0%的额外可行产出，固定LLM核算下完整路径可用产出率达21.1%，两动作回滚规则在配对条件下可达90%可用产出率。
AI.motivation: 研究LLM推理流水线中引入中间承诺阶段的代价与收益问题，探索如何通过可信不变量约束来减少搜索空间、提升推理效率。
AI.method: 提出约束路径推理（CPR）框架，区分软硬约束：可信或验证过的不变量作为硬约束，其余假设作为软约束可修正。通过阶段级核算衡量有效分支因子、端点集中度和每可用输出成本，支持离散承诺和连续流两种形式。
AI.result: 在1180个生成QCQP和40个人工退化多项式实例上：残差分诊以17.7%尝试恢复63.0%额外可行产出；固定LLM核算中，直接可用产出41.1%，形式化后90.0%，完整路径21.1%；两动作回滚规则达90%可用产出率（vs反馈选择器36.7%）；跨轨迹移植降低熵和可接受质量，同调用自提议实验中可用产出率25.0% vs 8.3%。
AI.conclusion: 模型生成状态提供假设，可信执行决定约束强度。任务兼容的承诺能够分解转移、集中候选质量、引入规律性，并在增益超过传播误差和执行成本时提供有效反馈。

title: AffectFuse: Cross-Task Feature Fusion with Temporal Modeling for Multi-Task Affective Behavior Analysis
summary: Affective behavior recognition in the wild requires joint prediction of continuous valence-arousal, categorical facial expression, and multi-label action units from unconstrained face images. We present our system for the Multi-Task Learning (MTL) track of the 11th Affective Behavior Analysis in-the-wild (ABAW) competition on s-Aff-Wild2, the static selected-frame version of Aff-Wild2. The method focuses on post-encoder adaptation: frozen AffectNet-supervised backbones provide multi-resolution features, while task-specific temporal heads and cross-task fusion modules select the useful signals for each target. For action-unit recognition, we adapt MAE-Face with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) and use DISFA through per-unit expert routing rather than direct sequential transfer. Ablations over backbone, temporal, fusion, and AU-adaptation choices define the final configuration. The final system obtains P = 1.7302 on the official validation split, showing that post-encoder adaptation and task-wise modeling choices provide a strong MTL pipeline without training a new large-scale face foundation model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向ABAW竞赛的多任务学习系统，采用固定骨干网络+后编码器适配策略，通过任务特定头、跨任务融合模块和AU专家路由实现情感识别，无需训练新的大规模人脸基础模型，在验证集上取得P=1.7302的成绩。
AI.motivation: 野外情感行为识别需要同时预测连续效价-唤醒、分类面部表情和多标签动作单元，现有方法往往依赖训练全新的大规模人脸基础模型，计算成本高昂。本文旨在探索一种轻量级的多任务学习方案，通过后编码器适配和任务特定模块设计，在不重新预训练大模型的前提下实现高效的情感识别。
AI.method: 采用冻结的AffectNet预训练骨干网络提取多分辨率特征；设计任务特定的时序头和跨任务融合模块来选择各目标的有效信号；对于动作单元识别，引入MAE-Face结合LoRA低秩适配，并使用DISFA通过每单元专家路由而非直接顺序迁移进行训练。
AI.result: 在s-Aff-Wild2官方验证集上取得P=1.7302的成绩。
AI.conclusion: 后编码器适配和任务特定建模选择能够构建强大的多任务学习流水线，无需训练新的大规模人脸基础模型即可实现有效的野外情感行为识别。

title: LenGuard-GPC: Length Guarding with Guided-Prompt Consistency for Spatial Reasoning Reinforce Learning
summary: Multi-view spatial reasoning requires vision-language models to compare visual evidence across images, align object correspondences, and infer spatial relations over long visual contexts, a setting where chain-of-thought reasoning tends to grow verbose without becoming more accurate. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards is a natural fit for this task, but standard GRPO reward relies on sparse outcome-level feedback and gives no signal about where a reasoning trajectory goes wrong, nor any control over its length. We propose LenGuard-GPC, a dense reward framework that addresses both problems together. For each sampled trajectory, it compares the token-wise predictive distributions under a standard prompt and a guided prompt, and uses the resulting token-sum KL divergence as a dense reward signal. Since this KL penalty accumulates over tokens and would otherwise reward shorter responses regardless of their quality, we introduce a staged length bonus that keeps reasoning length within a controlled range without simply encouraging brevity. On six multi-view spatial reasoning benchmarks, LenGuard-GPC improves accuracy over vanilla GRPO while reducing average response length.

AI.tldr: 提出LenGuard-GPC框架，通过KL散度密集奖励和分段长度奖励，在多视角空间推理任务中提升准确率并缩短响应长度。
AI.motivation: 标准GRPO奖励仅提供稀疏的结果级反馈，无法定位推理轨迹中的错误位置，也无法控制推理长度。多视角空间推理需要长上下文推理，而链式思维推理会变得冗长却不提高准确性。
AI.method: 提出LenGuard-GPC密集奖励框架：1）计算标准提示与引导提示下的token级预测分布的KL散度作为密集奖励信号；2）引入分段长度奖励，将推理长度控制在合理范围内，避免简单鼓励简短的负面效应。
AI.result: 在六个多视角空间推理基准上，LenGuard-GPC相比标准GRPO提升了准确率，同时降低了平均响应长度。
AI.conclusion: 通过密集的KL散度奖励和分段长度控制，LenGuard-GPC有效解决了稀疏奖励和推理长度失控的问题，实现了更高效、更准确的多视角空间推理。

title: CNS-Edit++: Category-Agnostic 3D Editing with Coupled Neural Shape Representation
summary: This paper presents a latent-space 3D shape editing framework built upon a coupled neural shape (CNS) representation and a neural feature volume optimization. This work extends CNS-Edit, built on Coupled Neural Shape optimization, to CNS-Edit++, by generalizing the category-specific coupled representation to category-agnostic 3D shape editing with foundation models. The Coupled Neural Shape (CNS) representation couples a global latent code that captures high-level shape semantics with a 3D neural feature volume that provides spatial context for local shape manipulation. Then we formulate a coupled neural shape optimization procedure that co-optimizes these two components subject to a given editing operation. Our framework can be instantiated on both the category-specific 3D inversion model and category-agnostic 3D foundation models. We provide various shape editing operators, including copy, resize, delete, mix, point-wise drag, and region-wise drag, each of which is formulated as an objective to guide the CNS optimization. To preserve regions outside the editing area, we further introduce two complementary region-wise control mechanisms, i.e., KV-cache replacement and latent feature regularization. Extensive quantitative and qualitative evaluations across different 3D generative models demonstrate the strong capabilities of our approach over state-of-the-art solutions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于耦合神经形状(CNS)表示和神经特征体积优化的潜空间3D形状编辑框架CNS-Edit++，将类别特定的耦合表示推广为类别无关的3D形状编辑，并支持多种编辑操作（复制、调整大小、删除、混合、点拖拽、区域拖拽），通过KV缓存替换和潜在特征正则化实现区域控制，在多种3D生成模型上取得了优于现有方法的效果。
AI.motivation: 现有3D形状编辑方法多局限于特定类别，缺乏通用的、类别无关的编辑能力，且在保持编辑区域外原始内容方面存在不足。
AI.method: 基于CNS表示（全局潜编码+3D神经特征体积），通过耦合神经形状优化协同优化两个组件；引入KV缓存替换和潜在特征正则化两种互补的区域控制机制；支持基于类别特定3D反演模型和类别无关3D基础模型的实例化。
AI.result: 在多种3D生成模型上的定量和定性评估均表明，该方法显著优于现有最先进方案。
AI.conclusion: CNS-Edit++成功将类别特定的3D形状编辑推广到类别无关的通用编辑框架，为3D形状编辑提供了一种灵活高效的解决方案。

title: Coordinated Disentanglement with Iterative Mode Discovery Under Hidden Correlations
summary: Disentangled representation learning is a powerful paradigm for robust attribute prediction. While recent methods address attribute correlations, hidden correlations remain underexplored, where data under the value of a certain attribute exhibit underlying modes correlated with other attributes. To preserve mode information and achieve disentanglement, we jointly discover modes and enforce mode-based conditional independence. Yet, the interdependency between these two modules may lead to error amplification under naive iterations. We propose Coordinated Disentanglement with Iterative mode Discovery (CoDID), an end-to-end framework featuring a dynamic architecture that adapts to evolving number of modes, and a coordination mechanism that mitigates error amplification via meta-optimization. Empirical results demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance on diverse tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoDID框架，通过迭代模式发现和协调机制解决属性预测中隐藏关联的解耦问题，在多个任务上达到最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有解耦表示学习方法虽然处理了属性间的显式关联，但忽视了隐藏关联——即某属性值下的数据存在与其他属性相关的潜在模式。为保留模式信息并实现解耦，需要同时发现模式并施加基于模式的条件独立性约束。
AI.method: 提出CoDID框架，包含动态架构以适应不断变化的模式数量，以及通过元优化缓解错误放大的协调机制。该框架以端到端方式联合进行模式发现和条件独立性约束。
AI.result: 在多个不同任务上的实验结果表明，CoDID达到了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过协调迭代模式发现与解耦学习，能够有效处理隐藏关联问题，提升属性预测的鲁棒性。

title: Digital measurement of droplet flame diameter in microgravity combustion images using Segment Anything Model 2 with automatic prompt selection
summary:
Flame diameter is a key measurable parameter in microgravity droplet combustion, but its extraction from self-illuminated frames remains difficult because soot tails, blurred luminous boundaries, chamber reflections, and droplet drift introduce substantial measurement bias and operator dependence. This work presents an AI-enabled digital measurement workflow for automated flame diameter from combustion images. The workflow integrates automatic prompt-point generation into Segment Anything Model 2, employing Random Sample Consensus (RANSAC)-based circle fitting. The automatic prompt strategy removes subjective manual point selection, while the video memory mechanism maintains temporal consistency for drifting droplets, and the RANSAC fitting rejects soot-tail pixels as geometric outliers.
  The method is validated by 19,537 flame images of n-heptane, n-decane, and n-octane droplets with varying initial diameters. Compared with manual-reference measurements, the proposed workflow achieves a mean relative agreement of 96.9%, a mean absolute percentage error of 3.1%, and substantially outperforms conventional Hough circle detection, which performed worse under the same evaluation conditions. The results also show that the measurement accuracy improves with increasing droplet size. The proposed workflow has a combined standard uncertainty of 8.54% and achieves approximately a 229-fold improvement in efficiency over manual measurement.
  These results demonstrate that the proposed SAM2-based workflow provides a reproducible, fully automated, and metrologically characterized digital measurement system for extracting flame diameter from challenging combustion images. The approach supports high-throughput combustion diagnostics and illustrates that AI-based segmentation can be integrated into quantitative measurement workflows for digitalized image-based metrology.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于SAM2的AI自动化火焰直径测量工作流，通过自动提示点生成、视频记忆机制和RANSAC圆拟合，在19537张微重力燃烧图像上达到96.9%的平均一致性和3.1%的平均绝对百分比误差，效率提升约229倍。
AI.motivation: 微重力液滴燃烧中，火焰直径从自发光图像中提取困难，因为烟尾、模糊边界、腔体反射和液滴漂移带来测量偏差和操作者依赖性，亟需自动化、可重复的测量方法。
AI.method: 集成自动提示点生成到Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM2)，结合RANSAC圆拟合并设计视频记忆机制以保持时间一致性，自动拒绝烟尾像素等几何异常值。
AI.result: 在正庚烷、正癸烷和正辛烷的19537张火焰图像上验证，平均一致性96.9%，MAPE为3.1%，组合标准不确定度8.54%，效率提升229倍，优于传统Hough圆检测。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的SAM2工作流为具有挑战性的燃烧图像提供了可复制、全自动、具有计量学表征的数字测量系统，支持高通量燃烧诊断，展示了AI分割可集成到定量测量工作流中。

title: An Explicit World Model Based on Data-First Ontology: DaoQL Multimodal Storage Validation and Counterfactual Reasoning Evaluation
summary: Large language models encode world models implicitly in neural weights, which exposes four structural risks in high-precision domains such as medicine and finance: hallucination, frozen knowledge, poor explainability, and poor modifiability. This paper proposes data-first ontology: LLMs are treated as reasoning and language engines, while deterministic knowledge is moved into an explicit multimodal database, DaoQL. We formalize an explicit world model and show that, under rule independence, deterministic evaluation, and fixed conflict resolution, explicit models provide a sufficient condition for composable counterfactual decomposability; implicit models lack atomic read/delta semantics and therefore provide no comparable architectural guarantee. The implemented system focuses on DaoQL's verified storage layer and explicit Eval path, integrating graph, column, vector, and full-text engines within one process. KVCache graph nodes, expert hot updates, and the DaoQL-Agent runtime remain future work. On an embedded same-machine setup, DaoQL reports graph BFS at 1.20 ms, HNSW at 83.1 us, and a Fluent hybrid query at 105.8 us; these results indicate engineering potential but must be interpreted with deployment-shape differences from client-server systems. Exploratory measurements on LDBC SNB SF1 and ANN-Benchmarks further show 34/34 query coverage with interactive-class queries mostly in the sub-millisecond to millisecond range, but only 1.8 QPS overall due to long-tail BI/IC queries; ANN-Benchmarks reaches Recall@10 >= 99% at thousand-level QPS after a bridge-edge protection fix. In a five-domain counterfactual experiment (n = 1250), DaoQL+GPT-4o achieves 94% composable counterfactual decomposability, 49 percentage points above GPT-4o alone. The paper explicitly separates provable structure, preliminary empirical evidence, and architectural roadmap claims.

AI.tldr: 本文提出数据优先本体论，将确定性知识移入显式多模态数据库DaoQL，LLM仅作为推理和语言引擎，通过显式世界模型实现可组合反事实可分解性，实验显示在五领域反事实实验中比纯GPT-4o提升49个百分点。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在高精度领域（如医学、金融）存在幻觉、知识冻结、可解释性差、可修改性差四种结构风险，亟需一种更可靠的知识表示与推理架构。
AI.method: 提出数据优先本体论，将确定性知识移入显式多模态数据库DaoQL（集成图、列、向量、全文引擎），LLM仅保留推理和语言能力；形式化显式世界模型并证明其在规则独立、确定性评估、固定冲突解决条件下满足可组合反事实可分解性的充分条件。
AI.result: DaoQL在嵌入式同机设置下：图BFS 1.20ms，HNSW 83.1μs，Fluid混合查询105.8μs；LDBC SNB SF1上34/34查询全覆盖；ANN-Benchmarks Recall@10≥99%达千级QPS；五领域反事实实验(n=1250)中DaoQL+GPT-4o达94%可组合反事实可分解性，比纯GPT-4o高49个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 显式世界模型提供了隐式模型缺乏的原子读/增量语义与架构保证，DaoQL展示了工程潜力；KVCache图节点、专家热更新和DaoQL-Agent运行时留待未来工作。

title: PAVXploreRL: Physical-Action-Visual World Model Reinforcement Learning with Action Exploration
summary: Action-conditioned world models are a key component of embodied AI, serving as scalable policy evaluators that reduce reliance on expensive real-world rollouts. To accurately capture diverse action-induced dynamics, such models should satisfy three key objectives-Physical Plausibility (P), Action Adherence (A), and Visual Fidelity (V), collectively referred to as PAV-while remaining robust to both in-distribution (ID) expert demonstrations and out-of-distribution (OOD) actions. However, existing methods primarily rely on ID action-video pairs and pixel-level reconstruction losses, which do not explicitly optimize PAV objectives and generalize poorly beyond expert data. To address this, we propose PAVXploreRL, a reinforcement learning framework built on a pretrained latent world model that explicitly optimizes PAV objectives through reward-driven training. To improve action generalization, our method jointly leverages ID trajectories and noise-driven OOD action exploration, without paired video supervision. Experiments show that PAVXploreRL consistently outperforms pretrained baselines, achieving a 5.6% average gain across benchmarks and producing higher-quality PAV properties. As a policy evaluator, it also yields more reliable performance estimates and reduces the overestimation bias of prior expert-only world models such as Ctrl-World. Code: https://github.com/Social-AI-Studio/PAVXploreRL

AI.tldr: 提出PAVXploreRL框架，通过强化学习优化世界模型的物理合理性、动作遵循性和视觉保真度（PAV），结合分布内轨迹和噪声驱动的分布外动作探索，提升动作泛化能力，相比基线方法平均提升5.6%。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型主要依赖分布内动作-视频对和像素级重建损失，未能显式优化PAV目标，且难以泛化到专家数据之外的分布外动作。
AI.method: 提出PAVXploreRL框架，基于预训练潜在世界模型，通过强化学习奖励驱动训练显式优化PAV三目标；联合利用分布内轨迹和噪声驱动的分布外动作探索，无需配对视频监督。
AI.result: 在多个基准上平均提升5.6%，生成更高质量的PAV属性；作为策略评估器时提供更可靠的性能估计，减少了Ctrl-World等仅专家世界模型的过高估计偏差。
AI.conclusion: PAVXploreRL通过强化学习显式优化PAV目标并引入分布外探索，有效提升了世界模型的泛化能力和评估可靠性。

title: Lossless but Not Free: An Empirical Anatomy of Speculative Decoding on Consumer Hardware
comment: 15 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Code, benchmark harness, and all result artifacts: https://github.com/ParamChordiya/speculative_decoding_engine
summary: Single-stream autoregressive decoding of large language models is bound by memory bandwidth: each generated token requires one full forward pass through the target model, and successive passes cannot be parallelized. Speculative decoding restructures this computation: a small draft model proposes $K$ tokens autoregressively, the target model scores all of them in one batched pass, and a rejection-sampling rule provably preserves the target model's output distribution. We present a from-scratch, device-agnostic (CUDA/MPS/CPU) implementation and an empirical study across five draft/target backend configurations on a consumer Apple-silicon laptop. Distribution equivalence is verified at three levels, culminating in a two-sample test over roughly 9,200 real-model tokens per method ($χ^2 = 162.5$, dof $= 200$, $p = 0.976$) and exact greedy-sequence agreement. The best configuration reaches a measured $1.61\times$ wall-clock speedup at $K=6$, on an acceptance profile declining from 69.7% at $K=1$ to 37.8% at the optimum, while three of five configurations decelerate, either because the draft fails to out-speed a small target or because the quantized Metal backend executes "parallel" verification serially, an effect we isolate and quantify. The failures are as instructive as the successes: speculative decoding pays off only when verification is genuinely batch-parallel and the draft/target latency gap is real.

AI.tldr: 本文通过自研的跨平台实现（CUDA/MPS/CPU），在消费级Apple Silicon笔记本上对推测解码进行了实证研究。最佳配置在K=6时达到1.61倍加速，但五分之三的配置反而减速，原因包括草稿模型不够快或Metal后端的"并行"验证实际是串行执行。
AI.motivation: 大模型自回归解码受限于内存带宽，每生成一个token都需要一次完整前向传播且无法并行化。推测解码通过草稿模型提议+目标模型批量验证来重构计算，但其实际加速效果在消费级硬件上缺乏系统评估。
AI.method: 实现了一个从零开始、跨设备（CUDA/MPS/CPU）的推测解码框架。草稿模型自回归生成K个候选token，目标模型批量评分，通过拒绝采样保证分布等价。在五种草稿/目标模型配置下进行实验，验证了三层分布等价性（含约9200个真实模型token的双样本检验）。
AI.result: 最佳配置在K=6时达到1.61倍实际加速，接受率从K=1的69.7%下降到最优点的37.8%。但五种配置中有三种反而减速，原因在于草稿模型速度不够快或量化Metal后端将"并行"验证串行执行。
AI.conclusion: 推测解码只有在验证真正批量并行且草稿/目标延迟差距真实存在时才有加速效果。失败案例与成功案例同样具有启发性。

title: Learning-Driven Adaptive Audit Scheduling: A Sequential Decision Approach to Off-Chain Data Integrity
summary: We model cryptographic auditing of off-chain data as a Constrained MDP (CMDP) under partial observability: the storage node's hidden type and corruption state make the problem a POMDP, while a miss-rate ceiling rho imposes an explicit security constraint. We propose DRQN-CMDP, a Deep Recurrent Q-Network whose GRU layer maintains a belief over the latent node type, paired with Lagrangian dual ascent that adapts the miss-rate penalty lambda automatically. A pairing-free homomorphic-MAC primitive supplies O(1) on-chain verification cost. Across 13 methods--four DQN variants, PPO, A2C, PPO-Lagrangian, a stateful Bayesian heuristic, three fixed-rule baselines, and an oracle-informed heuristic--DRQN-CMDP achieves a favourable balance: 83% lower gas than fixed high-frequency auditing, single-digit miss rate (7.5%), and moderate detection latency--a combination no other method matches across all three objectives simultaneously.

AI.tldr: 提出DRQN-CMDP框架，将加密审计建模为带约束的POMDP，使用深度循环Q网络与拉格朗日对偶方法，在链上验证成本、漏检率和检测延迟三个目标上取得最佳平衡。
AI.motivation: 链下数据存储的加密审计面临节点隐藏类型与腐败状态的不确定性，现有方法在安全约束（漏检率上限）与审计成本之间难以兼顾。
AI.method: 将问题建模为带约束的部分可观测MDP（CMDP/POMDP），采用带GRU层的深度循环Q网络（DRQN-CMDP）维持对节点潜在类型的信念，结合拉格朗日对偶自适应调整漏检率惩罚项，并设计无配对的同态MAC原语实现O(1)链上验证。
AI.result: 在13种方法的对比中，DRQN-CMDP相比固定高频审计降低83% gas消耗，漏检率仅7.5%，检测延迟适中，是唯一在三项指标上同时表现良好的方法。
AI.conclusion: DRQN-CMDP有效平衡了审计的安全性、成本与效率，为链下数据加密审计提供了一种实用性强的自适应解决方案。

title: SPARE-GS: Structural Parsimony and Resource Efficiency for 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) achieves high-fidelity novel view synthesis in real-time; however its training efficiency and representation compactness are hindered by excessive primitive proliferation. To address this challenge, we formulate the structural evolution of 3DGS as a global budget-constrained optimization problem and derive an optimality condition, which requires the marginal utility of structural resources to be balanced across spatial regions under a finite primitive budget. Based on this formulation, we propose SPARE-GS, a general plug-and-play framework that dynamically aligns the distribution of 3D Gaussian primitives with regional representational demand. SPARE-GS estimates capacity-normalized regional demand, assigns adaptive target quotas, and uses regional budget deviations to coordinate densification, pruning and adaptive termination toward a more balanced structural allocation. Extensive experiments across standard, accelerated, and structure-enhanced 3DGS pipelines demonstrate that SPARE-GS reduces the Gaussian count and training time by an average of 30.38% and 23.81%, respectively, while improving the average PSNR. Moreover, the resulting compact representations reduce downstream processing time and improve the rate-distortion performance of diverse compression and pruning methods, demonstrating the broad applicability of global structural budget regulation.

AI.tldr: SPARE-GS是一个即插即用框架，通过全局预算约束优化3D高斯溅射的原始结构演化，平衡各区域的表征需求，平均减少30.38%的高斯数量和23.81%的训练时间，同时提升PSNR。
AI.motivation: 3DGS在高质量实时新视角合成中，训练效率和表示紧凑性因原始体过度增生而受限，现有方法缺乏对结构演化的全局资源约束。
AI.method: 将3DGS结构演化建模为全局预算约束优化问题，推导最优性条件（各区域边际效用平衡），提出SPARE-GS框架：估计容量归一化的区域需求、分配自适应目标配额、利用区域预算偏差协调密集化/剪枝/自适应终止。
AI.result: 在标准、加速和结构增强的3DGS管道上，高斯数量减少30.38%，训练时间减少23.81%，PSNR提升；紧凑表示还提升了下游压缩和剪枝方法的率失真性能。
AI.conclusion: 全局结构预算调节是一种具有广泛适用性的有效策略，SPARE-GS能提升3DGS的训练效率、表示紧凑性和下游处理性能。

title: Cross-Branch Conflict as a Shield: Safeguarding Facial Identities in Unified Multimodal Image Editing
summary: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) have recently demonstrated powerful instruction-based image editing capabilities, but they also raise serious concerns about unauthorized manipulation of personal portraits. Existing adversarial protection methods are mainly designed for either visual understanding or image generation models and often become ineffective when transferred to UMMs, which process an image through multiple complementary visual pathways. In this work, we first conduct a feature-level analysis of unified image editing. We observe that the ViT-based understanding branch and the VAE-based generation branch exhibit non-trivial structural agreement for the same input image. Although perturbing an individual branch can reduce this agreement and induce intermediate hidden-state deviations, such effects are asymmetric and gradually attenuated during multimodal fusion and generation. These observations reveal that single-branch feature distortion is insufficient for consistently disrupting unified image editing. Motivated by this finding, we propose CCS, a unified adversarial protection framework that jointly drives the ViT and VAE representations away from their clean counterparts while explicitly disrupting their cross-branch compatibility through linear CKA. By simultaneously removing stable information from both visual pathways and creating incompatible visual contexts, CCS prevents the UMM from recovering reliable identity information during editing. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CCS consistently outperforms existing protection methods in suppressing identity-preserving edits.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CCS框架，通过联合扰动ViT和VAE分支并破坏跨分支兼容性，有效防止统一多模态模型对个人肖像的未经授权编辑。
AI.motivation: 统一多模态模型（UMMs）具备强大的指令式图像编辑能力，但同时也引发了对个人肖像被未经授权操纵的严重担忧。现有对抗性保护方法主要针对视觉理解或图像生成模型设计，在迁移到UMMs时往往失效，因为UMM通过多条互补的视觉通路处理图像。
AI.method: 首先进行特征级分析，发现ViT理解分支和VAE生成分支对同一输入图像存在非平凡的结构一致性。单分支扰动效果非对称且在融合过程中衰减。据此提出CCS框架，联合驱动ViT和VAE表示偏离干净版本，并通过线性CKA显式破坏跨分支兼容性，从两条视觉通路移除稳定信息并制造不兼容的视觉上下文。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，CCS在抑制身份保留编辑方面持续优于现有保护方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过同时破坏多模态模型的多条视觉通路并阻断其跨分支兼容性，CCS有效防止UMM在编辑过程中恢复可靠的身份信息。

title: TellTale: Blending Multi-Instance LoRA Text Encoders and a Zero-Shot LLM Judge for Ambivalence/Hesitancy Recognition in Videos
summary: We present TellTale, a text-only approach to ambivalence/hesitancy (A/H) recognition in interview videos, evaluated on the BAH dataset as part of the 3rd A/H Video Recognition Challenge (11th ABAW Workshop, ECCV 2026). Although the dataset provides video, audio, facial crops, and transcripts, TellTale relies on the transcript alone and combines three probability streams. Two text encoders, multilingual-e5-large and mDeBERTa-v3-base, are fine-tuned with parameter-efficient LoRA adapters under a multiple-instance learning (MIL) objective, in which transcript chunks are scored individually and pooled with a smooth maximum so that only the video-level label is needed for supervision. The third stream requires no training: a quantized 14B instruction LLM is prompted, zero-shot, to rate each transcript for A/H. The three probabilities are combined by a weighted average and a single decision threshold, both selected on participant-grouped cross-validated predictions. On the organizer-scored private test set of 152 videos from unseen participants, TellTale achieves a Macro-F1 of 0.7364 and an average precision of 0.7940, compared with 0.2827 Macro-F1 for the official vision-based baseline.

AI.tldr: TellTale是一个仅依赖文本（对话转录稿）的犹豫/矛盾情绪识别方法，在BAH数据集上通过多实例学习和零样本大语言模型结合三个概率流，在测试集上达到0.7364 Macro-F1，远超视觉基线（0.2827）。
AI.motivation: 探索在面试视频中仅使用文本转录进行犹豫/矛盾情绪识别的可能性，挑战现有依赖多模态（视频、音频、面部图像）的主流方法。
AI.method: 1) 两个文本编码器（multilingual-e5-large和mDeBERTa-v3-base）使用LoRA微调，采用多实例学习（MIL）目标，对转录片段单独评分并通过平滑最大值池化。2) 量化14B指令大语言模型零样本提示评分。3) 三个概率流通过加权平均和决策阈值结合，阈值通过留参与者交叉验证选择。
AI.result: 在152个未见参与者视频的私有测试集上，Macro-F1为0.7364，平均精度为0.7940，而官方视觉基线的Macro-F1仅为0.2827。
AI.conclusion: 纯文本方法在犹豫/矛盾情绪识别上显著优于多模态视觉基线，证明文本转录已蕴含充分的情感线索，无需依赖视频或音频信息。

title: DARA: Degradation-Aware Low-Rank Residual Adaptation with Original-to-Corrupted Distillation for Corruption-Robust Animal Re-Identification
summary: Animal re-identification (Re-ID) relies on fine-grained identity cues that can be disrupted by blur, noise, compression, and other visual degradations. Existing robustness strategies based on degradation-augmented training or pixel-level restoration improve robustness indirectly, but do not explicitly repair shifts in the identity retrieval space. We study corruption-robust animal Re-ID as input-conditioned feature-space repair and introduce DARA, a lightweight retrofit for compact Re-ID models. DARA freezes the fine-tuned backbone and learns routed low-rank residual experts to adapt degraded-input embeddings without corruption-type annotations. To stabilize this adaptive repair, original-to-corrupted distillation uses an original-image teacher to preserve individual embeddings and retrieval relations. Experiments on ATRW, FriesianCattle2017, MPDD, and SeaStarReID2023 show that DARA improves corrupted-query retrieval over standard and augmentation-based fine-tuning, generalizes to unseen corruptions and cross-domain evaluation, and recovers 77.0% of the corrupted-query mAP gap to full corrupted fine-tuning while adding only 0.49% parameters and 0.05% FLOPs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DARA方法，通过冻结骨干网络并学习路由低秩残差专家来修复退化输入的特征嵌入，无需退化类型标注，仅增加0.49%参数和0.05%FLOPs即可恢复77.0%的检索性能差距。
AI.motivation: 现有鲁棒策略（如退化增强训练、像素级修复）仅间接提升鲁棒性，未能显式修复身份检索空间中的特征偏移，且需要退化类型标注。
AI.method: DARA冻结微调后的骨干网络，学习路由低秩残差专家来适配退化输入的嵌入；通过原始-退化蒸馏（使用原始图像教师）保持个体嵌入和检索关系，无需退化类型标注。
AI.result: 在ATRW、FriesianCattle2017、MPDD、SeaStarReID2023四个数据集上，DARA提升了退化查询的检索性能，泛化到未见退化和跨域评估，恢复77.0%的退化查询mAP差距，仅增加0.49%参数和0.05%FLOPs。
AI.conclusion: DARA作为一种轻量级后装模块，能够有效修复紧凑Re-ID模型在退化输入下的特征空间偏移，提升鲁棒性且计算开销极小。

title: Self-Modifying Lean Proof Agents with Verifier-Grounded Benchmark Coevolution
summary: Designing effective Lean proof agents is a central challenge in formal mathematical reasoning. Beyond building stronger provers, recent work emphasizes the workflow around Lean: how an agent decomposes proof obligations, uses tools and compiler feedback, diagnoses failures, repairs proofs, and maintains structured proof context. Motivated by code-level self-evolving agents, we study whether such workflows can be evolved rather than hand-designed. We present a self-evolving Lean proof agent in which a small fixed, trusted runtime wraps a fully mutable workspace: the proof workflow, prompts, and tools. Unlike most self-evolving systems, which optimize against a fixed external benchmark, our system coevolves the agent and its benchmark. Between generations, the highest-scoring agent (the champion) revises the active task distribution through a mastery-throttled curriculum update that introduces harder proof obligations only after the current level is mastered, and a single-anchor recalibration re-runs the champion on the updated benchmark to keep scores comparable as difficulty rises. All evolution stays inside a Lean-grounded verification loop: however the agent rewrites itself, a success counts only when its behavior yields Lean-verified proofs under a trusted snapshot, and each attempt must emit a machine-readable, Lean-grounded proof context whose representation may evolve but whose groundedness is enforced. We run the coevolving trajectory and a fixed-benchmark baseline for 15 active generations and compare them on a held-out miniF2F test split. The best coevolving agent reaches a 45.1% held-out solve rate, versus 12.7% for the seed and 32.0% for the best fixed-benchmark agent, showing that verifier-grounded self-evolution can improve Lean proof workflows under a coevolving benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种自演进的Lean证明智能体，通过运行时封装可变工作空间（证明工作流、提示和工具），并采用智能体与基准共同演进的机制，在15代演进后，在miniF2F测试集上达到了45.1%的解题率，远超固定基准的32.0%和初始种子的12.7%。
AI.motivation: 当前Lean证明智能体的工作流（如证明分解、工具使用、失败诊断、修复等）多依赖人工设计，缺乏自动化演进能力，研究者希望借鉴代码级自演进智能体的思想，探索这些工作流能否自动演化而非手工设计。
AI.method: 提出一个自演进Lean证明智能体系统：1) 一个固定可信的小型运行时包裹完全可变的工作空间（工作流、提示、工具）；2) 智能体与基准共同演进，最高分冠军通过掌握度阈值课程更新引入更难证明任务；3) 单锚定重新校准确保分数可比性；4) 所有演进都在Lean验证循环内进行，仅当行为产生Lean验证的证明才算成功。
AI.result: 经过15代主动演进，最佳共同演进智能体在保留的miniF2F测试集上达到45.1%的解题率，而固定基准智能体为32.0%，初始种子仅为12.7%。
AI.conclusion: 验证器锚定的自演进能够有效改进Lean证明工作流，共同演进基准的策略优于固定基准，为自动化的形式化证明智能体设计提供了新方向。

title: DRIFT: Difficulty-aware Rectified Flows for Through-plane MRI Super-Resolution
summary: Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) is often acquired with anisotropic resolution to reduce scan time, producing stair-step artifacts along the through-plane direction. In through-plane MRI super-resolution, an efficiency-fidelity trade-off arises: feed-forward regressors are fast but oversmooth at large slice-thicknesses, while sampling-based methods improve fidelity at high inference cost. We propose DRIFT, a two-stage thickness-conditioned rectified flow framework for through-plane MRI super-resolution with continuous input slice-thickness. Stage 1 employs an Anatomical Projection Network (APN) to map low-resolution patches to a coarse high-resolution manifold, providing a deterministic anatomical initialization that shortens the residual transport of Stage 2 and stabilizes slice-wise refinement. Stage 2 refines details via rectified flow and introduces a Physics-Aware Difficulty (PAD) metric derived from slice-thickness induced through-plane bandwidth deficit to guide an Adaptive Integration Scheduler (AIS), allocating ODE steps by thickness. A Consistent Endpoint Trajectory Alignment (CETA) loss enforces thickness-consistent reconstructions. Experiments show that DRIFT outperforms super-resolution baselines while reducing inference cost. Code, models, and interactive demos are available at https://yoonseokchoi-ai.github.io/drift-eccv2026/.

AI.tldr: DRIFT是一种两阶段厚度条件整流流框架，用于连续输入切片厚度的MRI超分辨率。第一阶段用解剖投影网络提供粗分辨率初始化解，第二阶段用整流流细化细节，通过物理感知难度度量和自适应积分调度器降低推理成本，并采用一致性端点轨迹对齐损失确保厚度一致性重建。
AI.motivation: 各向异性MRI分辨率导致的阶梯伪影问题需要在超分辨率中平衡效率与保真度：前馈回归器速度快但过度平滑，采样方法保真度高但推理成本大。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：Stage 1 APN提供粗分辨率初始化；Stage 2用整流流细化，引入PAD度量和AIS自适应分配ODE步数，CETA损失保证厚度一致性。
AI.result: DRIFT在超分辨率任务上优于基线方法，同时降低了推理成本。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种兼顾效率与保真度的连续切片厚度MRI超分辨率方法，代码和模型已开源。

title: Quantifying Diversity of Thought: A Predictive Law of Weighted LLM Ensemble Lift
summary: This paper provides an experimentally verified formal law for calculating the uplift that diversity of thought provides in Large Language Model (LLM) ensembles. From first principles, we derive an exact decomposition of LLM ensemble lift into rescue and damage masses, which yields a compact heuristic for calculating uplift. From this we extract the metrics which predict ensemble performance: an accuracy adjusted correctness correlation, $φ_{\mathrm{adj}}$, together with the accuracy gap and collective accuracy of the pair. We test the law on 767,520 inferences from ten open-weight models over two graduate-level science benchmarks, together with a novel agentic cybersecurity benchmark in which each model conducts digital-forensics investigations by multi-turn tool use in a network-isolated sandbox (23,520 graded trials including abstentions); all votes are released openly. Calibrated once on SuperGPQA at a 40:60 vote split, the heuristic predicts lift on the calibration set with Spearman's $ρ=0.84$ and, with its coefficients frozen, transfers to two datasets never used in calibration ($ρ=0.51$ on GPQA Diamond and $0.84$ on the forensic tasks), whilst the measured swap mass tracks realised lift with $R^2\ge 0.96$ throughout. Raw $φ$ has almost no predictive power ($R^2\le 0.09$ throughout); the accuracy-adjusted $φ_{\mathrm{adj}}$ is markedly superior ($R^2=0.67$ on SuperGPQA), and the heuristic combining these metrics is the most stable pre pooling predictor across the three datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实验验证了多样性思维对大型语言模型（LLM）集成性能提升的正式规律，推导出救助质量与损害质量的分解，并提出了预测集成性能的精度调整相关性指标φ_adj，在多个基准测试上验证了其预测能力。
AI.motivation: 目前缺乏一个经过实验验证的正式规律，能够准确预测LLM集成中多样性思维带来的性能提升，现有指标（如原始相关性φ）预测能力极弱。
AI.method: 从第一性原理推导出LLM集成提升的精确分解（救助质量与损害质量），得到简洁启发式公式；提出精度调整的正确性相关性指标φ_adj，结合精度差距和集体准确率预测集成性能；在767,520次推理和23,520次网络安全试炼上验证。
AI.result: 启发式公式在SuperGPQA上校准后Spearman ρ=0.84；冻结系数后迁移到GPQA Diamond（ρ=0.51）和取证任务（ρ=0.84）；交换质量追踪实际提升的R²≥0.96；原始φ的R²≤0.09，而φ_adj的R²=0.67。
AI.conclusion: 精度调整的φ_adj指标显著优于原始相关性，结合多种指标的启发式公式是跨数据集最稳定的预集成预测器，验证了多样性思维提升LLM集成的正式规律。

title: Thinking in Video: Can Video Generators Really Reason About the Real World?
summary: Recent advances in world models and video generation have given rise to an emerging reasoning paradigm that leverages video generative models to simulate, predict, and reason about real-world dynamics. We redefine this paradigm as Thinking in Video, where video is not merely an output artifact but a medium for constructing, extending, and verifying causal thought. However, this promise remains unverified: convincing rollouts may reflect memorized appearances rather than causal understanding, while existing metrics separate perceptual fidelity from semantic logic. To evaluate whether video generators support such reasoning, we introduce the Causal-Generative Dual-Judge (CGDJ), auditing World Model Consistency from two perspectives. Explicit Causal Perception tests whether a generator reads a video scenario as a reasoning problem through spatio-temporal flattened visual question answering, while Implicit Generative Perception-Prediction Gap evaluates whether it renders the causal consequence as a consistent future video. Applying CGDJ to representative open- and closed-source generators reveals a clear Perception-Prediction Gap: open-source models produce plausible dynamics despite near-zero explicit causal perception, whereas advanced closed-source systems show stronger but still limited alignment between reasoning and generation. Further analysis exposes audio-visual misalignment, where models verbalize correct causal logic more reliably than they render it, challenging the "world simulator" narrative.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"视频思维"范式，将视频生成模型作为因果推理的媒介，并设计CGDJ评估框架。研究发现开源模型生成逼真但缺乏因果理解，闭源模型因果与生成间存在差距，且视听模态存在错位，挑战了"世界模拟器"的说法。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成模型虽能生成逼真内容，但其是否具备真正的因果推理能力尚不明确；传统评估指标将感知保真度与语义逻辑分离，无法有效衡量生成模型是否支持因果推理。
AI.method: 提出Causal-Generative Dual-Judge (CGDJ)框架，包含显式因果感知（时空展平VQA测试）和隐式生成感知-预测差距（评估生成模型能否渲染因果一致的未来视频）两个维度。
AI.result: 开源模型能生成合理的动态但显式因果感知接近零；闭源模型因果与生成的对齐更强但仍有限；存在视听错位——模型用语言表达因果逻辑比用视频渲染更可靠。
AI.conclusion: 当前视频生成模型尚不能真正充当世界模拟器，因果推理与视觉生成之间存在显著差距，需进一步弥合。

title: Position: Explanation Stability Is a Property of the Model Method Pair, Not the Model
summary: This position paper argues that claims about explanation stability are scientifically invalid without cross method validation. Just as statistical significance requires the test statistic to be specified, stability should either be evaluated across multiple attribution paradigms or explicitly scoped to the computational objective of a single method. In controlled chest X ray experiments, DenseNet201, ResNet50V2, and InceptionV3 achieved AUC values above 99%, yet their stability rankings reversed across attribution methods.
