We present the first deep learning pipeline for wildlife leprosy detection and contribute the PanLep300 dataset of 125,670 annotated bounding-box crops across 953 tracks from 303 camera-trap videos with ecologically-motivated splits that withhold whole individuals and camera installations. We benchmark spatial (2D), temporally aggregated (2.5D), and video-based (3D) classification approaches to investigate which approach is best suited to automated leprosy detection in wild apes. We find that simple aggregation of crop-level predictions consistently matches or outperforms both learned temporal models and end-to-end video architectures -- consistent with leprosy's static cutaneous presentation. We further find that performance is suppressed when tracklets contain frames of partially visible individuals -- as commonly occurs at the start and end of a track -- and demonstrate that this can be addressed through targeted construction and aggregation strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个用于野生动物麻风病检测的深度学习管道，并构建了PanLep300数据集。通过对比2D、2.5D和3D分类方法，发现简单的2D预测聚合方法表现最佳，符合麻风病静态皮肤病变的特点。
AI.motivation: 西非野生黑猩猩中已确认存在麻风病，但人工审查大规模相机陷阱视频数据不可行，亟需自动化筛查方法。
AI.method: 构建PanLep300数据集（125,670个标注边界框，953条轨迹，303个视频），采用生态学动机的数据划分（保留完整个体和相机安装）。对比2D、2.5D（时间聚合）和3D（视频级）分类方法。
AI.result: 简单的2D裁剪级预测聚合方法一致优于或持平于学习型时间模型和端到端视频架构；部分可见个体的短轨迹会抑制性能，可通过针对性构建和聚合策略改善。
AI.conclusion: 对于静态皮肤病变的麻风病检测，简单聚合方法足够有效，无需复杂时间模型；需注意轨迹中部分可见帧对性能的影响。

title: The PanAf-SBR Dataset: Social Behaviour Recognition for Wild Great Apes
summary: Behavioural shifts in wild great ape populations, particularly the breakdown of social structures, can serve as an early indicator of population decline. Automating the detection of behaviours indicative of these shifts is therefore a critical task for conservation. Several valuable datasets have recently been introduced for the automated recognition of great ape behaviour, yet few include fine-grained social behaviour annotations, and those that do are captured either in captive settings or via aerial platforms such as UAVs. We address this gap by introducing PanAf-SBR, the first wild great ape camera trap dataset annotated with social behaviours. PanAf-SBR extends PanAf500 with 100 additional videos covering 36,063 frames. These come with 81,096 annotations including bounding boxes, segmentation masks, intra-video identities, and seven social behaviour classes defined under the action giver and receiver convention of ChimpACT. We use this data together with the AlphaChimp architecture to establish the first benchmarks for fine-grained social behaviour recognition in wild great apes from camera trap footage. We further conduct bidirectional transfer learning experiments between PanAf-SBR and the captive ChimpACT dataset, finding that cross-dataset pre-training is highly beneficial for specific classes rather than of uniform benefit. Finally, we examine the role of background context by inverting the segmentation masks to suppress non-ape pixels.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了 PanAf-SBR，这是首个标注了社交行为的野生类人猿相机陷阱数据集，并利用 AlphaChimp 架构建立了细粒度社交行为识别基准。实验发现跨数据集预训练对特定类别有益，并通过掩码反转分析了背景上下文的作用。
AI.motivation: 野生类人猿种群行为变化（特别是社会结构崩溃）可作为种群衰退的早期指标，因此自动化检测相关行为对保护工作至关重要。现有数据集缺乏野外环境下的细粒度社交行为标注，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 在 PanAf500 基础上新增 100 个视频（36,063 帧），提供 81,096 个标注（边界框、分割掩码、身份标识和 7 类社交行为）。采用 AlphaChimp 架构建立基准，进行双向迁移学习实验，并通过反转分割掩码抑制非猿类像素以分析背景作用。
AI.result: 建立了野生类人猿相机陷阱视频中细粒度社交行为识别的首个基准；跨数据集预训练对特定类别效果显著提升而非均匀受益；背景上下文对识别性能有影响。
AI.conclusion: PanAf-SBR 填补了野外类人猿社交行为自动识别数据集的空白，为保护生物学中的行为监测提供了新工具，迁移学习的非均匀收益表明需要针对性地设计预训练策略。

title: Does Super-Resolution Preserve Defect Evidence? A Low-False-Call Benchmark for Semiconductor Inspection
summary: Super-resolution can make inspection images appear sharper without preserving the evidence needed to detect a defect. We study this failure mode with a benchmark that separates reconstruction from detection and evaluates both at a predeclared low false-positive rate. Ten end-to-end repetitions combine independently generated line/space and contact-hole images with model training, calibration, clean controls, weak defects, and a held-out defect morphology. Every reconstruction is scored by the same local residual detector, while direct and jointly trained detectors form a separate comparison track. Reconstruction fidelity and inspection utility diverge: the two learned reconstruction models attain the highest structural similarity yet detect fewer defect pixels than bicubic interpolation in every paired repetition. A direct DeepLabV3 detector reaches $0.1984\pm0.0385$ recall at $0.000174\pm0.000084$ false-positive rate and satisfies the held-out feasibility criterion in all ten repetitions. An illustrative joint model, DPU-WaferSR, passes independent clean calibration but exceeds the held-out limit in all ten repetitions, demonstrating that calibration success does not guarantee transfer. Weak-defect recall remains near zero for every feasible method. Applying the unchanged policies to 4,591 public Carinthia-S masks further reveals large method-dependent shifts on real SEM texture. These results support a simple conclusion: super-resolution for inspection should be judged by preserved task evidence and operating-point transfer, not reconstruction quality alone.

AI.tldr: 本文通过基准测试发现，超分辨率技术在检测任务中虽能提升图像清晰度，但会丢失缺陷检测所需的关键证据；在固定低假阳性率下，学习型超分辨率模型的重构保真度与检测效用出现背离，其缺陷像素检测能力甚至低于简单双三次插值，而直接检测器（DeepLabV3）在所有测试中均满足可转移性要求，表明超分辨率技术用于检测时应以任务证据保留和操作点转移能力作为评判标准，而非单纯追求重构质量。
AI.motivation: 超分辨率技术虽能使检测图像视觉上更清晰，但可能破坏缺陷检测所需的关键证据，现有评估方法未能充分揭示这一失效模式。
AI.method: 构建基准测试，独立分离重构与检测环节，在预声明的低假阳性率下评估；采用10次端到端重复实验，包含线条/空间和接触孔图像，对比多种模型（学习型超分辨率、双三次插值、直接检测器DeepLabV3、联合模型DPU-WaferSR），并扩展至4,591个真实SEM掩膜数据集验证方法迁移性。
AI.result: 学习型超分辨率模型SSIM最高但缺陷像素检测能力最差；直接检测器DeepLabV3在0.000174假阳性率下召回率达0.1984且全部通过迁移测试；联合模型校准成功但迁移全部失败；弱缺陷召回率对所有可行方法接近零；在真实SEM纹理上方法间存在显著转移差异。
AI.conclusion: 超分辨率用于检测时应以任务证据保留和操作点转移能力作为评判标准，而非单纯追求重构质量。

title: TimeLens2: Generalist Video Temporal Grounding with Multimodal LLMs
summary: Video multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can describe what happens in a video, but rarely identify when the supporting evidence occurs. We study generalist video temporal grounding, in which one model predicts a variable-cardinality set of evidence intervals across video lengths, domains, query forms, and viewpoints. Existing training strategies are misaligned with this set-valued task: long-video labels often rely on brittle one-pass annotation, while reinforcement-learning rewards either fail to distinguish non-overlapping predictions or require fragile segment matching. TimeLens2 treats temporal evidence as an interval set throughout supervision and optimization. TimeLens2-93K constructs reliable multi-span supervision through caption-derived proposals, independent localization, cross-agent consensus, semantic verification, and boundary refinement. Our temporal Wasserstein reward computes exact one-dimensional \(W_1\) between uniform distributions over merged interval supports, providing dense, matching-free feedback under unequal cardinalities and equivalent fragmentation; temporal IoU complements it with precise-overlap feedback. Across seven benchmarks, TimeLens2-2B outperforms all size-matched baselines on every benchmark, while the 4B and 8B variants achieve state-of-the-art performance, surpassing open-source models with up to 397B parameters. The 2B, 4B, and 8B variants improve over their Qwen3-VL backbones by 14.2, 13.0, and 18.1 mIoU points, respectively.

AI.tldr: TimeLens2提出了一种面向视频时间定位的通用框架，将时间证据视为区间集合，通过新构建的93K多跨度监督数据集和时序Wasserstein奖励函数，实现了在多种视频长度、领域和查询形式下的高性能时间定位。2B/4B/8B模型均超越同规模基线，并优于397B参数的开源模型。
AI.motivation: 现有视频多模态大模型能描述视频内容，但难以准确定位证据发生的时间位置；已有的训练策略（如长视频单次标注、强化学习奖励）与多区间集合预测任务不匹配，导致模型无法泛化到不同视频长度、领域和查询形式。
AI.method: 1) TimeLens2-93K数据集构建：通过字幕候选提议、独立定位、跨模型一致性筛选、语义验证和边界细化生成可靠的多跨度监督；2) 时序Wasserstein奖励：计算预测和真实区间在均匀分布下的1维Wasserstein距离，提供密集无匹配反馈，处理不等基数/等价碎片化情况；3) 结合时序IoU提供精确重叠反馈。
AI.result: 在7个基准上，TimeLens2-2B超越所有同尺寸基线；4B和8B变体达到最佳性能，超过397B参数的开源模型。2B/4B/8B相对于Qwen3-VL骨干分别提升14.2、13.0、18.1 mIoU。
AI.conclusion: 通过将时间证据视为区间集合进行监督和优化，结合高质量多跨度数据集与新的奖励函数设计，可以显著提升视频时间定位的精度和泛化能力，证明该方向的有效性和可扩展性。

title: An Explainable FFT-Based Spatial-Frequency Fusion Framework for Deepfake Detection
summary: Deepfake generation has raised growing concerns regarding digital media authenticity, misinformation, identity fraud, and public trust. Recent studies show that combining spatial and frequency features leads to stronger detection results than using independently. This paper presents MSCA-FFT, a Fast Fourier Transform (FFT)-based multi-scale cross-attention framework for image-level deepfake detection. The model combines a partially fine-tuned Xception spatial branch with an FFT-based frequency branch. The frequency branch processes the log-scaled FFT magnitude spectrum through shallow convolutional layers, avoiding inverse frequency-to-image reconstruction used in DCT-based pipelines. The spatial and frequency representations are refined by transformer encoders, fused through cross-attention, and passed to an MLP classifier for real/fake prediction. Experimental results show that MSCA-FFT achieves consistently higher performance than the DCT-based state-of-the-art spatial-frequency fusion method and the compared baseline models. The ablation study further indicates that the FFT-based frequency branch provides complementary spectral cues when fused with spatial features. In addition, FFT-based frequency analysis and Grad-CAM/LIME explanations show consistent evidence around manipulation-sensitive facial regions, including the eyes, mouth, nose, and facial boundaries.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MSCA-FFT框架，结合部分微调的Xception空间分支和基于FFT的频率分支，通过交叉注意力融合进行深度伪造检测，在多个指标上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 深度伪造生成技术对数字媒体真实性、虚假信息传播和身份欺诈构成严重威胁，现有结合空间与频率特征的方法虽有提升，但基于DCT的管道需要逆频率-图像重建，效率受限。
AI.method: MSCA-FFT包含两个分支：1) 部分微调的Xception网络提取空间特征；2) FFT分支计算对数尺度下FFT幅度谱，通过浅卷积层处理。两分支特征分别经Transformer编码器精炼后，通过交叉注意力机制融合，最终由MLP分类器输出真假预测。
AI.result: MSCA-FFT在性能上持续优于基于DCT的先进空间-频率融合方法及对比基线模型。消融实验证实FFT频率分支能为空间特征提供互补的频谱线索。Grad-CAM和LIME解释显示模型关注眼睛、嘴巴、鼻子和面部边界等操纵敏感区域。
AI.conclusion: FFT-based多尺度交叉注意力框架在深度伪造检测中具有优越性和可解释性，为数字媒体取证提供了有效且可靠的技术方案。

title: Bio-SFT: Asymmetric Cortical Guidance and Retinal Adaptation for Robust HDR Reconstruction
summary: Recovering high dynamic range (HDR) radiance from a single standard dynamic range (SDR) image is highly ill-posed. Extreme luminance variation and severe quantization in dark regions make accurate reconstruction challenging, often leading to visual artifacts and color distortions. To address this problem, we propose Bio-SFT, a bio-inspired spiking frequency transformer for single-image HDR reconstruction. Bio-SFT incorporates three biologically motivated components. First, a learnable Naka--Rushton retinal adaptation frontend stabilizes the input under complex lighting conditions. Second, an explicit Parvo--Magno split introduces asymmetric Parvo-to-Magno guidance, allowing high-frequency structural cues to modulate low-frequency reconstruction. Third, an event-driven SNN hard gating module applies all-or-none spiking to suppress dark-region noise while preserving structural details. The module is trained with a sparsity prior to encourage efficient feature utilization. Built for end-to-end training within a transformer backbone, these lightweight components provide strong parameter efficiency. Experiments on HDRTV1K show that Bio-SFT achieves competitive perceptual quality and consistently improves HDR-VDP-3 and $ΔE_{ITP}$ while reducing artifact propagation in symmetric guidance pipelines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Bio-SFT，一种受生物启发的脉冲频率变换器，用于从单张SDR图像重建HDR辐射图，通过模拟视网膜机制（Naka-Rushton适应、Parvo-Magno通路分离、SNN硬门控）有效抑制暗区噪声和伪影，在HDRTV1K数据集上取得竞争性结果。
AI.motivation: 单张SDR图像重建HDR辐射图是高度病态问题，极端亮度变化和暗区严重量化导致重建困难，常出现视觉伪影和色彩失真。
AI.method: Bio-SFT包含三个生物启发组件：1）可学习的Naka-Rushton视网膜适应前端稳定光照；2）显式的Parvo-Magno通路分离，通过非对称Parvo-to-Magno引导实现高低频重建；3）事件驱动的SNN硬门控模块，利用全有或全无脉冲抑制暗区噪声并保持结构细节。
AI.result: 在HDRTV1K数据集上，Bio-SFT实现了竞争性的感知质量，持续提升了HDR-VDP-3和ΔE_ITP指标，同时减少了对称引导流水线中的伪影传播。
AI.conclusion: 受生物视觉启发的轻量级组件（视网膜适应、通路分离、脉冲门控）能有效提升单图像HDR重建的质量和参数效率。

title: DA-MergeLoRA: Hypernetwork-Based LoRA Merging for Few-Shot Test-Time Domain Adaptation
summary: Few-shot Test-Time Domain Adaptation (FSTT-DA) seeks to adapt models to novel domains using only a handful of unlabeled target samples. This setting is more realistic than typical domain adaptation setups, which assume access to target data during source training. However, prior FSTT-DA approaches fail to effectively leverage source domain-specific knowledge, relying on shallow batch normalization updates, prompt-based methods that treat the model as a black box, or ensembling strategies that do not capture cross-domain relationships. To address these limitations, we introduce a new FSTT-DA framework that integrates LoRA fine-tuning with model merging. In our approach, separate LoRA modules are fine-tuned on CLIP's vision encoder for each source domain. Since LoRA modifies only a small fraction of the model's parameters, it retains the base model's generalized knowledge while internally learning domain-specific features. To adapt the learned knowledge to a specific target domain, we propose a hypernetwork trained via meta-learning that generates per-column merging factors to combine LoRA modules. Given a small batch of target images, the hypernetwork produces merging weights that fuse source LoRA modules into a single adapted representation. Our results demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across various domain adaptation datasets. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/nahbois4321/DA-MergeLoRA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合LoRA微调与模型合并的新框架，用于少样本测试时域适应（FSTT-DA），通过元学习训练的超网络生成合并因子，在仅用少量无标签目标样本的情况下实现跨域知识迁移，达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有FSTT-DA方法未能有效利用源域知识，或依赖浅层BN更新、黑盒提示方法、无法捕捉跨域关系的集成策略，存在局限性。
AI.method: 对每个源域在CLIP视觉编码器上分别微调独立的LoRA模块，保留基础模型通用知识的同时学习域特定特征；提出元学习训练的超网络，根据少量目标图像生成逐列合并因子，将多个源LoRA模块融合为单一适配表示。
AI.result: 在多个域适应数据集上取得了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: 结合LoRA和模型合并的方法能有效实现少样本测试时域适应，代码已开源。

title: TraversRL: Traversable Pedestrian Pathway Generation With Reinforcement Learning
summary: Automatically generating pedestrian pathways from aerial images requires producing a connected network suitable for routing, not just detecting where sidewalks appear. Sidewalks and crossings, in contrast to roads, may be partially occluded, implicitly defined, and exhibit complex connectivity patterns. Existing segmentation-based approaches focus on labeling pixels to infer segments, but often produce disconnected or fragmentary graphs that are unreliable for navigation. We introduce TraversRL, a vision-conditioned model that iteratively grows a pathway network from an aerial image, simulating a traveler navigating the built environment. TraversRL uses an action space of short and long direction-distance segments designed to adapt to complex patterns and span occlusions, and uses a combination of graph-level and step-wise rewards to balance overall connectivity with precise edge placement. Across three visual backbones and three intersection datasets, TraversRL substantially improves buffered IoU with the ground-truth graph relative to a state-of-the-art segmentation baseline, and more than doubles metrics of connectivity. Moreover, combining global and local rewards produces cleaner graphs with fewer spurious branches while further improving overall performance. These results demonstrate that modeling pathway extraction as a sequential decision process from the perspective of a traveler, while optimizing for final graph quality with reinforcement learning, produces significantly more reliable pedestrian networks.

AI.tldr: 提出TraversRL模型，将行人路径提取建模为顺序决策过程，通过强化学习从航空图像中生成连通可靠的行人网络，相比分割基线方法显著提升了连通性和准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于分割的方法提取的行人路径网络常出现断裂和不连通问题，难以用于导航；行人和人行道存在遮挡、隐式定义及复杂连接模式，需要更可靠的提取方法。
AI.method: TraversRL是一种视觉条件模型，模拟旅行者导航行为迭代生成路径网络；采用长短方向-距离段组成的动作空间以适应复杂模式和跨越遮挡；结合图级奖励和逐步奖励平衡全局连通性和局部边缘精度；通过强化学习优化最终图质量。
AI.result: 在三种视觉骨架和三个交叉路口数据集上，相比最先进的分割基线，TraversRL显著提升了缓冲IoU，连通性指标提升一倍以上；全局与局部奖励结合可生成更干净、分支更少的图并进一步提升整体性能。
AI.conclusion: 将路径提取建模为从旅行者视角的顺序决策过程，并通过强化学习优化最终图质量，能够生成更可靠的行人网络。

title: Generative Transmission: Rethinking Computation, Bandwidth, and Memory in Communication
comment: Submitted to WAICA on 30 April, accepted on 8 July, and awarded Best Paper on 18 July
summary: Under the AI Flow framework, communication is shifting from transmitting fidelity-oriented information flows toward delivering task-oriented and perception-oriented token flows across heterogeneous network resources. Video communication is a fundamental component of modern information networks. However, under ultra-low-bandwidth and weak-network conditions, conventional video coding and transmission methods, which are primarily optimized for pixel-level fidelity, often struggle to balance visual usability, transmission efficiency, and robustness to unstable links. With the rapid advancement of generativemodels, video communication is also moving from precise signal reconstruction toward receiver-side perceptual utility and system-level usability. In this paper, we propose Generative Transmission (GenTrans) for video communication under ultra-low-bandwidth and weak-network conditions. Built upon Generative Video Compression (GVC), GenTrans formulates video transmission as a joint optimization problem involving bandwidth, computation, and memory, rather than treating it merely as a signal coding task. By leveraging generative priors, cross-clip memory reuse, runtime state reuse, and weak-network-aware transport, GenTrans significantly reduces transmission overhead while enabling visually coherent and practically useful reconstruction. Experimental results show that GenTrans supports effective video transmission under ultra-low-bitrate and weak-network conditions, achieving improved transmission efficiency, decoding efficiency, and robustness while preserving perceptual quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GenTrans框架，将视频通信从传统保真度导向的编码传输转变为生成式传输，在超低带宽和弱网络条件下，通过生成式先验、跨片段内存复用、运行状态复用和弱网络感知传输等机制，实现视觉连贯且实用的视频重建。
AI.motivation: 传统视频编码传输方法以像素级保真度为目标，在超低带宽和弱网络条件下难以平衡视觉可用性、传输效率和对不稳定链路的鲁棒性，亟需新的解决方案。
AI.method: 基于生成式视频压缩（GVC），将视频传输建模为带宽、计算和内存的联合优化问题，利用生成式先验、跨片段内存复用、运行状态复用和弱网络感知传输等关键技术。
AI.result: 在超低码率和弱网络条件下实现有效视频传输，在保持感知质量的同时，提升了传输效率、解码效率和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 视频通信正从精确信号重建转向接收端感知效用和系统级可用性，GenTrans为这一转变提供了可行的技术方案。

title: DecoyFace: Beyond Obfuscation via Controllable and Imperceptible Identity Misdirection for Privacy-Preserving Face Recognition
summary: Split face recognition reduces client-side computation but exposes intermediate features to feature inversion attacks and unauthorized analysis by honest-but-curious (HBC) servers. Existing privacy-preserving face recognition methods mainly aim to resist unauthorized reconstruction, typically producing features whose inversion yields visibly degraded results, which may reveal the existence of protection and motivate adaptive attacks. To address this issue, we propose DecoyFace, an imperceptible decoy-oriented framework that steers unauthorized reconstruction toward a plausible but incorrect identity while preserving recognition utility. The key idea is to decompose the intermediate representation into a reconstruction-sensitive subspace and its complementary subspace. The client injects decoy identity cues into the reconstruction-sensitive subspace, while limited recognition-relevant evidence from the true sample is retained in the complementary subspace. On the server side, an authorized canonicalization module suppresses decoy-dominant components and recovers a recognition-friendly representation. This design addresses both attacker-side inversion from intercepted features and HBC server-side reconstruction from canonicalized representations. Experiments show that DecoyFace preserves competitive recognition accuracy while substantially reducing identity leakage to 2.93% under U-Net attacks and 0.74% under Flow-Matching attacks while yielding visually plausible and imperceptible reconstructions, with over 99.78% face validity on LFW dataset.

AI.tldr: DecoyFace提出了一种隐形的诱饵导向框架，通过分解中间表示为重构敏感子空间和互补子空间，在重构敏感子空间中注入诱饵身份线索，同时保留真实样本的识别相关信息于互补子空间。服务器端通过规范化模块抑制诱饵主导成分，恢复识别友好的表示。该方法在保持竞争性识别精度的同时，将U-Net攻击下的身份泄露降至2.93%，Flow-Matching攻击下降至0.74%，并在LFW数据集上实现99.78%以上的面部有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有隐私保护人脸识别方法主要抵抗未授权的图像重构，但产生的特征重构后图像质量明显退化，暴露了保护机制的存在，从而可能引发自适应攻击。本文旨在实现一种不可感知的保护机制，使未授权重构生成看似合理但身份错误的图像。
AI.method: 将中间表示分解为重构敏感子空间和互补子空间；客户端在重构敏感子空间中注入诱饵身份线索，在互补子空间中保留真实样本的识别相关信息；服务器端使用规范化模块抑制诱饵主导成分，恢复识别友好的表示。
AI.result: U-Net攻击下身份泄露降至2.93%，Flow-Matching攻击下降至0.74%；LFW数据集上人脸有效性超过99.78%；保持竞争性识别精度；重构图像视觉上看似合理且不可感知。
AI.conclusion: DecoyFace有效解决了分割人脸识别中中间特征暴露带来的隐私泄露问题，通过诱饵导向机制在保持识别效用的同时，显著降低身份泄露风险，且保护机制具有不可感知性。

title: FlexiGrad: Adaptive Gradient Modulation for Hierarchical Fine-Grained Classification
summary: Many fine-grained recognition tasks contain hierarchical labels such as order, family and species. Although this supervision should be beneficial, jointly optimising all levels often leads to unstable training because coarse and fine classifiers impose inconsistent gradients on the shared backbone. This hierarchical gradient conflict prevents the model from learning a coherent coarse-to-fine representation. In this paper, we propose FlexiGrad, a simple and parameter-free method that regulates gradient interactions during backpropagation. FlexiGrad removes only the harmful conflicting component when tasks disagree and reinforces the shared direction when they partially agree through a smooth hierarchy-aware weighting function. This produces stable optimisation and preserves both global structure and fine-grained discriminative cues. FlexiGrad integrates into existing architectures without modification while improves multi-granularity accuracy on CUB-200-2011, FGVC-Aircraft and Stanford Cars. The code will be available at PRIS-CV/FlexiGrad.

AI.tldr: 提出FlexiGrad方法，通过调节层级标签之间的梯度冲突，实现粗细粒度特征的稳定联合学习，无需额外参数即可提升多层级分类精度。
AI.motivation: 层级标签（如目、科、种）的粗细分类器会对共享主干网络产生不一致的梯度（层级梯度冲突），导致联合训练不稳定，模型难以学到连贯的粗细粒度表征。
AI.method: 提出FlexiGrad，一种无参数的梯度调节方法：当任务梯度冲突时移除有害成分，当部分一致时通过平滑的层级感知权重函数增强共享方向，从而稳定优化过程。
AI.result: 在CUB-200-2011、FGVC-Aircraft和Stanford Cars三个数据集上，多粒度分类准确率均有提升。
AI.conclusion: FlexiGrad无需修改现有架构即可有效缓解层级梯度冲突，兼顾全局结构与细粒度判别信息。

title: Scalable Model-Assisted Multi-Target Estimation in Large Image Collections
comment: Accepted at the 42nd Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence (UAI 2026)
summary: Computer vision models are increasingly used as measurement tools to estimate population-level quantities from large image collections, but prediction errors introduce bias and the resulting estimates lack statistical guarantees required in scientific applications. Prior work uses a Monte Carlo framework to combine model predictions with ground-truth annotations by sampling some images for humans to label and is able to provide unbiased estimates with controllable accuracy, but primarily addresses single-scalar estimation. We study the more general problem of multi-target estimation, where many quantities (e.g., class counts or proportions) must be estimated simultaneously, and adapt sampling and estimation strategies from survey sampling to this setting. Evaluations on five detection and segmentation datasets with 7-80 classes show that importance sampling excels with moderate annotation budgets or fewer targets, whereas uniform sampling with control variates is superior when estimating many targets or operating with minimal labels. Additionally, a subset-based ratio estimator remains highly competitive across all regimes. Ultimately, our framework effectively combines biased model predictions and limited human labels into rigorous scientific measurements.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了多目标估计问题，提出了结合模型预测与人工标注的蒙特卡洛框架，通过调查采样策略（重要性采样、均匀采样+控制变量、子集比率估计器）实现无偏且可控精度的科学测量，实验表明不同策略在不同标注预算和目标数量下各有优劣。
AI.motivation: 现有计算机视觉模型在估计总体量时存在预测偏差且缺乏统计保证，先前蒙特卡洛方法仅适用于单标量估计，而实际科学应用中需要同时估计多个目标（如各类别数量或比例），因此需要将采样与估计策略推广到多目标场景。
AI.method: 借鉴调查采样方法，将重要性采样、均匀采样配合控制变量法、以及基于子集的比率估计器应用于多目标估计框架中，在5个检测与分割数据集（7-80类）上评估不同策略的表现。
AI.result: 重要性采样在中等标注预算或较少目标时表现优异；均匀采样配合控制变量法在估计大量目标或标注极少时更优；子集比率估计器在所有场景中均保持高竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能有效结合有偏模型预测与有限人工标注，为科学研究提供严谨的统计测量方法，不同采样策略适应不同标注预算和目标数量的场景。

title: Pixel-Space Diffusion Transformers
summary: Latent diffusion models (LDMs) enable efficient high-resolution image synthesis by denoising in a VAE-compressed latent space. However, fixed visual tokenizers can discard fine textures and structural details, while separate representation and diffusion training creates a mismatch between reconstruction and generation objectives. These limitations have renewed interest in pixel-space diffusion, which models raw pixels directly, removes the VAE bottleneck, and supports end-to-end optimization. This formulation better matches the demands of high-fidelity generation but introduces challenges in high-dimensional modeling, including noise scheduling, loss weighting, token efficiency, and scalable architecture design. Pixel-space modeling also offers a promising basis for unified multimodal systems: raw pixels, text, and task conditions can be represented in a shared token space and jointly processed by a single Transformer, narrowing the gap between visual understanding and generation. This paper reviews Pixel-Space Diffusion Transformers (pDiTs) from the perspectives of model architecture, continuous generative mechanisms, and unified multimodal modeling. We summarize representative methods, identify key technical challenges, and discuss future directions toward high-fidelity, end-to-end vision foundation models that integrate generation and understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了像素空间扩散Transformer（pDiTs）在模型架构、连续生成机制和统一多模态建模方面的研究进展，指出其通过直接对原始像素建模、消除VAE瓶颈并支持端到端优化，为高保真图像生成和多模态统一模型提供了新方向。
AI.motivation: 潜空间扩散模型（LDMs）存在固定视觉分词器丢失细节纹理、重构与生成目标不匹配等局限，而像素空间扩散能直接建模原始像素、消除VAE瓶颈并支持端到端优化，更符合高保真生成需求。
AI.method: 本文以综述形式，从模型架构（扩散Transformer）、连续生成机制（噪声调度、损失加权、Token效率）和统一多模态建模（共享Token空间、联合处理）三个维度，系统梳理了像素空间扩散Transformer（pDiTs）的代表性方法。
AI.result: 总结了pDiTs在像素空间建模方面的关键挑战（高维建模、噪声调度、损失加权、Token效率、可扩展架构），并指出其在统一多模态系统中具备缩小视觉理解与生成差距的潜力。
AI.conclusion: 像素空间扩散Transformer为实现高保真、端到端的视觉基础模型提供了可行路径，未来方向包括整合生成与理解能力的统一视觉基础模型。

title: Miles: Metric Learning with Expandable Subspace for Pre-Trained Model-Based Class-Incremental Learning
comment: This work has been accepted by IEEE Transactions on Image Processing
summary: Class Incremental Learning (CIL) aims to learn new concepts consistently from a data stream without forgetting. Unlike typical CIL methods which need to learn a model from scratch, pre-trained model (PTM) can easily adapt to a new task with fine-tuning. However, existing PTM-based CIL methods fail to achieve a trade-off between performance and computational expenditure, i.e., they either adopt the same parameter space so that leading catastrophic forgetting, or expand a new branch for each task but adding more computational cost. To this end, we propose MetrIc Learning with Expandable Subspace (Miles) to harness the prior information within pre-trained knowledge, thereby orchestrating an efficient expansion of the parameter space through guided optimization. Specifically, it decouples the learnable modules with the pre-trained model, exploiting prior information from intermediate features of the backbone network to enable more flexible parameter expansion. Then, a central loss is adopted to guide the new category to cluster towards the corresponding prototype in the new task subspace while incorporating an auxiliary distance regularization term to maintain metric equilibrium across tasks. Extensive experiments on six benchmark datasets demonstrate that Miles achieves state-of-the-art performance in various CIL settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Miles方法，通过度量学习和可扩展子空间，在预训练模型基础上实现类别增量学习，在性能与计算开销之间取得平衡，并在六个基准数据集上达到最优效果。
AI.motivation: 现有基于预训练模型的增量学习方法难以平衡性能与计算开销：要么使用相同参数空间导致灾难性遗忘，要么为每个任务扩展新分支增加计算成本。
AI.method: 将可学习模块与预训练模型解耦，利用骨干网络中间特征先验信息实现灵活参数扩展；采用中心损失引导新类别向对应原型聚类，并引入辅助距离正则化项以保持任务间度量平衡。
AI.result: 在六个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，Miles在各种增量学习设置下均达到了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: Miles有效利用预训练知识，通过引导优化的可扩展子空间策略，实现了高效且高性能的类别增量学习。

title: ConsiSpace: Learning Geometric Consistency Matters for Video Spatial Reasoning
summary: Video spatial reasoning is essential for navigation-oriented perception and long-video question answering, where models must infer spatial relations across long horizons under changing viewpoints. However, existing multimodal large language models (MLLMs) remain largely semantic-centric, and often fail to reliably aggregate consistent spatial evidence from redundant video observations, leading to inefficient or unstable reasoning. To address these issues, we propose ConsiSpace, a geometry-consistency-aware framework for geometry-sensitive video spatial reasoning that turns spatial consistency into both an evidence organization principle and an explicit post-SFT learning signal. We build a geometry-consistent memory (GCM) including implicit evidence tokens and explicit geometric cues, and leverage efficient organization strategies to compactly preserve task-related spatial evidence. Furthermore, we utilize unified consistency self-supervised reinforcement learning (UC-SSRL) after supervised fine-tuning to improve cross-view stability, with answer-, metric-, and topology-consistency rewards. Extensive experiments on three spatial-reasoning benchmarks, VSI-Bench, OSI-Bench, and MMSI-Video-Bench, show consistent gains, improving the average score by 12.6 points over the strongest baselines.

AI.tldr: ConsiSpace是一个面向视频空间推理的几何一致性感知框架，通过构建几何一致性记忆（GCM）和统一一致性自监督强化学习（UC-SSRL），在三个空间推理基准上平均提升12.6分。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型（MLLMs）以语义为中心，难以从冗余视频观测中可靠聚合一致的空间证据，导致推理效率低且不稳定。
AI.method: 提出ConsiSpace框架：1）构建几何一致性记忆（GCM），包含隐式证据token和显式几何线索；2）采用高效组织策略紧凑保留与任务相关的空间证据；3）在监督微调后使用统一一致性自监督强化学习（UC-SSRL），通过答案一致性、度量一致性和拓扑一致性奖励提升跨视角稳定性。
AI.result: 在VSI-Bench、OSI-Bench和MMSI-Video-Bench三个空间推理基准上，相比最强基线平均提升12.6分，取得一致改善。
AI.conclusion: 将空间一致性同时作为证据组织原则和显式的后SFT学习信号，能有效提升MLLM在视频空间推理任务中的几何敏感性和跨视角稳定性。

title: Semantic Color Naturalness Breaker: Preventing Illegitimate Colorization via Content-Aware Color Priors
summary: Automatic image colorization enables large-scale and low-cost reuse of grayscale media (e.g., manga panels and archival photographs), facilitating unauthorized reuse and redistribution. Once released online, grayscale content can be readily turned into unauthorized colorized derivatives using off-the-shelf models, creating a practical need for proactive, content-side protection at publication time. Building on Uncolorable Examples (UE), which add imperceptible perturbations to released grayscale images to degrade unauthorized colorization, we propose Semantic Color Naturalness Breaker (SCNB) -- a semantic-level UE framework that drives colorization outputs toward content-inconsistent colors while preserving the visual fidelity of the released grayscale media. We further introduce Content-aware Color Distributional Distance (CaCDD), a ground-truth-free, content-aware measure of color plausibility derived from semantic color priors, used both as the optimization objective of SCNB and as an evaluation metric. Experiments on ImageNet show that our method remains effective under small perturbation budgets and common post-processing, supporting practical deployment in real-world content-sharing pipelines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出语义级不可着色示例框架(SCNB)，通过添加人眼不可察觉的扰动，使自动着色模型生成内容不一致的颜色，从而保护灰度媒体免遭未经授权的自动着色再利用。同时引入内容感知颜色分布距离(CaCDD)作为优化目标和评估指标。
AI.motivation: 灰度图像可通过现成模型轻易被自动着色，导致未经授权的衍生物再利用和再分发，需要一种在发布时主动保护内容的方案。
AI.method: 提出SCNB框架，在语义层面驱动着色输出生成内容不一致的颜色，同时保持发布灰度图像的视觉保真度；并引入CaCDD作为基于语义颜色先验的无参考评估指标和优化目标。
AI.result: 在ImageNet上的实验表明，该方法在小扰动预算和常见后处理条件下依然有效，支持实际内容共享管线的部署。
AI.conclusion: SCNB能够有效保护灰度媒体免受未经授权的自动着色，具有实际部署可行性。

title: Coarse-to-fine Framework for Generative MEF via Implicit Neural Representation
summary: Multi-exposure fusion (MEF) expands the luminance range beyond what a single exposure can capture. Combining images taken at different exposure levels requires handling geometric differences while naturally merging their complementary brightness information. It often demands generative completion where details are missing. Diffusion-based generative methods address these challenges, however, they are computationally expensive and struggle to preserve fine structures in saturated regions. We propose LIIFusion, a coarse-to-fine framework that balances fusion quality and efficiency in generative MEF. The coarse stage performs low resolution generative fusion, enhanced by an adaptive exposure correction that recovers structure lost in saturated over-exposed areas. The fine stage adapts a local implicit image function into a multi-exposure fusion function: conditioned on the HR OE/UE sources and the coarse output, it queries arbitrary target coordinates and fuses source evidence regardless of the HR input resolution. LIIFusion achieves up to 3.5$\times$ speed-up over existing generative methods while maintaining or improving structural fidelity and perceptual quality. We believe this framework provides an effective pathway toward making generative MEF more practical in real-world applications.

AI.tldr: 提出LIIFusion，一种粗到细的生成式多曝光融合框架，大幅提升效率同时保持高质量。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散生成式MEF方法计算昂贵，且在饱和区域难以保留精细结构，需要更高效实用的融合方案。
AI.method: 粗阶段进行低分辨率生成融合，配合自适应曝光校正恢复过曝区域结构；细阶段将局部隐式图像函数适配为多曝光融合函数，在任意坐标查询并融合HR源证据。
AI.result: 相比现有生成方法提速最高3.5倍，同时结构保真度和感知质量维持或提升。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为生成式MEF在实际应用中走向实用化提供了有效路径。

title: Rarity-Aware Discrete Diffusion with Spatially Consistent Decoding for Photo-Realistic Image Super-Resolution
summary: Continuous diffusion models have become the dominant paradigm for photo-realistic image Super-Resolution (SR), but they typically formulate reconstruction as continuous signal-level denoising and incorporate semantic priors through external conditioning modules. This makes it less direct to exploit the unified token-based scaling paradigm of modern multimodal models. Autoregressive models provide a more native semantic representation by modeling images as discrete visual tokens, yet their causal decoding is inefficient for high-resolution reconstruction. Discrete diffusion offers a promising middle ground by enabling non-causal, parallel prediction over visual tokens. However, directly adapting discrete diffusion to SR remains non-trivial due to two task-specific challenges: (1) the long-tailed distribution of visual tokens, which under-represents rare but perceptually critical textures; and (2) spatially inconsistent parallel decoding, which may introduce isolated artifacts. To address these issues, we propose DiMOO-SR, a rarity-aware multimodal discrete diffusion framework for photo-realistic image SR. During training, Inverse Frequency Sampling (IFS) prioritizes under-represented but information-rich tokens. During inference, Spatial Consistency Ranking (SCR) refines token confidence using local neighborhood agreement to improve structural coherence. Extensive experiments on widely used real-world SR benchmarks demonstrate that DiMOO-SR achieves competitive perceptual quality with only a few parallel decoding steps, highlighting the potential of discrete diffusion for generative image super-resolution. The code will be released upon publication.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DiMOO-SR，一种稀有感知的多模态离散扩散框架，用于真实图像超分辨率，通过逆频率采样（IFS）和空间一致性排名（SCR）分别解决视觉令牌的长尾分布和并行解码的空间不一致问题，在少量并行解码步骤下实现了有竞争力的感知质量。
AI.motivation: 现有的连续扩散模型虽然在图像超分辨率中表现优异，但难以利用统一的多模态令牌缩放范式；自回归模型能提供更自然的语义表示，但其因果解码在高分辨率重建中效率低下；离散扩散结合了两者优势，但直接应用于超分辨率面临两个挑战：视觉令牌的长尾分布导致稀有但关键的纹理表示不足，以及并行解码可能产生空间不一致的孤立伪影。
AI.method: 提出DiMOO-SR框架：训练阶段采用逆频率采样（IFS）优先处理信息丰富但表示不足的令牌；推理阶段采用空间一致性排名（SCR）通过局部邻域一致性来细化令牌置信度，提升结构连贯性。
AI.result: 在多个真实世界超分辨率基准上的实验表明，DiMOO-SR在仅需少量并行解码步骤的情况下，达到了有竞争力的感知质量。
AI.conclusion: DiMOO-SR证明了离散扩散模型在生成式图像超分辨率中的潜力，为解决传统离散扩散在该任务中的关键瓶颈提供了有效方案。

title: Brain-Aligned Multi-Stream Video Transformers with Sparse Self-Selection
summary: Modern video transformers typically ignore principles from primate vision and are rarely evaluated against neural data, limiting their biological interpretability. We introduce a sparse winner-takes-all token selection module that replaces dense self-attention to improve efficiency and approximate competitive routing observed in biological visual circuits. We further propose a neuro-inspired split-and-fuse video transformer which uses two complementary pathways: a high-resolution, low-frame-rate "what" stream and a low-resolution, high-frame-rate "where" stream, fused before classification. On Kinetics-400 and Something-Something V2, our best variant operates on the Pareto frontier of accuracy versus inference time among models of comparable scale and pretraining, and showing improved robustness to spatial perturbations. Using representational similarity analysis between model embeddings and time-resolved EEG recordings for the same video stimuli, our model attains a peak brain-model correlation of 0.18 (about 78% of the noise ceiling) and consistently outperforms strong video transformer baselines, suggesting that pathway specialization and sparse competition are useful inductive biases for efficient, brain-aligned video understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种受灵长类视觉启发的稀疏赢者通吃令牌选择模块和分裂融合视频Transformer，通过双通路设计（高分辨率低帧率的"什么"流和低分辨率高帧率的"哪里"流）在Kinetics-400和Something-Something V2上实现了准确率与推理时间的帕累托最优，并在与EEG神经数据的表征相似性分析中达到了0.18的峰值脑-模型相关性（约噪声上限的78%），优于强视频Transformer基线。
AI.motivation: 现有视频Transformer通常忽略灵长类视觉原理，且很少用神经数据进行评估，缺乏生物可解释性。作者希望通过引入生物视觉中的竞争路由机制和双通路分工来提升模型效率和大脑对齐程度。
AI.method: 提出稀疏赢者通吃令牌选择模块替代密集自注意力；设计分裂融合视频Transformer，包含高分辨率低帧率的"什么"流和低分辨率高帧率的"哪里"流，在分类前进行融合。
AI.result: 在Kinetics-400和Something-Something V2上达到准确率与推理时间的帕累托最优；对空间扰动具有更强鲁棒性；与EEG神经数据相关性达0.18（噪声上限的78%），持续优于强基线模型。
AI.conclusion: 通路专业化和稀疏竞争是高效且与大脑对齐的视频理解的有效归纳偏置。

title: MixDiffusion: Mixing Diffusion-based Uni-condition Text-to-Image Generation Models for Multi-condition Image Synthesis
summary: Recent advances in text-to-image (T2I) generation have enabled controllable image synthesis by incorporating conditions beyond text. However, most existing diffusion-based methods are limited to a single type of control condition (e.g., bounding boxes or keypoints), which restricts their flexibility. To address this limitation, we propose MixDiffusion, a training-free diffusion framework for multi-condition T2I generation. MixDiffusion theoretically supports an arbitrary number of control conditions, including bounding boxes, keypoints, sketches, depth maps, reference images, and text, by collaboratively integrating multiple pre-trained uni-condition diffusion models. The key insight of the proposed approach is to derive the predicted noise distribution in each denoising step of the diffusion-based multi-condition image generation model from the predicted noise distributions of multiple diffusion-based uni-condition models with a derived integration formula, which is supported by rigorous theory proof. Owing to its training-free nature, MixDiffusion is easy to deploy and readily extensible to new control modalities.

AI.tldr: MixDiffusion是一种无需训练的多条件文本到图像生成框架，通过集成多个预训练的单条件扩散模型，理论上支持任意数量的控制条件（如边界框、关键点、草图、深度图、参考图像和文本），并基于严格理论推导的噪声分布积分公式实现多条件协同生成。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散的T2I方法大多局限于单一类型的控制条件（如仅边界框或仅关键点），缺乏灵活性。研究者希望突破这一限制，实现多条件控制的图像生成。
AI.method: 提出MixDiffusion框架，利用多个预训练的单条件扩散模型，通过推导的积分公式在每个去噪步骤中融合多个模型的预测噪声分布，从而实现多条件控制。该框架无需额外训练，理论上有严格证明支持。
AI.result: MixDiffusion理论上支持任意数量的控制条件（边界框、关键点、草图、深度图、参考图像、文本），且由于无需训练，易于部署并方便扩展至新的控制模态。
AI.conclusion: MixDiffusion是一种灵活、可扩展的多条件T2I生成框架，解决了现有方法仅支持单种控制条件的局限性，具有无需训练、易于部署的优点。

title: Reviving Ancient Paintings via Poem: A Colorization Framework for Aligning Cultural Semantics
summary: The irreversible fading of ancient paintings disrupts the "congruence between poems and paintings", a core aesthetic principle where visual imagery harmonizes with literary inscriptions. Although diffusion models provide strong generative priors, restoring historically faithful colors remains difficult: visual restoration is inherently ambiguous, while direct text guidance often causes modern semantic bias, over-saturation, and cross-boundary color leakage. To address this, we propose PoemColor, a poem-guided ancient painting colorization framework. Our method aligns poetic cultural semantics with painting restoration through two key designs. First, the Poetic Painting Projector (P3) converts implicit poetic context into a classical color-aware condition via poem-to-palette pretraining, reducing the ambiguity of poem-to-color mapping. Second, Structure-Aware Semantic Attention (SASA) regulates how poetic color semantics are injected into the diffusion backbone by jointly controlling their propagation direction and regional injection strength. In addition, we construct a hybrid restoration dataset that integrates synthetic degradation with expert-restored artifacts, providing both scalable supervision and real classical color references. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our framework significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods, delivering controllable colorization that revives both historical authenticity and poetic semantics.

AI.tldr: 提出PoemColor框架，利用诗歌语义指导古画着色，通过诗歌-调色板预训练和结构感知注意力机制，实现兼具历史真实性和诗歌意境的着色效果。
AI.motivation: 古画褪色破坏了"诗画合一"的美学原则，现有扩散模型存在语义偏差、过饱和和颜色泄漏等问题，难以恢复历史真实的色彩。
AI.method: 1) 诗画投影器(P3)：通过诗歌-调色板预训练将诗歌文化语义转化为古典色彩条件；2) 结构感知语义注意力(SASA)：联合控制诗歌色彩语义的传播方向和区域注入强度；3) 构建混合修复数据集，融合合成退化与专家修复样本。
AI.result: 在多个指标上显著优于现有方法，实现了可控着色，同时恢复了历史真实性和诗歌语义。
AI.conclusion: 诗歌语义可以有效引导古画着色，解决多义性问题，为跨模态文化遗产修复提供了新范式。

title: LFM: Leveraging Foundation Models for Source-Free Universal Domain Adaptation
comment: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Multimedia (2026)
summary: Source-free universal domain adaptation (SF-UniDA) adapts a pre-trained source model to an unlabeled target domain under both covariate and label shifts, without access to source data. However, existing SF-UniDA methods rely on inefficient techniques such as threshold tuning and clustering. Foundation models (FMs), known for their generalization and zero-shot capabilities, remain underexplored in SF-UniDA. In this paper, we propose a framework that leverages foundation models (LFM) for SF-UniDA. We use a vision-language model (VLM) to compute similarities between target samples and text labels, including those for unknown classes generated by prompting a large language model. The label shift type is determined by analyzing the coefficient of variation of a similarity-based sample-level score. Unknown samples are identified using a binary Gaussian mixture model fitted to another similarity-based metric. Under a consensus strategy, the pseudo-labels generated by the VLM are refined by the target model initialized with the pre-trained source model, integrating knowledge from both the source domain and foundation models. Finally, these refined pseudo-labels are used to train the target model. Extensive experiments across all possible label shifts and multiple benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and superiority of our proposed LFM framework. Our code is available at https://github.com/iamjingli/LFM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LFM框架，利用视觉-语言基础模型（VLM和LLM）解决源数据不可用的通用领域自适应（SF-UniDA）问题，通过文本相似度计算、标签偏移检测、高斯混合模型识别未知样本及伪标签精炼等策略，实现了无需阈值调参和聚类的有效自适应。
AI.motivation: 现有SF-UniDA方法依赖阈值调参和聚类等低效技术，而基础模型（FMs）的泛化和零样本能力在该领域未被充分探索，因此作者旨在利用FMs提升SF-UniDA的性能和效率。
AI.method: 1) 使用VLM计算目标样本与文本标签（含LLM生成的未知类标签）的相似度；2) 通过相似度样本级得分的变异系数判断标签偏移类型；3) 利用二元高斯混合模型拟合另一相似度指标识别未知样本；4) 采用共识策略，用源模型初始化的目标模型精炼VLM生成的伪标签，融合源域和基础模型知识；5) 用精炼后的伪标签训练目标模型。
AI.result: 在多种标签偏移场景和多个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，LFM框架有效且优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: LFM框架成功将基础模型引入SF-UniDA领域，避免了传统方法的低效操作，实现了鲁棒且高效的自适应，代码已开源。

title: BMFA: Boundary-Minority Free-Energy Adaptive Screening
comment: 14 pages. Experiments include synthetic analysis, COCO, LVIS, closed-loop DeiT-Tiny evaluation, and ImageNet-1K classification
summary: Vision Transformers process spatially redundant tokens efficiently only when coarse token summaries preserve the evidence required by exponential attention aggregation. We identify a boundary-minority underestimation failure in which a spatially small, high-response region contributes dominant Gibbs mass while remaining nearly invisible to a block mean. We formalize the failure through the discrepancy between normalized log-mean-exp free energy and mean summarization, prove that minority Gibbs mass can remain non-vanishing as its spatial support and mean contribution vanish, and characterize the limitations of finite-order moment corrections. Building on the resulting analysis, we introduce Boundary-Minority Free-Energy Adaptive Screening (BMFA), which constructs a hierarchical piecewise-constant approximation and recursively refines blocks according to a computable lower-bound increment of local free energy. Controlled synthetic tests, COCO and LVIS diagnostic probes, closed-loop DeiT-Tiny evaluations, and ImageNet-1K experiments establish a consistent evidence chain. BMFA reduces the mean synthetic underestimate from 2.582 to 0.261 at a 5.794% leaf ratio, lowers the COCO image-edge mean gap from 2.254 to 0.526, and preserves 71.520% ImageNet Top-1 accuracy at a 55.861% leaf ratio. The current prototype evaluates selection quality after full QK computation; the reported leaf ratio therefore characterizes representation granularity rather than verified sparse-kernel speedup.

AI.tldr: 本文发现Vision Transformer中空间小但响应强的区域（边界-少数）会被平均池化低估，提出BMFA方法通过层次化分段常数逼近和递归细化来修正此问题，在多个测试中验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: Vision Transformer在处理空间冗余token时，粗粒度的token摘要可能导致边界-少数区域（空间小但响应强）被低估，从而影响注意力聚合的准确性。
AI.method: 提出BMFA（边界-少数自由能自适应筛选），构建层次化分段常数逼近，根据局部自由能的可计算下界增量递归细化块。
AI.result: 在合成测试中，平均低估从2.582降至0.261（叶子比率5.794%）；COCO图像边缘平均差距从2.254降至0.526；ImageNet-1K在叶子比率55.861%时保持71.520%的Top-1准确率。
AI.conclusion: BMFA能有效修正边界-少数低估问题，且当前原型在完整QK计算后评估选择质量，叶子比率反映表示粒度而非验证的稀疏核加速。

title: RayOcc: Occlusion-Aware Ray Occupancy Estimation via Gaussian Mixture Intensity
summary: Camera-only 3D semantic occupancy prediction aims to infer voxel-wise scene semantics from multi-view images, yet remains fundamentally challenging due to depth ambiguity and occlusion. Along a single camera ray, multiple spatially separated surfaces may coexist, making occupancy inherently a multi-label existence problem rather than a single-depth estimation task. However, most existing approaches favor a single dominant depth hypothesis per ray, limiting their ability to model volumetric scenes under complex occlusion. To address this limitation, we introduce RayOcc, an occlusion-aware ray occupancy framework that reformulates ray modeling as multi-label existence prediction. Instead of predicting a categorical depth distribution, RayOcc estimates a non-normalized Gaussian mixture intensity along each ray and converts it into interval-wise occupancy probabilities via a Poisson event formulation, allowing multiple occupied hypotheses to coexist without enforcing mutual competition across depth. The predicted mixture components are interpreted as occupancy hypotheses to initialize sparse 3D Gaussian primitives, which are refined and rasterized for semantic occupancy prediction. Experiments on the nuScenes benchmark show that RayOcc achieves state-of-the-art overall IoU and mIoU among the compared Gaussian-based occupancy methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RayOcc，一种基于多标签射线建模的3D语义占用预测方法。通过非归一化高斯混合强度与泊松事件建模，解决单射线多表面共存问题，在nuScenes上达到高斯方法SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有纯视觉3D语义占用预测方法沿单射线只预测单一深度假设，无法处理深度模糊和遮挡导致的多个空间分离表面共存问题，本质上是多标签存在性问题却被简化为单深度估计。
AI.method: 提出RayOcc框架：1) 沿射线预测非归一化高斯混合强度，通过泊松事件公式转换为区间占用概率，实现多假设共存；2) 将混合分量作为占用假设初始化稀疏3D高斯原语，经细化与光栅化得到语义占用预测。
AI.result: 在nuScenes基准上，RayOcc在整体IoU和mIoU上达到所有对比的高斯方法中最高水平，验证了多标签射线建模的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 将射线建模从单深度估计重构为多标签存在预测，能够更好地处理复杂遮挡下的体积场景建模，为3D占用感知提供了新范式。

title: Early Yield Prediction for Sugar Beet Fields using Satellite Data -- Learnings from Specialized Vision Transformers
summary: Remote sensing has become an increasingly valuable tool for agricultural monitoring, particularly through the use of publicly available satellite imagery. However, effectively integrating domain knowledge into machine learning methods remains challenging. This study presents a real-world example of early sugar beet harvest yield forecasting from purely optical Sentinel-2 imagery, demonstrating how a tight integration of domain knowledge and machine learning can lead to synergistic gains. We empirically find that using very small vision transformer patch sizes and all available Sentinel-2 spectral bands improves our model despite being uncommon design choices in the domain. As a practical contribution, we were able to identify a large fraction of low-yield fields in a different year early on in the growth cycle through a modified training setup and a ranking-based detection of underperforming fields.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过紧密整合领域知识与机器学习，利用Sentinel-2光学影像实现了甜菜早期产量预测，发现使用小视觉Transformer块大小和全部光谱波段可提升模型性能，并提出改进训练方法实现低产田块早期识别。
AI.motivation: 尽管遥感影像日益普及，但如何将领域知识有效整合到机器学习方法中仍面临挑战，本研究旨在探索这一融合路径。
AI.method: 基于Sentinel-2光学影像，采用小视觉Transformer块大小和全部光谱波段训练模型，并设计改进训练流程及基于排名的低产田块检测方法。
AI.result: 发现非常规设计（小patch大小、全波段）能提升模型性能；在另一个年份的早期生长周期中成功识别出大部分低产田块。
AI.conclusion: 领域知识与机器学习的紧密结合能产生协同增益，为农作物早期产量预测和低产田块识别提供了实用方案。

title: ShotPlan: Cinematic Video Generation with Learnable Planning Token
summary: Current video generation models achieve impressive results in single-shot generation, yet remain limited in cinematic video generation, where coherent narratives and effective multi-shot composition require explicit shot planning. To address this challenge, we propose ShotPlan, a framework for explicit multi-shot cinematic video generation built upon a video diffusion foundation model. Our method introduces learnable planning tokens that capture shot-level transition cues and can be seamlessly integrated with the original video generation tokens to control transition timestamps. Unlike standard video generation tokens, the proposed planning tokens are equipped with Fractional Temporal Rotary Position Embedding (FRoPE), enabling shot transitions to be modeled at the frame level. Experiments demonstrate that ShotPlan significantly outperforms existing cinematic video generation methods, offering more flexible shot management and stronger inter-shot consistency.

AI.tldr: ShotPlan框架通过在视频扩散基础模型中引入可学习的规划令牌和分数时域旋转位置嵌入（FRoPE），实现了显式的多镜头电影化视频生成，在镜头管理和镜头间一致性上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成模型在单次生成上表现优异，但在需要连贯叙事和有效多镜头构图的电影化视频生成方面存在局限，缺乏显式的镜头规划机制。
AI.method: 提出ShotPlan框架，引入可学习的规划令牌（planning tokens）捕获镜头级过渡提示，并与原始视频生成令牌无缝集成以控制过渡时间戳；同时设计了分数时域旋转位置嵌入（FRoPE），支持在帧级别建模镜头过渡。
AI.result: 实验表明ShotPlan在镜头管理和镜头间一致性上显著优于现有电影化视频生成方法。
AI.conclusion: ShotPlan通过显式的镜头规划令牌和FRoPE位置嵌入，有效解决了电影化视频生成中的多镜头编排问题，为未来相关研究提供了新思路。

title: PC-Seg: Progressive Cross-View Consistency for 3D OCT Segmentation from Sparse 2D Annotations
summary: Volumetric segmentation of optical coherence tomography (OCT) images is essential for diagnosing ocular diseases but requires labor-intensive voxel-wise annotations. While semi-supervised learning (SSL) can reduce annotation costs, most existing methods process data slice by slice and fail to exploit the inherent 3D spatial context. We propose PC-Seg, a progressive cross-view consistency framework that learns high-accuracy 3D segmentation models from sparse 2D annotations. Unlike conventional multi-view approaches, PC-Seg uses a single 2D model to learn cross-view consistency from standard B-scans and orthogonal slices, thereby generating reliable volumetric pseudo-labels. These pseudo-labels are then distilled into a 3D model, followed by a co-training stage in which the 2D and 3D models mutually refine each other through ensemble pseudo-labeling. Experiments on the MSHC and Duke DME datasets demonstrate that PC-Seg achieves accuracy comparable to fully supervised learning while using labels for only about 0.7% of the training data, outperforming state-of-the-art semi-supervised and retinal layer segmentation methods. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/gsisaoki/pc-seg-official.

AI.tldr: 提出PC-Seg框架，利用稀疏2D标注通过渐进式交叉视图一致性学习生成可靠的3D分割伪标签，仅用0.7%标注数据即可达到与全监督学习相当的性能。
AI.motivation: OCT图像体积分割需要大量人工标注，现有半监督方法逐片处理数据，未能充分利用3D空间上下文信息。
AI.method: 1) 使用单一2D模型从标准B扫描和正交切片学习交叉视图一致性，生成可靠3D伪标签；2) 将伪标签蒸馏到3D模型；3) 2D和3D模型通过集成伪标签进行协同训练，相互精炼。
AI.result: 在MSHC和Duke DME数据集上，仅用约0.7%训练数据标注即可达到与全监督学习相当的准确率，优于现有半监督和视网膜层分割方法。
AI.conclusion: PC-Seg有效解决了OCT图像3D分割中标注成本高的问题，通过交叉视图一致性和协同训练策略，实现了极低标注比例下的高精度分割。

title: DA-Fusion: Deformable Attention-Based RGB-D Fusion Transformer for Unseen Object Instance Segmentation
comment: 7 pages, 5 figures. Published in the Proceedings of the 2025 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA 2025)
summary: In logistics automation, precise segmentation of unseen objects is crucial for efficient robotic manipulation in cluttered environments. Tasks such as bin-picking and shelf-picking require robust perception to handle occlusions, varying object shapes, and complex spatial arrangements. Traditional RGB-based methods tend to over-segment objects due to their reliance on texture, while depth-based methods often under-segment by focusing primarily on geometric features. To address these limitations, we propose DA-Fusion, a deformable attention-based RGB-D fusion Transformer designed for unseen object instance segmentation. DA-Fusion effectively combines the strengths of both RGB and depth data, enhancing segmentation accuracy in cluttered and multi-layered object environments. We also introduce the Object Clutter Bin Dataset (OCBD), a benchmark dataset specifically tailored for evaluating bin-picking scenarios in top-down views. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that DA-Fusion outperforms state-of-the-art methods across diverse environments, making it particularly suited for real-world logistics tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DA-Fusion，一种基于可变形注意力的RGB-D融合Transformer，用于物流自动化中未见过的物体实例分割，并引入新数据集OCBD，实验表明其优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有RGB方法因依赖纹理易过度分割，深度方法因侧重几何特征易欠分割，两者在遮挡、形状多变场景中表现不佳，亟需一种融合RGB和深度信息的方法。
AI.method: 提出DA-Fusion，采用可变形注意力机制的RGB-D融合Transformer，有效结合RGB纹理信息与深度几何信息；同时构建了OCBD基准数据集。
AI.result: 在多种环境下，DA-Fusion在未见物体实例分割任务上全面超越现有最先进方法，尤其适用于真实物流场景。
AI.conclusion: DA-Fusion通过可变形注意力融合RGB-D特征，有效解决了过分割和欠分割问题，为物流自动化中的杂乱环境物体分割提供了高性能解决方案。

title: To Blend In, First Decouple: Rethinking Camouflage Image Generation via Context-Decoupled Representations
summary: Camouflage image generation (CIG) focuses on generating visually concealed objects that seamlessly blend into their backgrounds. Existing methods typically follow either background-guided paradigms that adapt object appearance via style transfer, or foreground-guided strategies that outpaint surrounding regions conditioned on object features. However, they still suffer from appearance discrepancy and background artifacts. We attribute these limitations to cross-context representation leakage, where object and background cues are entangled in a coupled conditional space, resulting in ambiguous control and degraded camouflage fidelity. To tackle this, we propose a new context-decoupled generative paradigm, termed CamoDreamer, which aims to isolate contextual conditional guidance and explicitly decouple latent camouflage features into coordinated object and background control streams. First, a Contrast-aware Contextual Bridge is designed to model cross-context discrepancies and construct contrast-aware dual conditional guidance. Second, Context-Decoupled Assimilation Streams are employed to separate generative interactions conditioned on the dual guidance, while facilitating background rendering with target-aware cues in the latent space. Finally, a Frequency-Adaptive Contextual Blend module integrates complementary high-frequency textures and low-frequency structures from decoupled features to improve holistic coherence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CamoDreamer consistently outperforms existing methods with a substantial margin, while maintaining a relatively lightweight design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CamoDreamer，一种上下文解耦的伪装图像生成范式，通过分离对象与背景的条件控制流，解决现有方法中外观不一致和背景伪影问题，在保持轻量设计的同时显著超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有伪装图像生成方法存在跨上下文表征泄露问题，即对象和背景特征在耦合的条件空间中纠缠，导致控制模糊和伪装保真度下降，表现为外观不一致和背景伪影。
AI.method: 1) 对比感知上下文桥接模块建模跨上下文差异，构建对比感知的双重条件引导；2) 上下文解耦同化流分离基于双重引导的生成交互，并在潜在空间中加入目标感知线索辅助背景渲染；3) 频率自适应上下文融合模块整合解耦特征中的互补高频纹理和低频结构，提升整体连贯性。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，CamoDreamer在性能上持续且显著优于现有方法，同时保持相对轻量的设计。
AI.conclusion: CamoDreamer通过上下文解耦的生成范式有效解决了伪装图像生成中的外观不一致和背景伪影问题，为伪装生成任务提供了新的有效思路。

title: Measuring Monosemanticity in Sparse Autoencoders via Latent Activation Coherence
comment: This is a preprint version. A shorter version of this paper has been accepted for presentation and publication in the post-workshop proceedings of the 8th International Workshop on eXplainable Knowledge Discovery in Data Mining (XKDD 2026), co-located with ECML PKDD 2026. The appendix is included only in this preprint and is not part of the peer-reviewed proceedings paper
summary: Within Explainable Artificial Intelligence, mechanistic interpretability uses Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to extract more interpretable features from neural representations. However, assessing their monosemanticity, and thus explanation quality, remains challenging. Existing metrics require external concept labels or depend on pretrained embedding models, making them sensitive to encoder's geometry. We introduce the Tversky Monosemanticity Score (TMS), a label-free metric that operationalizes monosemanticity as activation-set coherence of binarized SAE latents, and does not require external embedding encoders. We evaluate TMS on SAEs trained on features from pretrained vision and vision-language models (DINOv3, CLIP, BLIP2), two common SAE regimes (TopK, BatchTopK), multiple sparsity levels, and expansion factors. Our results show that TMS is less affected by encoder anisotropy than its embedding-based alternative, while remaining aligned with established monosemanticity indicators. TMS also reveals distinct SAE training dynamics across base models. Moreover, under encoder anisotropy, TMS provides a stronger indication of probe-based concept deletion effectiveness, while being competitive otherwise.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Tversky Monosemanticity Score (TMS)的无标签度量方法，用于评估稀疏自编码器（SAE）提取特征的单义性。TMS通过二值化SAE潜在变量的激活集一致性来量化单义性，无需外部嵌入编码器。实验表明，TMS比基于嵌入的替代方法更少受编码器各向异性影响，与已有单义性指标一致，并能揭示不同基础模型下的SAE训练动态。
AI.motivation: 现有评估SAE单义性的指标要么需要外部概念标签，要么依赖预训练嵌入模型，对编码器的几何结构敏感，缺乏一种无需标签且不受嵌入模型影响的度量方法。
AI.method: 提出TMS，将SAE潜在变量二值化后，通过激活集的Tversky相似度来衡量其一致性，无需外部概念标签或嵌入编码器。在DINOv3、CLIP、BLIP2等预训练模型上，对TopK和BatchTopK两种SAE训练范式进行了评估。
AI.result: TMS比基于嵌入的度量更少受编码器各向异性影响，与已有单义性指标保持一致，并能有效揭示不同基础模型下SAE的训练动态。在编码器各向异性条件下，TMS对基于探针的概念删除效果提供了更强的指示。
AI.conclusion: TMS是一种有效且鲁棒的单义性度量方法，特别适用于编码器各向异性场景，为SAE评估提供了更可靠的无标签方案。

title: CDIS: Cross-Dimensional Class-Agnostic 3D Instance Segmentation via 2D Mask Tracking and 3D-2D Projection Merging
comment: 6 pages, 5 figures. Published in the proceedings of the 2025 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS)
summary: Class-agnostic 3D instance segmentation is critical for robotic systems operating in unknown environments, enabling perception of previously unseen objects for reliable manipulation and navigation. Existing approaches typically project per-frame 2D instance masks into 3D and merge them, which often breaks object identities across time and yields fragmented 3D instances. We introduce Cross-Dimensional Class-Agnostic 3D Instance Segmentation (CDIS), a zero-shot framework that explicitly tracks 2D instance masks across frames and associates them with 3D superpoints, creating a feedback loop between 2D and 3D. This cross-dimensional reasoning links temporally stable 2D tracks with spatially coherent 3D regions, producing globally consistent 3D instance labels without any 3D-specific training. Experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that CDIS achieves higher accuracy and consistency than state-of-the-art zero-shot methods, while remaining efficient and scalable to diverse real-world environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CDIS框架，通过跨维度推理（2D追踪+3D超点关联）实现零样本的类别无关3D实例分割，无需3D训练即可在基准数据集上达到更高精度和一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将逐帧2D实例掩膜投影到3D再合并，导致跨时间对象身份断裂和3D实例碎片化，亟需一种能保持时空一致性的零样本3D实例分割方法。
AI.method: CDIS框架显式跨帧追踪2D实例掩膜，并将其与3D超点关联，构建2D与3D之间的反馈循环，实现跨维度推理。
AI.result: 在基准数据集上，CDIS的准确率和一致性均优于现有最先进零样本方法，且高效可扩展。
AI.conclusion: CDIS通过跨维度联动2D时间稳定性和3D空间一致性，无需3D训练即可生成全局一致的3D实例标签，适用于真实环境中的机器人系统。

title: Toward Optimal Adenovirus Detection Using YOLO26
summary: This study systematically benchmarks different data augmentation setups across YOLO26 model size variants to determine the most effective setup for adenovirus detection in TEM images. The benchmarked setups include NAS, GAS, GMAS and DAS, all evaluated under identical training conditions. The adenovirus dataset, selected from the published TEM virus dataset, was re-annotated by leveraging adenovirus particle positions to generate YOLO-compatible bounding box annotations. The experimental results demonstrated the impact of the benchmarked data augmentation setups on adenovirus detection with YOLO26 and indicated the most effective data augmentation setup.

AI.tldr: 本研究系统比较了YOLO26模型在不同数据增强设置下对透射电镜图像中腺病毒检测的效果，确定了最优的数据增强方案。
AI.motivation: 透射电镜图像中腺病毒的准确检测对病毒研究和临床诊断具有重要意义，但现有研究缺乏对不同数据增强方法在YOLO模型上系统性的比较。
AI.method: 在相同训练条件下，对YOLO26模型变体分别应用NAS、GAS、GMAS和DAS四种数据增强方案，利用已发表TEM病毒数据集中重新标注的腺病毒数据进行实验。
AI.result: 实验结果显示不同数据增强方案对腺病毒检测性能有显著影响，并明确了最有效的数据增强方案。
AI.conclusion: 通过系统基准测试，本研究为YOLO模型在TEM图像病毒检测任务中的数据增强选择提供了参考依据。

title: FF-ProCams: Feed-Forward Gaussian Splatting for Projector-Camera System
summary:
Projector-camera (ProCams) systems achieve active scene perception and controllable appearance manipulation via structured illumination, serving as a core infrastructure for spatial augmented reality, projection mapping, and surface reflectance acquisition. Existing inverse-rendering methods for ProCams deliver high-fidelity results but rely on time-consuming per-scene optimization, while mainstream feed-forward 3D reconstruction models produce baked appearance that cannot adapt to spatially varying projector illumination.
  To resolve this accuracy-efficiency trade-off, we propose FF-ProCams, a Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian inverse-rendering framework for ProCams. A hybrid Mamba2-Transformer encoder aggregates cross-view geometric and photometric cues from sparse multi-view observations, and lightweight heads predict a relightable Gaussian representation in a single forward pass. We further design a projector-aware differentiable renderer to synthesize camera observations under arbitrary active illumination and ProCams poses. To enable feed-forward training, we construct a large-scale synthetic ProCams dataset covering diverse object geometries and surface materials. Experiments show FF-ProCams achieves high-fidelity projector-aware rendering, generalizes to unseen patterns, and supports novel projector-camera poses. Using only 8 input views, it outperforms optimization-based baselines with 297 views while reducing test-time reconstruction to 0.13 seconds (a three-to-five-order-of-magnitude speedup). The code and data are available at https://github.com/CPREgroup/FF-ProCams/.

AI.tldr: 提出FF-ProCams，一个前馈式3D高斯逆渲染框架，实现投影仪-相机系统的高保真、实时可重光照渲染，仅需8张视图即可在0.13秒内完成重建，速度比优化基线方法提升3-5个数量级。
AI.motivation: 现有ProCams逆渲染方法存在精度-效率权衡：基于优化的方法效果虽好但耗时，而前馈3D重建模型无法适应投影仪的动态光照变化。
AI.method: 提出FF-ProCams框架：1) 混合Mamba2-Transformer编码器聚合跨视图几何与光度线索；2) 轻量级头部预测可重光照高斯表示；3) 设计投影仪感知的可微分渲染器；4) 构建大规模合成ProCams数据集用于前馈训练。
AI.result: 仅用8张输入视图，在0.13秒内完成重建，性能超越使用297张视图的优化基线方法，实现3-5个数量级的加速，并支持泛化到未知投影图案和新视角。
AI.conclusion: FF-ProCams成功解决了ProCams系统中精度与效率的矛盾，为空间增强现实、投影映射等应用提供了高效可行的解决方案。

title: Vis2Reg: Visibility-Aware Landmark-Free Geometric 3D--2D Registration for Liver Laparoscopy
summary: Accurate 3D--2D liver registration, which aligns preoperative 3D models to partial, view-dependent intraoperative surface observations, is critical for AR-guided laparoscopic surgery but remains challenging due to severe occlusion, limited visibility, and the lack of 3D ground-truth supervision. Existing landmark-free approaches perform partial-to-complete geometric alignment, yet robust self-supervision under extreme partial visibility remains difficult. We propose Vis2Reg, a visibility-aware registration framework that explicitly constrains deformation using mask-consistent visible regions. We introduce a visibility-aware self-supervision that derives a visible-domain 3D supervision signal from intraoperative masks, enabled by differentiable point rasterization and mask-guided back-projection. This formulation improves robustness under severe occlusion while maintaining fully self-supervised learning. Vis2Reg combines a robust geometric rigid initialization module with an implicit neural deformation field for stable alignment. Vis2Reg achieves a Dice score of 92.6\% and a Chamfer Distance of 1.43 mm on real intraoperative datasets, with 111 ms per-frame inference time, demonstrating both accuracy and practical efficiency.

AI.tldr: Vis2Reg是一种面向AR引导腹腔镜手术的可见性感知3D-2D肝脏配准框架，通过掩膜引导的可见区域约束和自监督学习，在严重遮挡条件下实现了92.6% Dice和1.43mm Chamfer距离的高精度配准，推理速度达111毫秒每帧。
AI.motivation: 现有无标记点方法在极端局部可见性下难以实现鲁棒的自监督配准，亟需一种能利用可见区域约束、无需3D真值监督的配准方法。
AI.method: 提出Vis2Reg框架，包含：1）可见性感知自监督学习，通过可微点光栅化和掩膜引导反向投影生成可见域3D监督信号；2）鲁棒的几何刚性初始化模块；3）隐式神经变形场用于稳定对齐。
AI.result: 在真实术中数据集上达到92.6% Dice分数和1.43mm Chamfer距离，每帧推理时间111毫秒。
AI.conclusion: Vis2Reg在严重遮挡和有限可见性条件下实现了高精度、高效率的3D-2D肝脏配准，为AR引导腹腔镜手术提供了实用方案。

title: PRiSM: Prototype Regularization for Few-Shot VLMs
summary: Training-free few-shot adaptation methods have gained significant attention recently in the context of Vision-language Models (VLMs). Yet, current benchmarks rely on strong assumptions about the statistics of the adaptation data, e.g., class balance. We question these simplifying assumptions and introduce a more realistic benchmark that varies both the levels of class balance and the effective number of classes in few-shot tasks via Dirichlet sampling. Surprisingly, under our setting, we observe substantial drops in the performances of state-of-the-art methods, more so when the number of labeled samples increases. To mitigate this, we introduce PRiSM, a class-prototype regularization that can be deployed as a plug and play module on top of any existing baseline method, significantly improving performances. Our method optimizes a novel multi-term loss, which includes a regularizer maximizing inter-class pairwise distances, along with additional terms promoting support-feature alignment and fidelity to the baseline prototypes. Furthermore, we introduce an effective and computationally efficient block Majorize-Minimize optimizer for our objective. More specifically, we derive a valid blockwise Lipschitz constant (i.e., a bound on the Hessian's spectral norm), which can be computed efficiently via the Gershgorin circle theorem. Extensive experiments show that PRiSM improves several training-free baselines, with large gains when dealing with severe class imbalance and high numbers of classes.

AI.tldr: 本文指出现有VLM小样本适应基准存在数据统计假设过强的问题，引入基于狄利克雷采样的更真实基准，并提出了即插即用的类原型正则化方法PRiSM，通过多目标损失和高效的Majorize-Minimize优化器显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有训练-free小样本适应方法在基准测试中依赖于强假设（如类别平衡），这些假设与真实场景不符。本文旨在揭示这些简化假设带来的性能虚高问题，并提出更鲁棒的解决方案。
AI.method: 1) 引入基于狄利克雷采样的新基准，变化类别平衡度和有效类别数；2) 提出PRiSM模块，包含最大化类间距离的正则项、支持特征对齐项和基线原型保真项；3) 设计基于块Majorize-Minimize的高效优化器，利用Gershgorin圆定理计算块Lipschitz常数。
AI.result: 在更真实的不平衡基准下，现有方法性能大幅下降，尤其是标记样本增多时。PRiSM作为即插即用模块能显著提升多个训练-free基线，在严重类别不平衡和高类别数情况下增益最大。
AI.conclusion: 现有VLM小样本适应方法在非平衡场景下存在严重性能退化，PRiSM通过类原型正则化能有效缓解该问题，且具有高效性和通用性。

title: Consistent Feature Transport for Image Relighting
summary: Image relighting modifies illumination while preserving non-lighting content such as identity and geometry. Existing diffusion-based methods often suffer from unstable illumination changes or inconsistent content preservation under complex lighting, as they lack an explicit mechanism to learn feature transformations between images. We reformulate relighting as an illumination feature transport problem and introduce Consistent Feature Transport (CFT), a training principle that explicitly enforces illumination-consistent transport between source and target image distributions. Built upon rectified flow, CFT jointly models noise-to-image generation and illumination-consistent source-to-target transport through trajectory-level supervision. This dual-transport formulation encourages isolation of illumination-specific variations while preserving content-aligned features. To support complex lighting scenarios, we construct a large-scale portrait relighting dataset with diverse relighting effects. Experiments show consistent improvements over existing state-of-the-art relighting approaches and demonstrate that CFT can generalize to other editing tasks, including style transfer. Code is available at https://github.com/Dixin-Lab/CFT.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为CFT（一致特征传输）的图像重光照方法，将重光照视为光照特征传输问题，通过轨迹级监督联合建模噪声到图像生成和光源到目标的光照一致传输，在肖像重光照数据集上优于现有方法，并能泛化到风格迁移等任务。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散的图像重光照方法在复杂光照下常出现不稳定的光照变化或内容保持不一致的问题，缺乏显式学习图像间特征变换的机制。
AI.method: 将重光照重新定义为光照特征传输问题，提出CFT训练原则，基于整流流（rectified flow）通过轨迹级监督联合建模噪声到图像生成和光照一致的源到目标传输，实现光照变化的隔离和内容对齐特征的保持。同时构建了大规模肖像重光照数据集。
AI.result: 在多项实验中一致优于现有最先进的重光照方法，并能泛化到风格迁移等其他编辑任务。
AI.conclusion: CFT通过显式的特征传输机制有效解决了复杂光照下的重光照问题，具备良好的泛化能力。

title: CaT-GS: Efficient 3DGS Rendering for Large Scale Scenes via Inter-frame Caching and Tile Scheduling
summary: Recent breakthroughs in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have advanced neural rendering with high fidelity and speed. However, its performance degrades significantly in large-scale scenes due to the computational burden of tile-based rasterization. Existing optimization efforts either require costly scene re-training or focus on narrow aspects of the pipeline, overlooking critical inefficiencies in real-world deployments. Through a comprehensive analysis, we identify three primary sources of redundancy and low GPU utilization: redundant inter-frame pre-processing, viewpoint-based occlusion redundancy, and severe tile-level load imbalance. To address these issues, we propose CaT-GS, a novel and efficient 3DGS rendering pipeline. CaT-GS introduces a speculative multi-frame preprocessing method to eliminate redundant computations across consecutive frames, and an inter-frame caching mechanism to eliminate viewpoint redundant rendering stages. Furthermore, it refactors rasterization tasks with a dedicated kernel to mitigate tile load imbalance, significantly boosting GPU utilization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CaT-GS achieves a speedup of up to 10 times over the original 3DGS and up to 70% over previous state-of-the-art methods, establishing a new benchmark for high-fidelity, real-time rendering of large-scale scenes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CaT-GS，一种针对大规模场景的高效3D高斯泼溅渲染管线，通过投机性多帧预处理、帧间缓存机制和专用光栅化内核，实现最高10倍于原始3DGS的加速，并超过现有最先进方法70%。
AI.motivation: 3DGS在大规模场景中因瓦片光栅化的计算负担导致性能严重下降，现有优化方法要么需要昂贵重训，要么仅关注局部环节，缺乏对实际部署中关键低效问题的系统性解决。
AI.method: 1) 投机性多帧预处理方法，消除连续帧间的冗余计算；2) 帧间缓存机制，消除基于视点的冗余渲染阶段；3) 重构光栅化任务并设计专用内核，缓解瓦片级负载不均衡，提升GPU利用率。
AI.result: 在实验中，CaT-GS相比原始3DGS实现最高10倍加速，相比之前最先进方法实现最高70%加速，成为大规模场景高保真实时渲染的新基准。
AI.conclusion: CaT-GS通过系统性地识别和解决3DGS在大型场景中三种主要冗余与低效问题（帧间预处理冗余、视点遮挡冗余、瓦片负载不均衡），大幅提升了渲染效率，为大规模场景实时高保真渲染树立了新标准。

title: Leveraging Dissimilarity Invariance as a Robust Anchor for Learning with Noisy Labels
summary: Deep learning models excel in visual recognition but suffer severe performance drops when training labels are corrupted by noise. Under label noise prior work cannot learn accurate similarities and thus misguide the learning process. In this paper, we uncover a complementary and novel phenomenon, Dissimilarity Invariance, whereby semantic dissimilarity between unrelated samples remains stable despite label noise. Leveraging this insight, we propose NegScale, a plug-and-play framework that shifts focus from fragile similarity to robust dissimilarity. NegScale integrates: (1) Structured Negative Orthogonality Penalty (SNOP), enforcing subspace orthogonality for unrelated samples; and (2) Dissimilarity-Calibrated Similarity Adjustment (DCSA), suppressing spurious similarity using dissimilarity anchors. We also give theoretical analysis that proves Dissimilarity Invariance and the effectiveness of NegScale. Empirical results demonstrate that NegScale consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, establishing new benchmarks on CIFAR with synthetic noise and real-world datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NegScale框架，利用"不相似性不变性"现象，通过鲁棒的不相似性来应对标签噪声，显著提升视觉识别性能。
AI.motivation: 深度学习模型在标签噪声下性能严重下降，现有方法无法学习准确相似性，导致学习过程被误导。
AI.method: 提出NegScale框架，包含两个核心模块：(1)结构化负正交惩罚(SNOP)强制无关联样本子空间正交；(2)不相似性校准相似性调整(DCSA)利用不相似锚点抑制虚假相似性。
AI.result: 在CIFAR合成噪声数据集和真实世界数据集上，NegScale一致超越现有最先进基线，建立新的基准。
AI.conclusion: 不相似性在标签噪声下具有稳定性，利用这一特性设计的NegScale框架能有效应对标签噪声问题。

title: Locality-Aware Density Control for Efficient Gaussian-based Image Representation
summary: 2D Gaussian Splatting is an attractive direction for image representation due to its explicit formulation, fast rasterization, and favorable decoding efficiency. The representation quality of this paradigm depends on the proper allocation of Gaussian capacity to the demanding regions. However, existing methods fail to allocate Gaussian capacity efficiently during optimization: under-reconstructed content is often refined in a fragmented pixel-wise manner, while neighboring optimized Gaussians with similar attributes are redundantly retained. This inefficiency motivates the need for a density control framework that jointly addresses insufficient allocation in under-reconstructed regions and redundant allocation in over-reconstructed regions. Our key insight is that this framework should exploit two complementary forms of locality: the local continuity of reconstruction errors in image space for improved Gaussian allocation, and the local similarity of neighboring Gaussians in Gaussian space for redundant elimination. Based on this insight, we propose Locality-Aware Density Control (LocoADC), a plug-and-play framework that improves Gaussian capacity utilization through Region-wise Gaussian Densification (RGD) and Similarity-Driven Gaussian Merging (SDGM) strategies, together with a local color consistency constraint for more reliable merging. Extensive experiments on diverse datasets show that LocoADC consistently improves multiple baselines by enabling more effective local Gaussian allocation, including a 2.93 dB PSNR gain over GI on the CLIC dataset under the same 30k Gaussian budget. Code is available at: \textit{https://github.com/ChenJiaCong-1005/LocoADC}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Locality-Aware Density Control (LocoADC)框架，通过区域级高斯致密化（RGD）和相似性驱动高斯合并（SDGM）策略，结合局部颜色一致性约束，有效改善了2D高斯泼溅表示中高斯容量的分配效率，在多个数据集上显著提升了基线方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有2D高斯泼溅方法在高斯容量分配上效率低下：欠重建区域以碎片化逐像素方式细化，而过重建区域中具有相似属性的相邻高斯被冗余保留，缺乏联合处理欠分配和过分配的密度控制框架。
AI.method: 提出LocoADC框架，包含三个关键策略：1) 区域级高斯致密化（RGD）：利用图像空间中重建误差的局部连续性进行高斯分配；2) 相似性驱动高斯合并（SDGM）：利用高斯空间中相邻高斯属性的局部相似性消除冗余；3) 局部颜色一致性约束，提升合并的可靠性。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，LocoADC一致性地提升了多种基线方法的性能，在CLIC数据集上以3万高斯预算相比GI方法取得了2.93 dB的PSNR增益。
AI.conclusion: LocoADC作为一个即插即用框架，通过利用两种互补的局部性（图像空间和局部高斯空间），有效提升了高斯容量利用率，是一种高效可靠的高斯密度控制方案。

title: MuViSeg: Multi-View Segment Correspondences from Dense Geometry Priors
summary: Classical image correspondence is solved at the level of sparse keypoints or dense pixels, but the systems that consume these matches - object-level mapping, topological navigation, scene-graph maintenance - reason about whole objects. Recent work narrows this gap by matchng directly at the level of instance segments: a class-agnostic segmenter partitions each image, and per-segment descriptors are obtained by pooling features from large 3D foundation models over the masks. We build on this segment-level matching paradigm and propose three learned matching heads: a LightGlue-style attention head with DoubleSoftmax scoring on frozen MASt3R descriptors; a DPT-style multi-scale fusion module that exposes layered spatial detail from the VGGT foundation model before pooling; and - as our main contribution - a multi-view extension that performs joint self-attention over segments drawn from several views at once, recovering transitive correspondences that strictly pairwise matchers cannot reach. Under a stratified zero-shot protocol on Replica and Virtual KITTI 2 with controlled viewpoint baselines from 0 deg to 180 deg, the LightGlue-style head improves over a parameter-free Sinkhorn matcher on the same MASt3R backbone by +4.85 AUPRC on Replica and +25.9 AUPRC on Virtual KITTI 2. Dropped into the RoboHop topological navigation pipeline on the Habitat-Matterport 3D (HM3D) Instance Image Navigation benchmark without retraining, our multi-view variant raises success rate from 50% to 70%, and our LightGlue-style head raises SPL from 45.7 to 59.1.

AI.tldr: 本文提出三种学习型匹配头（LightGlue风格注意力头、DPT风格多尺度融合模块、多视图联合自注意力模块）用于段级图像匹配，其中多视图变体作为主要贡献，在零样本测试中显著提升匹配性能，并成功应用于拓扑导航任务，将成功率从50%提升至70%。
AI.motivation: 传统图像匹配在稀疏关键点或密集像素层面进行，但下游任务（如目标级映射、拓扑导航）需要对象级别的理解，存在语义鸿沟。近期工作通过实例段级匹配缩小了这一差距，但现有方法仍受限于成对匹配，无法恢复跨视图的传递性对应关系。
AI.method: 提出三种学习型匹配头：（1）LightGlue风格注意力头，在冻结的MASt3R描述符上使用DoubleSoftmax评分；（2）DPT风格多尺度融合模块，在VGGT基础模型上暴露分层空间细节后池化；（3）多视图扩展（主要贡献），对多个视图的段进行联合自注意力，恢复成对匹配无法实现的传递性对应。在Replica和Virtual KITTI 2上采用分层零样本协议评估，并在Habitat-Matterport 3D导航基准上测试。
AI.result: LightGlue风格头在MASt3R骨干上相比无参数Sinkhorn匹配器，Replica上AUPRC提升4.85，Virtual KITTI 2上提升25.9。多视图变体在HM3D导航任务中将成功率从50%提升至70%，LightGlue风格头将SPL从45.7提升至59.1。
AI.conclusion: 学习型匹配头显著优于无参数基线，多视图联合自注意力成功捕获跨视图传递性对应，且无需重新训练即可直接提升下游导航任务的性能。

title: Exploration Matters for Escaping the Blur Trap in 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) employs Gaussian primitives for explicit scene representation, facilitating real-time, high-fidelity reconstruction and novel view synthesis of complex scenes. However, the explicit modeling inherent in 3DGS introduces a gradient bias during optimization, rendering its non-convex optimization process highly susceptible to convergence toward local suboptimal solutions. This constitutes a fundamental limitation in 3DGS optimization, which we term the Blur Trap. To address this limitation, we integrate simple explicit exploration into the 3DGS optimization framework. First, through rigorous mathematical analysis of the 3DGS optimization formulation, we identify the underlying optimization bias responsible for the Blur Trap and categorize it into two distinct subtypes: the Far-Side Blur Trap and the Near-Side Blur Trap. Subsequently, we propose two highly straightforward exploration strategies (Random Seeding and Random Splitting) to mitigate the far-side and near-side blur traps, respectively. Experimental validation demonstrates that the incorporation of these exploration operators effectively and complementarily overcome the Blur Trap, achieving high-quality rendering performance across multiple datasets. Project page: https://chengbo-wang.github.io/ExploreGS/

AI.tldr: 本文指出3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）优化中存在一种称为“模糊陷阱”的梯度偏差，导致优化易陷入局部次优解。作者将其分类为远侧和近侧两种类型，并提出了两种简单有效的探索策略（随机播种和随机分割）来分别缓解这两类陷阱，实验证明该方法能有效提升渲染质量。
AI.motivation: 3DGS虽然能实现高质量的场景重建和新视角合成，但其显式建模带来的梯度偏差导致非凸优化容易收敛到局部次优解，这是一个根本性缺陷。作者将其定义为“模糊陷阱”，并致力于解决这一优化瓶颈。
AI.method: 首先对3DGS优化公式进行严格数学分析，识别出导致模糊陷阱的优化偏差，并将其分为远侧模糊陷阱和近侧模糊陷阱两类。然后提出两种简单探索策略：随机播种（Random Seeding）和随机分割（Random Splitting），分别用于缓解远侧和近侧模糊陷阱。
AI.result: 实验验证表明，引入这两种探索算子能够有效且互补地克服模糊陷阱，在多个数据集上均实现了高质量的渲染性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过简单显式探索策略可以有效解决3DGS优化中的模糊陷阱问题，提升渲染质量。项目页面已公开。

title: HAS: Highlight-guided Attention Steering for Multimodal LLM Video Summarization
summary: Video understanding has become more and more important with the growth of Artificial Intelligence (AI) for video generation. Recently, Multimodal Large Language Model(M-LLM) has shown its capability in video understanding. Video summarization, a specific domain of video understanding, has proven its importance for efficient navigation and retrieval. Both video understanding and video summarization require a good selection of key frames in a video. Current video summarization methods heavily focus on the selected key frames and correlated segment captions. However, existing approaches overlook the perspective of treating the importance of the frames globally.
